scenarios.raw: **Collapse one folder (`F04.folder-collapse`).** Run `control-openhands browser click '[data-testid^="thread-folder-drag-ws-"][data-testid$="qa-f04-repo"]'`, `control-openhands browser attr '[data-testid^="thread-folder-drag-ws-"][data-testid$="qa-f04-repo"]' aria-expanded` (`false`) and `control-openhands browser count '[data-testid^="thread-folder-ws-"][data-testid$="qa-f04-repo"] >> testid=conversation-card'` (`0`). Click again: `true` and the cards return.
expected: a folder heading collapses and expands that folder.

scenarios.name: F04--collapse-all
scenarios.title: Collapse all
scenarios.body: Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=conversations-header-toggle'`, `control-openhands browser attr 'testid=conversations-header-toggle' aria-expanded` (`false`) and `control-openhands browser count 'testid=conversation-panel-list-scroll >> testid=conversation-card'` (`0`). Click again: `true` and every card is back.
scenarios.raw: **Collapse all (`F04.collapse-all`).** Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=conversations-header-toggle'`, `control-openhands browser attr 'testid=conversations-header-toggle' aria-expanded` (`false`) and `control-openhands browser count 'testid=conversation-panel-list-scroll >> testid=conversation-card'` (`0`). Click again: `true` and every card is back.
expected: the Conversations header collapses every folder, then expands them all.

scenarios.name: F04--new-conversation-in-a-folder
scenarios.title: New conversation in a folder
scenarios.body: Run `control-openhands browser goto /`, then `control-openhands browser click 'role=button[name="Start new conversation in qa-f04-folder"]' --expect-url '/conversations/'` (returns the new `/conversations/<id>`), then `control-openhands browser count '[data-testid^="thread-folder-ws-"][data-testid$="qa-f04-folder"] >> testid=conversation-card'`; it grows by one. Repeating `browser goto /` plus the click for `qa-f04-repo` 18 times arranges the data for the next two bullets.
scenarios.raw: **New conversation in a folder (`F04.folder-new-conversation`).** Run `control-openhands browser goto /`, then `control-openhands browser click 'role=button[name="Start new conversation in qa-f04-folder"]' --expect-url '/conversations/'` (returns the new `/conversations/<id>`), then `control-openhands browser count '[data-testid^="thread-folder-ws-"][data-testid$="qa-f04-folder"] >> testid=conversation-card'`; it grows by one. Repeating `browser goto /` plus the click for `qa-f04-repo` 18 times arranges the data for the next two bullets.
expected: a folder's `+` starts a conversation in that workspace and opens it.

scenarios.name: F04--folder-preview
scenarios.title: Folder preview
scenarios.body: With more than five conversations in `qa-f04-repo`, `control-openhands browser count '[data-testid^="thread-folder-ws-"][data-testid$="qa-f04-repo"] >> testid=conversation-card'` is `5` and `control-openhands browser text '[data-testid^="thread-folder-view-more-ws-"][data-testid$="qa-f04-repo"]'` is `More`. Click that button: every loaded row shows and the label is `Less`; click again: `5`.
scenarios.raw: **Folder preview (`F04.folder-preview-more`).** With more than five conversations in `qa-f04-repo`, `control-openhands browser count '[data-testid^="thread-folder-ws-"][data-testid$="qa-f04-repo"] >> testid=conversation-card'` is `5` and `control-openhands browser text '[data-testid^="thread-folder-view-more-ws-"][data-testid$="qa-f04-repo"]'` is `More`. Click that button: every loaded row shows and the label is `Less`; click again: `5`.
expected: a folder shows five rows; More shows every loaded row, Less returns to five.

scenarios.name: F04--reorder-folders
scenarios.title: Reorder folders
scenarios.body: In By workspace mode read the order with `control-openhands browser eval "[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid^=thread-folder-drag-]')].map(e=>e.textContent.trim())"`, then run `control-openhands browser drag '[data-testid^="thread-folder-drag-ws-"][data-testid$="qa-f04-folder"]' '[data-testid^="thread-folder-drag-ws-"][data-testid$="qa-f04-repo"]' --position before`. The same eval now starts with `qa-f04-folder`, `qa-f04-repo`, also after `browser reload`, and `control-openhands browser eval "JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('conversation-panel-preferences')).state.groupFolderOrder"` lists the `ws:<path>` keys in that order.
scenarios.raw: **Reorder folders (`F04.folder-reorder`).** In By workspace mode read the order with `control-openhands browser eval "[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid^=thread-folder-drag-]')].map(e=>e.textContent.trim())"`, then run `control-openhands browser drag '[data-testid^="thread-folder-drag-ws-"][data-testid$="qa-f04-folder"]' '[data-testid^="thread-folder-drag-ws-"][data-testid$="qa-f04-repo"]' --position before`. The same eval now starts with `qa-f04-folder`, `qa-f04-repo`, also after `browser reload`, and `control-openhands browser eval "JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('conversation-panel-preferences')).state.groupFolderOrder"` lists the `ws:<path>` keys in that order.
expected: dragging a folder heading onto another reorders the folders and the order persists.

scenarios.name: F04--load-more
scenarios.title: Load more
scenarios.body: In By date mode (More options → `testid=organize-chronological`, or the Recent preset) with 22 or more conversations, `control-openhands browser count 'testid=conversation-panel-list-scroll >> testid=conversation-card'` is `20`. Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=load-more-conversations'` and `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=load-more-conversations' --state detached --timeout 15000`; the count is the total (`23` with 23 conversations). In By workspace mode (`organize-grouped`, then `browser reload`) the same click adds the later rows to their own folders: with the oldest rows in No workspace and none of them loaded, `testid=thread-folder-__none_workspace` appears only after the click and `browser count 'testid=conversation-card'` grows by the number of unloaded No workspace rows (6 → 9 with three such rows, 5 → 7 with two). A folder that already shows five rows keeps the extra ones behind its More.
scenarios.raw: **Load more (`F04.load-more`).** In By date mode (More options → `testid=organize-chronological`, or the Recent preset) with 22 or more conversations, `control-openhands browser count 'testid=conversation-panel-list-scroll >> testid=conversation-card'` is `20`. Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=load-more-conversations'` and `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=load-more-conversations' --state detached --timeout 15000`; the count is the total (`23` with 23 conversations). In By workspace mode (`organize-grouped`, then `browser reload`) the same click adds the later rows to their own folders: with the oldest rows in No workspace and none of them loaded, `testid=thread-folder-__none_workspace` appears only after the click and `browser count 'testid=conversation-card'` grows by the number of unloaded No workspace rows (6 → 9 with three such rows, 5 → 7 with two). A folder that already shows five rows keeps the extra ones behind its More.
expected: 20 conversations load first; Load more fetches the rest and disappears when nothing is left.

scenarios.name: F04--organize
scenarios.title: Organize
scenarios.body: Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=conversation-layouts-toggle'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=advanced-options-row'`, `control-openhands browser snapshot 'testid=advanced-conversation-options-modal'` (sections Organize, Sort by, Threads, Additional, Automations, Metadata), `control-openhands browser click 'testid=organize-chronological'` (`browser attr 'testid=organize-chronological' aria-checked` is `true`), `control-openhands browser click 'testid=advanced-options-close'`, `control-openhands browser reload`, then `control-openhands browser count '[data-testid^=thread-folder-ws-]'`. The count is `0` and the rows form one list; `organize-grouped` brings the folders back.
scenarios.raw: **Organize (`F04.organize`).** Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=conversation-layouts-toggle'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=advanced-options-row'`, `control-openhands browser snapshot 'testid=advanced-conversation-options-modal'` (sections Organize, Sort by, Threads, Additional, Automations, Metadata), `control-openhands browser click 'testid=organize-chronological'` (`browser attr 'testid=organize-chronological' aria-checked` is `true`), `control-openhands browser click 'testid=advanced-options-close'`, `control-openhands browser reload`, then `control-openhands browser count '[data-testid^=thread-folder-ws-]'`. The count is `0` and the rows form one list; `organize-grouped` brings the folders back.
expected: More options → Organize switches between folders (By workspace) and a flat list (By date); the choice survives a reload.

scenarios.name: F04--header-divider
scenarios.title: Header divider
scenarios.body: With more rows than fit (By date mode with 20 loaded rows, as Organize leaves it; By workspace mode previews too few rows to scroll), `control-openhands browser eval "document.querySelector('[data-testid=older-conversations-summary]').parentElement.classList.contains('border-border')"` is `false`; after `control-openhands browser scroll 'testid=conversation-panel-list-scroll' --by 300` it is `true`, and `false` again after `--by -300`.
scenarios.raw: **Header divider (`F04.list-header`).** With more rows than fit (By date mode with 20 loaded rows, as Organize leaves it; By workspace mode previews too few rows to scroll), `control-openhands browser eval "document.querySelector('[data-testid=older-conversations-summary]').parentElement.classList.contains('border-border')"` is `false`; after `control-openhands browser scroll 'testid=conversation-panel-list-scroll' --by 300` it is `true`, and `false` again after `--by -300`.
expected: the header divider appears only while the list is scrolled.

scenarios.name: F04--rename
scenarios.title: Rename
scenarios.body: Pick the oldest untitled conversation (`b8d99...` from the picker step; the sort check below needs an old one). It is beyond the first 20 rows after a reload, so first run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=load-more-conversations'` and `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=load-more-conversations' --state detached --timeout 15000`. Then run `control-openhands browser scroll 'testid=conversation-card >> has-text=Conversation <id5>'` (the first five characters of its id), `control-openhands browser hover 'testid=conversation-card >> has-text=Conversation <id5>'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=conversation-card >> has-text=Conversation <id5> >> testid=ellipsis-button'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=context-menu >> testid=edit-button'`, `control-openhands browser fill 'input[data-testid=conversation-card-title]' 'QA_F04 renamed'`, `control-openhands browser press Enter`, then `control-openhands browser toasts` (`Conversation title updated successfully`), `control-openhands browser reload` and `control-openhands browser count 'testid=conversation-card-title >> has-text=QA_F04 renamed'` (`1`).
scenarios.raw: **Rename (`F04.card-rename`).** Pick the oldest untitled conversation (`b8d99...` from the picker step; the sort check below needs an old one). It is beyond the first 20 rows after a reload, so first run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=load-more-conversations'` and `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=load-more-conversations' --state detached --timeout 15000`. Then run `control-openhands browser scroll 'testid=conversation-card >> has-text=Conversation <id5>'` (the first five characters of its id), `control-openhands browser hover 'testid=conversation-card >> has-text=Conversation <id5>'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=conversation-card >> has-text=Conversation <id5> >> testid=ellipsis-button'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=context-menu >> testid=edit-button'`, `control-openhands browser fill 'input[data-testid=conversation-card-title]' 'QA_F04 renamed'`, `control-openhands browser press Enter`, then `control-openhands browser toasts` (`Conversation title updated successfully`), `control-openhands browser reload` and `control-openhands browser count 'testid=conversation-card-title >> has-text=QA_F04 renamed'` (`1`).
expected: ⋮ → Rename edits the title inline; Enter saves, a toast confirms, and the title persists.

scenarios.name: F04--sort
scenarios.title: Sort
scenarios.body: Under Sort by Updated (default) the just-renamed old conversation is first. Sorting applies to the loaded rows only: after a reload the first page is the 20 most recently updated. In More options run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=sort-created'` and `control-openhands browser click 'testid=advanced-options-close'`; `control-openhands browser eval "[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=conversation-panel-list-scroll] [data-testid=conversation-card-title]')].map(e=>e.textContent)"` now ends with `QA_F04 renamed` (with every page loaded, the older `pong` row comes after it), and the View menu row reads `More options · Custom`. Restore with `testid=layout-preset-recent-activity`.
scenarios.raw: **Sort (`F04.sort`).** Under Sort by Updated (default) the just-renamed old conversation is first. Sorting applies to the loaded rows only: after a reload the first page is the 20 most recently updated. In More options run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=sort-created'` and `control-openhands browser click 'testid=advanced-options-close'`; `control-openhands browser eval "[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=conversation-panel-list-scroll] [data-testid=conversation-card-title]')].map(e=>e.textContent)"` now ends with `QA_F04 renamed` (with every page loaded, the older `pong` row comes after it), and the View menu row reads `More options · Custom`. Restore with `testid=layout-preset-recent-activity`.
expected: Sort by Updated or Created reorders the list.

scenarios.name: F04--stop
scenarios.title: Stop
scenarios.body: On an idle row open ⋮ and run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=context-menu >> testid=stop-button'`; `control-openhands browser snapshot 'role=dialog'` reads `Confirm Stop Conversation`, `Are you sure you want to stop this conversation?`, and `control-openhands browser testids 'role=dialog'` lists `cancel-button` (`Cancel`) and `confirm-button` (`Confirm Close`). `control-openhands browser click 'role=dialog >> testid=cancel-button'` keeps it idle (`control-openhands conversation status <id>`). Repeat and click `'role=dialog >> testid=confirm-button'`; `control-openhands conversation wait <id> --until paused --timeout 30` reaches `paused`, `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=conversation-card >> has-text=Conversation <id5> >> testid=conversation-status-paused'` succeeds, and the reopened ⋮ menu has no Stop item. `control-openhands browser press Escape` closes it (`browser count 'testid=context-menu'` is `0`) and puts focus back on the row's ⋮ (`control-openhands browser eval "document.activeElement.dataset.testid"` is `ellipsis-button`).
scenarios.raw: **Stop (`F04.stop`).** On an idle row open ⋮ and run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=context-menu >> testid=stop-button'`; `control-openhands browser snapshot 'role=dialog'` reads `Confirm Stop Conversation`, `Are you sure you want to stop this conversation?`, and `control-openhands browser testids 'role=dialog'` lists `cancel-button` (`Cancel`) and `confirm-button` (`Confirm Close`). `control-openhands browser click 'role=dialog >> testid=cancel-button'` keeps it idle (`control-openhands conversation status <id>`). Repeat and click `'role=dialog >> testid=confirm-button'`; `control-openhands conversation wait <id> --until paused --timeout 30` reaches `paused`, `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=conversation-card >> has-text=Conversation <id5> >> testid=conversation-status-paused'` succeeds, and the reopened ⋮ menu has no Stop item. `control-openhands browser press Escape` closes it (`browser count 'testid=context-menu'` is `0`) and puts focus back on the row's ⋮ (`control-openhands browser eval "document.activeElement.dataset.testid"` is `ellipsis-button`).
expected: ⋮ → Stop Conversation asks for confirmation and pauses the conversation; the item is gone once paused.

scenarios.name: F04--presets
scenarios.title: Presets
scenarios.body: Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=conversation-layouts-toggle'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=layout-preset-recent-activity'`, `control-openhands browser reload`, reopen the menu, then `control-openhands browser attr 'testid=layout-preset-recent-activity' aria-checked` (`true`) and `control-openhands browser text 'testid=advanced-options-row'` (`More options`). With the paused conversation from Stop (above), `testid=layout-preset-focused` (Active) and `testid=layout-preset-minimal` (Compact) make `control-openhands browser count 'testid=conversation-card >> has-text=Conversation <id5>'` `0`; Recent shows it again.
scenarios.raw: **Presets (`F04.presets`).** Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=conversation-layouts-toggle'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=layout-preset-recent-activity'`, `control-openhands browser reload`, reopen the menu, then `control-openhands browser attr 'testid=layout-preset-recent-activity' aria-checked` (`true`) and `control-openhands browser text 'testid=advanced-options-row'` (`More options`). With the paused conversation from Stop (above), `testid=layout-preset-focused` (Active) and `testid=layout-preset-minimal` (Compact) make `control-openhands browser count 'testid=conversation-card >> has-text=Conversation <id5>'` `0`; Recent shows it again.
expected: a preset is checked and survives a reload; Active and Compact hide paused conversations; any manual change reads `More options · Custom`.

scenarios.name: F04--threads-scope
scenarios.title: Threads scope
scenarios.body: With the paused conversation from Stop and the Recent preset, open More options and run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=scope-relevant'` (`browser attr 'testid=scope-relevant' aria-checked` is `true`) and `control-openhands browser click 'testid=advanced-options-close'`: `control-openhands browser count 'testid=conversation-card >> has-text=Conversation <id5>'` is `0`, also after `browser reload`, and the View menu now checks no preset and reads `More options · Custom` (Recent shows old conversations; the Active preset also hides them). `testid=scope-all` brings the row back (`1`) and Recent is checked again.
scenarios.raw: **Threads scope (`F04.thread-scope`).** With the paused conversation from Stop and the Recent preset, open More options and run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=scope-relevant'` (`browser attr 'testid=scope-relevant' aria-checked` is `true`) and `control-openhands browser click 'testid=advanced-options-close'`: `control-openhands browser count 'testid=conversation-card >> has-text=Conversation <id5>'` is `0`, also after `browser reload`, and the View menu now checks no preset and reads `More options · Custom` (Recent shows old conversations; the Active preset also hides them). `testid=scope-all` brings the row back (`1`) and Recent is checked again.
expected: More options → Threads → Active only hides paused conversations; All threads shows them again.

scenarios.name: F04--hide-older
scenarios.title: Hide older
scenarios.body: In More options, `control-openhands browser attr 'testid=toggle-older-conversations' aria-checked` is `false` (Recent shows conversations of every age) and `control-openhands browser text 'testid=older-conversation-cutoff'` is `Over 1 week`. Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=older-conversation-cutoff'` (radios Over 1 hour, Over 1 day, Over 1 week, Over 30 days), `control-openhands browser click 'role=menuitemradio[name="Over 1 hour"]'`, then `control-openhands browser click 'testid=toggle-older-conversations >> text=Hide old conversations'` (`aria-checked` turns `true`; a click on the row's center lands on the cutoff dropdown instead), `control-openhands browser click 'testid=advanced-options-close'`, `control-openhands browser reload`, then `control-openhands browser storage --values`: `conversation-panel-preferences` holds `"showOlderConversations":false` and `"olderConversationCutoff":"1h"`, and the View menu reads `More options · Custom`. Restore with `testid=layout-preset-recent-activity` (it turns hiding off but keeps the cutoff) and the cutoff `Over 1 week`. Hiding itself needs a conversation last updated before the cutoff (not reachable on a fresh run).
scenarios.raw: **Hide older (`F04.hide-older`).** In More options, `control-openhands browser attr 'testid=toggle-older-conversations' aria-checked` is `false` (Recent shows conversations of every age) and `control-openhands browser text 'testid=older-conversation-cutoff'` is `Over 1 week`. Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=older-conversation-cutoff'` (radios Over 1 hour, Over 1 day, Over 1 week, Over 30 days), `control-openhands browser click 'role=menuitemradio[name="Over 1 hour"]'`, then `control-openhands browser click 'testid=toggle-older-conversations >> text=Hide old conversations'` (`aria-checked` turns `true`; a click on the row's center lands on the cutoff dropdown instead), `control-openhands browser click 'testid=advanced-options-close'`, `control-openhands browser reload`, then `control-openhands browser storage --values`: `conversation-panel-preferences` holds `"showOlderConversations":false` and `"olderConversationCutoff":"1h"`, and the View menu reads `More options · Custom`. Restore with `testid=layout-preset-recent-activity` (it turns hiding off but keeps the cutoff) and the cutoff `Over 1 week`. Hiding itself needs a conversation last updated before the cutoff (not reachable on a fresh run).
expected: Hide old conversations offers four cutoffs, persists the choice and hides conversations older than it.

scenarios.name: F04--automation-filter
scenarios.title: Automation filter
scenarios.body: In More options run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=automation-filter-only'` and `control-openhands browser click 'testid=advanced-options-close'`; with no automation runs `control-openhands browser text 'testid=conversation-panel-empty-state'` is `No conversations match the automation filter` (Load more stays). `testid=automation-filter-hide` keeps every manual conversation; `testid=automation-filter-all` restores the default. Unpin everything first: a pinned row suppresses the empty state.
scenarios.raw: **Automation filter (`F04.automation-filter`).** In More options run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=automation-filter-only'` and `control-openhands browser click 'testid=advanced-options-close'`; with no automation runs `control-openhands browser text 'testid=conversation-panel-empty-state'` is `No conversations match the automation filter` (Load more stays). `testid=automation-filter-hide` keeps every manual conversation; `testid=automation-filter-all` restores the default. Unpin everything first: a pinned row suppresses the empty state.
expected: More options → Automations shows all, hides or keeps only automation runs, with its own empty message.

scenarios.name: F04--row-metadata
scenarios.title: Row metadata
scenarios.body: In More options click `testid=toggle-repo-branch-metadata`, `testid=toggle-llm-profiles` and `testid=toggle-tags-metadata`, then `testid=advanced-options-close`. `control-openhands browser testids 'testid=conversation-card >> has-text=Conversation <id5>'` lists `conversation-card-workspace-folder` (`qa-f04-repo`) and `conversation-card-agent-chip` (`deepseek-flash`) and no `conversation-card-tag-chip`. Restore with `testid=layout-preset-recent-activity` (presets reset all metadata toggles).
scenarios.raw: **Row metadata (`F04.metadata-toggles`).** In More options click `testid=toggle-repo-branch-metadata`, `testid=toggle-llm-profiles` and `testid=toggle-tags-metadata`, then `testid=advanced-options-close`. `control-openhands browser testids 'testid=conversation-card >> has-text=Conversation <id5>'` lists `conversation-card-workspace-folder` (`qa-f04-repo`) and `conversation-card-agent-chip` (`deepseek-flash`) and no `conversation-card-tag-chip`. Restore with `testid=layout-preset-recent-activity` (presets reset all metadata toggles).
expected: Repo and branch, Agent / model and Show tags add or remove row chips.

scenarios.name: F04--hover-preview
scenarios.title: Hover preview
scenarios.body: Run `control-openhands browser mouse-click 900 900`, then `control-openhands browser tooltip 'testid=conversation-card >> has-text=Conversation <id5>'`. The text is the title, `Directory` with the workspace path, `Model` `deepseek/deepseek-flash` and `Created` with a date. After `testid=toggle-hover-metadata` is off (`aria-checked` `false`), `control-openhands browser tooltip ... --timeout 5000` finds no tooltip.
scenarios.raw: **Hover preview (`F04.hover-preview`).** Run `control-openhands browser mouse-click 900 900`, then `control-openhands browser tooltip 'testid=conversation-card >> has-text=Conversation <id5>'`. The text is the title, `Directory` with the workspace path, `Model` `deepseek/deepseek-flash` and `Created` with a date. After `testid=toggle-hover-metadata` is off (`aria-checked` `false`), `control-openhands browser tooltip ... --timeout 5000` finds no tooltip.
expected: hovering a row for a second shows title, directory, model and creation time, unless Details on hover is off.

scenarios.name: F04--pin
scenarios.title: Pin
scenarios.body: Run `control-openhands browser hover 'testid=conversation-card >> has-text=QA_F04 renamed'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=conversation-card >> has-text=QA_F04 renamed >> [data-testid^=conversation-pin-toggle-]'`, then `control-openhands browser text 'testid=conversation-panel-pinned-section'` (`Pinned` and the row), `control-openhands browser count 'testid=conversation-card >> has-text=QA_F04 renamed'` (`1`: not duplicated) and, after `browser reload`, `control-openhands browser attr 'testid=conversation-panel-pinned-section >> [data-testid^=conversation-pin-toggle-]' aria-pressed` (`true`). Unpin with `browser hover` and `browser click` on `testid=conversation-panel-pinned-section >> testid=conversation-card` and its `[data-testid^=conversation-pin-toggle-]`; after a reload `browser count 'testid=conversation-panel-pinned-section'` is `0`.
scenarios.raw: **Pin (`F04.pin`).** Run `control-openhands browser hover 'testid=conversation-card >> has-text=QA_F04 renamed'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=conversation-card >> has-text=QA_F04 renamed >> [data-testid^=conversation-pin-toggle-]'`, then `control-openhands browser text 'testid=conversation-panel-pinned-section'` (`Pinned` and the row), `control-openhands browser count 'testid=conversation-card >> has-text=QA_F04 renamed'` (`1`: not duplicated) and, after `browser reload`, `control-openhands browser attr 'testid=conversation-panel-pinned-section >> [data-testid^=conversation-pin-toggle-]' aria-pressed` (`true`). Unpin with `browser hover` and `browser click` on `testid=conversation-panel-pinned-section >> testid=conversation-card` and its `[data-testid^=conversation-pin-toggle-]`; after a reload `browser count 'testid=conversation-panel-pinned-section'` is `0`.

scenarios.name: F04--edit-tags
scenarios.title: Edit tags
scenarios.body: Open ⋮ on a row (hover, `testid=ellipsis-button`) and run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=context-menu >> testid=edit-tags-button'`. scenarios.name: F04--tag-overflow

After `browser reload` the row shows `Qabare` and `Qaenv: one` plus `control-openhands browser text 'testid=conversation-card >> has-text=Conversation <id5> >> testid=conversation-card-tag-overflow'` `+3` (aria-label `Show 3 more tags`). scenarios.name: F04--automation-setup-tag

Do not run any tools.' --wait --timeout 180` (one tiny model call; note `<setup-id>`). `control-openhands api GET /api/conversations/<setup-id> --pick tags` has `automationsetup: draft`. In the sidebar, `control-openhands browser text 'testid=conversation-card >> has-text=Reply >> testid=conversation-card-tag-chip'` is `Automation setup: Draft` (the first chip; the internal draft-id keys stay hidden). Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=conversation-layouts-toggle'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=tag-filters-section'`: the facet `testid=tag-facet-row-automationsetup=draft` reads `Automation setup: Draft`; click it, `control-openhands browser press Escape`, and `control-openhands browser text 'testid=conversation-active-tag-filters'` is `Automation setup: Draft` and `Clear all`, with only setup conversations (and pinned rows) left; `control-openhands browser click 'testid=active-tag-filter-automationsetup=draft'` removes it. After `control-openhands browser mouse-click 900 900`, `control-openhands browser tooltip 'testid=conversation-card >> has-text=Reply'` lists `Automation setup` and the raw value `draft` (`browser screenshot --feature F04.automation-setup-tag --name facet`). End with `control-openhands browser goto /`; the setup send leaves no Home draft, and opening another conversation from the sidebar leaves that conversation's tags alone (see Gotchas).

scenarios.name: F04--download

A file `…-conversation_<id>.zip` lands in `<run>/private/downloads`; `control-openhands browser downloads --last 1 --inspect` lists `<id-hex>/base_state.json` and `meta.json` for any row, plus event folders such as `bash_events/` for a conversation that ran (the `pong` row; it is the oldest, so Load more first).

A file `…-conversation_<id>.zip` lands in `<run>/private/downloads`; `control-openhands browser downloads --last 1 --inspect` lists `<id-hex>/base_state.json` and `meta.json` for any row, plus event folders such as `bash_events/` for a conversation that ran (the `pong` row; it is the oldest, so Load more first).

scenarios.name: F04--download-failure
scenarios.title: Download failure
scenarios.body: With ⋮ already open on a row, run `control-openhands browser errors --clear` and `control-openhands service stop agent-server`, click `testid=context-menu >> testid=download-trajectory-button`, then `control-openhands browser toasts --history` and `control-openhands browser count 'testid=context-menu'`. There is exactly one toast, `Couldn't download the conversation data: An error occurred`, and the menu is closed (`0`). The download request returned a plain-text ingress 502; `getApiErrorMessage` intentionally omits raw transport text and falls back to this generic message when the response body has no usable error field. `control-openhands browser errors --app-only` has `pageErrors` `0`; its 502 request and console error are the outage itself. Run `control-openhands restart` and `control-openhands doctor` afterwards.
scenarios.raw: **Download failure (`F04.download-error`).** With ⋮ already open on a row, run `control-openhands browser errors --clear` and `control-openhands service stop agent-server`, click `testid=context-menu >> testid=download-trajectory-button`, then `control-openhands browser toasts --history` and `control-openhands browser count 'testid=context-menu'`. There is exactly one toast, `Couldn't download the conversation data: An error occurred`, and the menu is closed (`0`). The download request returned a plain-text ingress 502; `getApiErrorMessage` intentionally omits raw transport text and falls back to this generic message when the response body has no usable error field. `control-openhands browser errors --app-only` has `pageErrors` `0`; its 502 request and console error are the outage itself. Run `control-openhands restart` and `control-openhands doctor` afterwards.
expected: a failed download shows one toast and closes the ⋮ menu. When the Agent Server is down behind a plain-text 502 ingress response, the toast uses the generic error fallback rather than raw transport text.

The conversation stays available with its full history and can be restored from Show archived.` `control-openhands browser click 'role=dialog >> testid=cancel-button'` keeps the row. scenarios.name: F04--show-archived-and-unarchive
scenarios.title: Show archived and Unarchive
scenarios.body: In More options click `testid=toggle-show-archived` (`aria-checked` `true`) and `testid=advanced-options-close`; `control-openhands browser count 'testid=conversation-card >> has-text=Conversation <id5> >> testid=conversation-card-archived-chip'` is `1` and the ⋮ menu offers `Unarchive Conversation`. `control-openhands browser click 'testid=context-menu >> testid=unarchive-button'` opens no dialog (`browser count 'role=dialog'` `0`) and the chip count drops to `0`. Turn Show archived off again.
scenarios.raw: **Show archived and Unarchive (`F04.show-archived-unarchive`).** In More options click `testid=toggle-show-archived` (`aria-checked` `true`) and `testid=advanced-options-close`; `control-openhands browser count 'testid=conversation-card >> has-text=Conversation <id5> >> testid=conversation-card-archived-chip'` is `1` and the ⋮ menu offers `Unarchive Conversation`. `control-openhands browser click 'testid=context-menu >> testid=unarchive-button'` opens no dialog (`browser count 'role=dialog'` `0`) and the chip count drops to `0`. Turn Show archived off again.
expected: Show archived brings archived rows back with an `Archived` chip; Unarchive restores a row without confirmation.
notes: Known issue [#18155](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/18155) (`F04.show-archived-unarchive`): Missing-runtime conversations shown as Archived but never hidden, chipped, or unarchivable. Live prerequisite: A Cloud sandbox or local runtime that becomes MISSING and non-resumable; ordinary local pause remains resumable.

scenarios.name: F04--fresh-browser-grouping
scenarios.title: Fresh-browser grouping
scenarios.body: Run this after the other list checks: select By workspace, record its groups, `control-openhands browser reset`, `control-openhands onboard --skip`, then `control-openhands browser click 'testid=conversation-layouts-toggle'` and `control-openhands browser click 'testid=layout-preset-by-workspace'`. Compare `browser snapshot 'testid=conversation-panel'` with `conversation status <id>`. Known failure (reproduced 2026-10-12, [#17386](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/17386)): existing conversations move to No workspace although their server working directory still matches the registered workspace. The reset clears browser metadata; do not use it before checks that depend on the original browser's grouping.
scenarios.raw: **Fresh-browser grouping (`F04.grouped-folders`).** Run this after the other list checks: select By workspace, record its groups, `control-openhands browser reset`, `control-openhands onboard --skip`, then `control-openhands browser click 'testid=conversation-layouts-toggle'` and `control-openhands browser click 'testid=layout-preset-by-workspace'`. Compare `browser snapshot 'testid=conversation-panel'` with `conversation status <id>`. Known failure (reproduced 2026-10-12, [#17386](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/17386)): existing conversations move to No workspace although their server working directory still matches the registered workspace. The reset clears browser metadata; do not use it before checks that depend on the original browser's grouping.
expected: By workspace shows one folder per known workspace (empty ones included) plus a No workspace folder while any loaded row has no workspace, in any browser.
annotations: Known failure (reproduced 2026-10-12, [#17386](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/17386)): existing conversations move to No workspace although their server working directory still matches the registered workspace. The reset clears browser metadata; do not use it before checks that depend on the original browser's grouping.

scenarios.name: F04--delete-all
scenarios.title: Delete all
scenarios.body: Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=conversation-layouts-toggle'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=delete-all-conversations'` and `control-openhands browser snapshot 'role=dialog'`: `Delete all conversations`, `Are you sure you want to delete N conversations?`. Cancel (`role=dialog >> testid=cancel-button`) keeps every row. Confirm with `control-openhands browser click 'role=dialog >> testid=confirm-button'` and `control-openhands browser wait 'role=dialog' --state detached --timeout 30000`; `control-openhands api GET '/api/conversations/search?limit=100'` has no items, Delete all is disabled again, and in By date mode the empty state returns. Expected for every conversation; today N and the deletion cover only the loaded pages (22 conversations, 20 loaded: 2 remain).
scenarios.raw: **Delete all (`F04.delete-all`).** Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=conversation-layouts-toggle'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=delete-all-conversations'` and `control-openhands browser snapshot 'role=dialog'`: `Delete all conversations`, `Are you sure you want to delete N conversations?`. Cancel (`role=dialog >> testid=cancel-button`) keeps every row. Confirm with `control-openhands browser click 'role=dialog >> testid=confirm-button'` and `control-openhands browser wait 'role=dialog' --state detached --timeout 30000`; `control-openhands api GET '/api/conversations/search?limit=100'` has no items, Delete all is disabled again, and in By date mode the empty state returns. Expected for every conversation; today N and the deletion cover only the loaded pages (22 conversations, 20 loaded: 2 remain).
expected: View → Delete all asks for confirmation with a count and deletes every conversation.
notes: Known issue #17919: Delete all deletes only the loaded pages, and its dialog states that smaller count (`F04.delete-all`).

families.title: Composer, slash commands and plan mode
families.overview:
The composer is the input box at the bottom of the home page and of every
conversation. A user types a message (Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line),
attaches files and images, picks the LLM profile for the running conversation,
watches and compacts the context window, stops and resumes the agent, and types
`/` for built-in commands (`/btw`, `/model`, `/goal`, `/plan`, `/code`) and
skills. `/plan` hands the next message to a planning agent whose PLAN.md card
can be viewed and built; Ctrl/Cmd+Enter builds it.
families.entry:
- Home page composer (`/`) and the composer of any conversation (`/conversations/<id>`, reached from the sidebar conversation list or by URL).
- `+` (More actions, `chat-plus-button`) inside the composer opens the tools menu; its last item **Add Files and Images** opens the native file picker (`upload-image-input`).
- Model pill (`chat-input-llm-profile`) next to `+`; at 320 px it moves into the vertical-dots **More input actions** button. On the home page it names the default profile (the one Settings → LLM marks as default); in a conversation it names the profile that conversation runs on.
- Right side of the composer: status text with Stop/Play, context ring (`context-window-meter`), mic (`chat-dictation-button`), Send (`submit-button`).
- Typing `/` at the start of a word opens the slash menu (`slash-command-menu`); `/plan` and `/code` are the only mode switches on the local backend (the Code/Plan pill is Cloud only).
- Keyboard: Enter sends, Shift+Enter newline, Ctrl+Enter / Cmd+Enter builds a plan; Escape closes the slash menu.
families.given:
Preconditions:

- Baseline state (launched, doctored, `onboard --skip` done) and `control-openhands llm preset deepseek` (profiles `deepseek-flash` active and `deepseek-pro`). Every recipe except `F05.agent-profile-switch`, the home draft, `F05.image-only-send` and `F05.profile-identity` needs a model. Without a DeepSeek key, `QA_DUMMY_KEY=qa control-openhands llm set --profile qa-zeta --model openai/gpt-4o --api-key-env QA_DUMMY_KEY --no-validate` stands in for the active profile: conversations can still be created (the agent errors at once), which is all those two bullets need, and every bullet that reads a reply is `blocked`.
- `F05.profile-identity` needs two profiles on one model: its bullet creates `qa-alpha` and `qa-zeta` with `llm set --no-validate` right before it and deletes them afterwards.
- A conversation to type into: `control-openhands conversation start --prompt "Reply with only: ok" --wait --timeout 240` prints `id` (`<id>` below) and leaves the browser on `/conversations/<id>`.
- Attachment fixtures: `control-openhands fixture image --name qa-image` and `control-openhands fixture file --name qa-note.txt --content "QA attachment 7731"` (both land in `$OH_VERIFY_RUN/evidence/_fixtures/`).
- Desktop viewport unless a bullet says otherwise. Microphone dictation is blocked in the sandbox browser (no microphone); `+` > Git tools needs a conversation on a git workspace (not driven here).
families.gotchas:
- Always export your own `OH_VERIFY_RUN`. `launch --new` repoints the shared `current` symlink, and another agent relying on `current` drove and then stopped this family's stack mid-run. If the URL jumps to a page you never opened or `fetch failed` appears, run `control-openhands status` before blaming the product.
- `conversation wait <id>` right after sending returns at once with the previous `finished` status. Use `conversation wait <id> --fresh`; `--until running` then a terminal wait only works for turns longer than the poll interval (a `Reply with only` turn on deepseek-flash can finish first, and `--until running` then times out).
- The slash menu stays open while you type a command; press Escape before Enter or Enter selects the highlighted option instead of sending.
- Conversation drafts are saved 500 ms after the last keystroke and flushed on navigation and unmount, so text typed just before leaving comes back.
- Escape closes the `+` tools menu (`browser count 'testid=tools-context-menu'` is `0`) and returns focus to `chat-plus-button`, whether focus was on the trigger or on a menu item. A menu left open covers attachments in screenshots. Escape also closes the narrow-width "More input actions" overflow menu (`browser count 'testid=chat-input-overflow-menu'` is `0`, the trigger's `aria-expanded` is `false`) and returns focus to the trigger, whether focus was on the trigger, on `overflow-model-button` or on a profile row of the open Model submenu (#18174).
- After a client-side switch between conversations (a sidebar row, or a user-message branch in `F06.branch-from-here`) Send keeps the previous conversation's state (Known failure, [#18202](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/18202); [draft fix PR #18203](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/18203)). Switching from an empty composer to one with a saved draft restores the text next to a disabled Send; this is a race (Send came up enabled in 1 of 7 tries), so one enabled reading does not show the bug is gone. Switching from a composer with text to an empty one leaves Send enabled, and clicking it does nothing. Typing or `browser reload` fixes it, and Enter in the field sends the restored text anyway. Read `browser enabled 'testid=submit-button'` after a reload, or after typing.
- Expected: a prompt that a suggestion chip (`testid=chat-suggestions`) or a `+` > **Macros** item writes into the composer enables Send at once. Known failure (reproduced 2026-10-09, [#18202](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/18202)): on a new No workspace conversation, `browser click 'testid=chat-suggestions >> text=Fix README'` (or `browser click 'testid=chat-plus-button'`, `browser hover 'testid=macros-button'`, `browser click 'testid=fix-readme-button'`) fills the field, but `browser enabled 'testid=submit-button'` is `false` (5 of 5 tries at desktop; a race at phone) until a character is typed. Both paths call `setMessageToSend`, which writes the text without an input event.
- Uploaded chips and thumbnails have no test ids. Their remove buttons are named `Remove <file name>` (file chip) and `Remove image` (thumbnail), and Send, Stop and Play read `Send message`, `Stop` and `Resume the agent task` (#18033); select by those names, or by text/alt.
- `browser upload` feeds the hidden input directly. To drive the real path, `+` > Add Files and Images, use `control-openhands browser upload-via 'testid=add-files-and-images-button' <file>`, which answers the native file chooser.
- The home composer has no `interactive-chat-box` wrapper: scope its chips and thumbnails with `testid=home-chat-launcher`.
- `conversation events` rows show a message's text and its attachment count (`images: 1` for the image-only message, whose text is a blank); `--grep 'data:image/png;base64'` searches whole events and quotes the `image` content block in `excerpts`.
- A user row with `images: 1` proves that the image reached the Agent Server, not the model. Only the reply proves that the model saw it. On agent-server 1.53.0 and older, `deepseek/*` profiles drop the image before the LLM call (`F05.image-only-send`). An image sent with no text then leaves deepseek-flash with an empty task. On 2026-10-08 it ran `env`, read the run directory and other files on the host, and decoded the picture from the event store with PIL to answer. Pause such a conversation (`control-openhands conversation pause <id>`), and use the question-plus-image send for the model check.
- The pill resolves the conversation's stamped profile before the user-level default, so profiles that share a model are told apart by name. The stamp lives in this browser's localStorage (`openhands-agent-server-conversation-metadata`), not on the server (`api GET /api/conversations/<id>` has no profile name): read it with `browser eval`, not `api GET`.
- The `Switched to profile` notes are client-side and gone after reload; assert the pill and `conversation status`.
- `/plan` messages go to a separate planner conversation; the browser stays on the parent `/conversations/<id>`, so wait on the planner id from `conversation list`.
- Only the newest goal status offers `Resume` (#18036): once a resumed goal has posted a newer status, the old `interrupted` row shows no button, also after a reload. Count `testid=goal-resume` after the resumed goal ends; while it runs the count is `0` anyway.
- Opening the context popover logs a 404 for `/api/llm/balance` on the local backend in `browser errors --app-only`; it does not break the popover.
- `--observe` takes the verbs' selector syntax: `testid=` and plain CSS segments are watched by an in-page MutationObserver (`observedBy` `mutation`), while `role=`, `text=` and other engines are polled every 20 ms (`poll-20ms`), which misses a state shorter than that; prefer a `testid=` or CSS form for anything brief.
- At `narrow` (320 px) the overflow menu's Model submenu opens to the right of the menu and runs off screen: each profile row starts at x about 270 with width 210 (`browser bbox 'testid=chat-input-llm-profile-option-deepseek-flash'`, `insideViewport` `false`), so both names read `deepse…`. Pick profiles by test id: the click lands on the strip of about 50 px that stays on screen. Known issue: #18063 (filed from the follow-up noted in #18015; the submenu also runs past the bottom edge, so the LLM Profiles link cannot be clicked at `narrow`) (`F05.overflow-menu`).
- Known issue [#17788](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/17788) (`F05.attach-files`): Cloud attachment upload rejects valid runtime data when cached fields are empty strings. Live prerequisite: A Cloud sandbox whose cached runtime URL/key are blank while the fresh runtime lookup is already ready.
- Known issue [#17621](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/17621) (`F05.context-window-meter`): Compact context always fails after exactly 60s — client-side timeout aborts a condensation the server then completes. Live prerequisite: A real summarizing model and conversation whose condensation takes longer than 60 seconds.
- Known issue [#17476](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/17476) (`F05.context-window-meter`): Planning socket stats overwrite the main conversation's context meter. Live prerequisite: A real planning sub-conversation and main conversation with distinct nonzero usage stats.
- Known issue [#17429](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/17429) (`F05.slash-btw`): 500 error with /btw. Live prerequisite: The exact pending tool/streaming state that triggers the generator-pickle error, plus a working model for the side question.
- Known issue [#17271](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/17271) (`F05.context-window-meter`): New chat retains context/state from the previous conversation. Live prerequisite: A completed conversation with nonzero token usage before New Chat; a dummy-key run supplies no genuine context usage.
- Known issue [#17263](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/17263) (`F05.context-window-meter`): Context meter stays pinned after a successful compaction once the condenser has its own usage entry. Live prerequisite: A real successful compaction whose condenser usage remains larger than the default agent usage.
- Known issue [#16851](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/16851) (`F05.profile-identity`): wrong model is displayed when loading existing conversation. Live prerequisite: The original conversation/model-switch history and usage record showing Opus with a Fable selector; a dummy-key conversation has no usage evidence.
- Known issue [#16835](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/16835) (`F05.context-window-meter`): Agent Canvas sidebar shows "Cache Hit: 0" while backend correctly records nonzero cache_read_tokens. Live prerequisite: A working prompt-caching model/proxy and a real conversation reporting nonzero cache_read_tokens.
- Known issue [#16430](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/16430) (`F05.attach-files`): File upload does not have an indication of progress. Live prerequisite: A remote or throttled real upload that stays in flight long enough to inspect progress and composer state.
- Known issue [#16339](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/16339) (`F05.attach-files`): Agent not informed of file location for files uploaded via canvas in cloud. Live prerequisite: An authenticated Cloud upload sandbox and working model to inspect the delivered filename/path notification and read the uploaded file.
- Known issue [#15782](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/15782) (`F05.draft-persistence`): Prompt disappears when a conversation is stopped. Live prerequisite: Clarify whether prompt means unsent composer text or the already-sent history message, and capture that state before sidebar Stop.
- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5639](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5639) (`F05.llm-profile-picker`): A profile switched before the first message can be absent from token/cost statistics after its successful turn. Live prerequisite: A working model, a profile switch before the first run, and nonzero usage/cost after that turn.
- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5627](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5627) (`F05.slash-goal`): After backend restart the goal chip can remain Running while the conversation is paused, and Stop does not clear it. Live prerequisite: A working model goal loop active during graceful backend restart, then goal-status and resume readback.
- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5523](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5523) (`F05.image-only-send`): DeepSeek V4.1 Flash images can be sent to another fallback profile because its vision capability is not detected. Live prerequisite: A working DeepSeek V4.1 Flash vision profile and another fallback profile, with an image-bearing turn.
- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5492](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5492) (`F05.slash-goal`): A goal can stop as Complete when its judge replies with complete as the string false. Live prerequisite: A real goal judge response containing complete as the string false rather than a JSON boolean.
- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5330](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5330) (`F05.slash-btw`): A /btw side question can prevent reuse of the normal conversation prompt cache. Live prerequisite: A working caching provider and comparable ordinary-message versus /btw prompt/cache records.
- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#4498](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/4498) (`F05.context-window-meter`): Compaction can leave an orphaned tool call/result in the live history and make the next provider request fail. Live prerequisite: A real condensation splitting an action/result pair, followed by the next provider request.
- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#4382](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/4382) (`F05.context-window-meter`): ACP cost can miss cache/thought usage, silently become zero, or inflate after stalled/reset cost updates. Live prerequisite: An authenticated ACP provider emitting cache/thought token usage or reset/stalled cumulative cost updates.

- Known issue [#17239](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/17239) (`F05.llm-profile-picker`): The reported model/profile picker can open above the viewport with unreachable rows. A frozen-target Local check with eight LLM profiles passed on Home at 1512x720, 1440x1000, 390x844 and 320x700, and in a genuine conversation at 1512x720 and 390x844: internal scrolling and selecting the first/last profile worked. The Cloud screenshot and real ACP multi-model picker remain unverified; they need an approved Cloud session or ACP account/adapter with a multi-row model catalogue. Local profile geometry is not proof of those branches. Run `backfill-18309-settings-worker`, Agent Server/SDK 1.54.0; evidence includes `F05.llm-profile-picker/17239-conversation-1512x720.png` and `17239-conversation-phone.png`.

- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5824](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5824) (`F05.slash-goal`): resuming after a failed judge audit can show iteration 2 of a maximum of 1 and run beyond the selected goal cap. Live prerequisite: an agent/judge run whose audit fails, followed by a successful incomplete judge verdict after Resume; a controller-only test does not establish the Canvas banner outcome.

- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5889](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5889) (`F05.attach-files`): a same-name attachment upload that fails part-way can replace the previous workspace file with partial content. Live prerequisite: an owned isolated backend with a controlled mid-upload filesystem failure (the original Linux file-size limit or an equivalent bounded child-process limit), a pre-existing target and a real Canvas overwrite. Never change resource limits on a shared runtime; a normal successful upload does not verify failure atomicity.

- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5820](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5820) (`F05.context-window-meter`): manual compaction on a null/no-op condenser can return500. Verification is blocked by genuine populated usage/context metrics: idle and refused-loopback runs leave `usage=null`, so neither composer nor Usage panel offers Compact context. A separate direct endpoint check returned500 but is not a Canvas reproduction. Use an existing real conversation with usage and no condenser, or an authorized successful provider run; never fabricate stats to expose the action.

features.description: Send is disabled while the field is empty; Shift+Enter inserts a newline; Enter sends, clears the field and the message persists after reload.
unsent text is restored per conversation (after navigation and reload) and on the home composer.
the field grows with its content and shrinks when cleared; a top-edge grip lets the user drag the height.
`+` opens a tools menu (Macros, Show skills/hooks/agent tools, Add Files and Images; Git tools in a repository); a macro fills the composer without sending.
before a conversation starts, `+` > Switch agent profile lists agent profiles and links to Manage agent profiles; it is absent in a started conversation.
picked files show as chips and images as thumbnails (with an Upload-as-file toggle), each removable; sent files land in the workspace and are named in the message.
a file over 3 MB, or a selection over 3 MB in total, is refused with an error toast.
an attached image alone, with an empty field, enables Send; the sent user message shows the thumbnail and carries the picture as an embedded data URL.
pasted clipboard text is inserted as plain text; pasted images and dropped files attach.
the mic button dictates into the composer; without a microphone it toasts a failure and resets.
the model pill switches the running conversation's LLM profile; the next reply uses the new model.

the pill names the profile the conversation was started with, also after a reload and when another profile uses the same model; changing the default profile in Settings changes the home pill, not an existing conversation's.

at very narrow widths the model pill collapses into a "More input actions" menu whose Model submenu fits the viewport and switches the profile; Escape closes the menu and returns focus to its trigger.
the ring shows context use; its popover opens the Usage tab and compacts the context.
Stop pauses a running agent (status `Stopped`, Play button); Play resumes it.
a follow-up typed while the agent runs is accepted and answered.
`/` opens a filtered command list (built-ins and skills) with arrow, Tab/Enter and Escape handling.
`/model` lists saved profiles; `/model <name>` switches profile.
`/btw <question>` answers a side question in a dismissible card without adding to the main stream; a bare `/btw` toasts that a question is needed.
`/goal [--max N] <objective>` runs a judged goal loop with a status banner, Stop and Resume; only the newest goal status offers Resume.
`/plan` switches to plan mode (a planner sub-conversation), `/code` switches back.
`/code <task>` switches to code mode and sends `<task>` to the code agent at once; `/plan <task>` switches to plan mode and sends `<task>` to the existing planner.
the planner's Plan.md card shows the plan with Read more, View (Planner tab) and Build.
Ctrl/Cmd+Enter in plan mode builds the plan with the code agent.
the composer fits a 390 px viewport with every control inline.

scenarios.name: F05--type-and-send
scenarios.title: Type and send
scenarios.body: On `/conversations/<id>` run `control-openhands browser attr 'testid=submit-button' aria-label` (`Send message`), `control-openhands browser enabled 'testid=submit-button'` (`false`), `control-openhands browser type 'testid=chat-input' 'Reply with only:'`, `control-openhands browser enabled 'testid=submit-button'` (`true`), `control-openhands browser press Shift+Enter`, `control-openhands browser type 'testid=chat-input' 'ok2'` and `control-openhands browser eval "document.querySelector('[data-testid=chat-input]').innerText"`: `Reply with only:\nok2`. Run `control-openhands browser press Enter --selector 'testid=chat-input'`; the field is empty and `control-openhands browser count 'testid=stop-button'` is `1` while the agent runs. Then `control-openhands conversation wait <id> --fresh --timeout 180` (a fast model can finish before a separate `--until running` wait starts, which then times out on `finished`), `control-openhands browser reload` and `control-openhands browser count 'testid=user-message >> has-text=ok2'`: `1`; `control-openhands browser text 'testid=agent-message >> nth=-1'` is `ok2`.
scenarios.raw: **Type and send (`F05.send-message`).** On `/conversations/<id>` run `control-openhands browser attr 'testid=submit-button' aria-label` (`Send message`), `control-openhands browser enabled 'testid=submit-button'` (`false`), `control-openhands browser type 'testid=chat-input' 'Reply with only:'`, `control-openhands browser enabled 'testid=submit-button'` (`true`), `control-openhands browser press Shift+Enter`, `control-openhands browser type 'testid=chat-input' 'ok2'` and `control-openhands browser eval "document.querySelector('[data-testid=chat-input]').innerText"`: `Reply with only:\nok2`. Run `control-openhands browser press Enter --selector 'testid=chat-input'`; the field is empty and `control-openhands browser count 'testid=stop-button'` is `1` while the agent runs. Then `control-openhands conversation wait <id> --fresh --timeout 180` (a fast model can finish before a separate `--until running` wait starts, which then times out on `finished`), `control-openhands browser reload` and `control-openhands browser count 'testid=user-message >> has-text=ok2'`: `1`; `control-openhands browser text 'testid=agent-message >> nth=-1'` is `ok2`.
expected: Send is disabled while the field is empty; Shift+Enter inserts a newline; Enter sends, clears the field and the message persists after reload.

scenarios.name: F05--draft-survives-navigation
scenarios.title: Draft survives navigation
scenarios.body: Run `control-openhands browser type 'testid=chat-input' 'QA draft text'` and wait out the 500 ms save: `control-openhands browser eval "new Promise(r=>setTimeout(()=>r(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('conversation-state-<id>')).draftMessage),1500))"` returns `QA draft text`. Then `control-openhands browser click 'testid=backend-selector-settings-link' --expect-url settings`, `control-openhands browser back` and the `innerText` eval above: `QA draft text`. `control-openhands browser reload` restores it again. A draft typed just before leaving is flushed, not lost: `control-openhands browser type 'testid=chat-input' ' plus fast'` and at once `control-openhands browser click 'testid=backend-selector-settings-link' --expect-url settings`, `control-openhands browser back`: the eval reads `QA draft text plus fast`. The same holds for an immediate sidebar switch to another conversation and back (that other conversation's composer stays empty). Clear with `control-openhands browser fill 'testid=chat-input' ''` and wait a second before navigating.
scenarios.raw: **Draft survives navigation (`F05.draft-persistence`).** Run `control-openhands browser type 'testid=chat-input' 'QA draft text'` and wait out the 500 ms save: `control-openhands browser eval "new Promise(r=>setTimeout(()=>r(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('conversation-state-<id>')).draftMessage),1500))"` returns `QA draft text`. Then `control-openhands browser click 'testid=backend-selector-settings-link' --expect-url settings`, `control-openhands browser back` and the `innerText` eval above: `QA draft text`. `control-openhands browser reload` restores it again. A draft typed just before leaving is flushed, not lost: `control-openhands browser type 'testid=chat-input' ' plus fast'` and at once `control-openhands browser click 'testid=backend-selector-settings-link' --expect-url settings`, `control-openhands browser back`: the eval reads `QA draft text plus fast`. The same holds for an immediate sidebar switch to another conversation and back (that other conversation's composer stays empty). Clear with `control-openhands browser fill 'testid=chat-input' ''` and wait a second before navigating.
expected: unsent text is restored per conversation (after navigation and reload) and on the home composer.
notes: Known issue [#15782](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/15782) (`F05.draft-persistence`): Prompt disappears when a conversation is stopped. Live prerequisite: Clarify whether prompt means unsent composer text or the already-sent history message, and capture that state before sidebar Stop.

scenarios.name: F05--home-draft
scenarios.title: Home draft
scenarios.body: Run `control-openhands browser goto /`, `control-openhands browser type 'testid=chat-input' 'QA home draft'`, `control-openhands browser goto /settings/secrets`, `control-openhands browser goto /`, then the `innerText` eval: `QA home draft`; `control-openhands browser storage --session` lists `oh:home-prompt-draft`. The automation setup page's docked composer (`/automations/setup`, F22) keeps no draft and never touches the Home one. With `QA home draft` still in the Home composer, run `control-openhands browser goto /automations`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=automations-add-automation'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=automations-add-automation-create' --expect-url '/automations/setup'` and `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=chat-input'`: the `innerText` eval is empty. `control-openhands browser type 'testid=chat-input' 'Reply with only the word ok2. Do not run any tools.'`, then `control-openhands browser eval "new Promise(r=>setTimeout(()=>r(sessionStorage.getItem('oh:home-prompt-draft')),1500))"` still returns `QA home draft`. `control-openhands browser click 'testid=submit-button' --expect-url '/conversations/'` and `control-openhands browser click 'testid=sidebar-conversations-link' --expect-url '/conversations(\?|$)'`: the Home composer shows `QA home draft`. Clear it (`fill 'testid=chat-input' ''`, wait a second) and repeat the setup send: New Chat is empty and `browser storage --session --values` has no `oh:home-prompt-draft`. Unsent text in the setup composer is lost when the user leaves that page (by design).
scenarios.raw: **Home draft (`F05.draft-persistence`).** Run `control-openhands browser goto /`, `control-openhands browser type 'testid=chat-input' 'QA home draft'`, `control-openhands browser goto /settings/secrets`, `control-openhands browser goto /`, then the `innerText` eval: `QA home draft`; `control-openhands browser storage --session` lists `oh:home-prompt-draft`. Do not run any tools.'`, then `control-openhands browser eval "new Promise(r=>setTimeout(()=>r(sessionStorage.getItem('oh:home-prompt-draft')),1500))"` still returns `QA home draft`. `control-openhands browser click 'testid=submit-button' --expect-url '/conversations/'` and `control-openhands browser click 'testid=sidebar-conversations-link' --expect-url '/conversations(\?|$)'`: the Home composer shows `QA home draft`. Clear it (`fill 'testid=chat-input' ''`, wait a second) and repeat the setup send: New Chat is empty and `browser storage --session --values` has no `oh:home-prompt-draft`. Unsent text in the setup composer is lost when the user leaves that page (by design).
expected: unsent text is restored per conversation (after navigation and reload) and on the home composer.

scenarios.name: F05--auto-resize
scenarios.title: Auto-resize
scenarios.body: On `/conversations/<id>` (`control-openhands browser goto /conversations/<id>`; Home draft left `/`) type `line`, then eight times `control-openhands browser press Shift+Enter` and `control-openhands browser type 'testid=chat-input' 'lineN'` (`line2`…`line9`): `control-openhands browser bbox 'testid=chat-input'` grows by 20 px per line, from `height` `20` to `180`; after `control-openhands browser fill 'testid=chat-input' ''` it is `20`. `control-openhands browser count '#resize-grip'` is `1`. `control-openhands browser drag '#resize-grip' --by 0,-200` makes the empty field `220` high and `control-openhands browser drag '#resize-grip' --by 0,150` brings it to `70`; after `control-openhands browser reload` it is `20` again (the dragged height is not kept).
scenarios.raw: **Auto-resize (`F05.composer-resize`).** On `/conversations/<id>` (`control-openhands browser goto /conversations/<id>`; Home draft left `/`) type `line`, then eight times `control-openhands browser press Shift+Enter` and `control-openhands browser type 'testid=chat-input' 'lineN'` (`line2`…`line9`): `control-openhands browser bbox 'testid=chat-input'` grows by 20 px per line, from `height` `20` to `180`; after `control-openhands browser fill 'testid=chat-input' ''` it is `20`. `control-openhands browser count '#resize-grip'` is `1`. `control-openhands browser drag '#resize-grip' --by 0,-200` makes the empty field `220` high and `control-openhands browser drag '#resize-grip' --by 0,150` brings it to `70`; after `control-openhands browser reload` it is `20` again (the dragged height is not kept).
expected: the field grows with its content and shrinks when cleared; a top-edge grip lets the user drag the height.

scenarios.name: F05--tools-menu-and-macros
scenarios.title: Tools menu and macros
scenarios.body: On `/conversations/<id>` run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=chat-plus-button'` and `control-openhands browser testids 'testid=tools-context-menu'`: `macros-button`, `show-skills-button`, `show-hooks-button`, `show-agent-tools-button`, `add-files-and-images-button` (no `git-tools-button` outside a repository). `control-openhands browser hover 'testid=macros-button'` shows `macros-submenu` with `increase-test-coverage-button`, `fix-readme-button`, `auto-merge-prs-button`, `clean-dependencies-button`. `control-openhands browser click 'testid=fix-readme-button'` closes the menu and fills the composer with `Please look at the README and make the following improvements…`; the `testid=user-message` count is unchanged. Clear with `control-openhands browser fill 'testid=chat-input' ''`. Open the menu again and `control-openhands browser press Escape`: `browser count 'testid=tools-context-menu'` is `0` and `control-openhands browser eval "document.activeElement.dataset.testid"` is `chat-plus-button`.
scenarios.raw: **Tools menu and macros (`F05.plus-menu`).** On `/conversations/<id>` run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=chat-plus-button'` and `control-openhands browser testids 'testid=tools-context-menu'`: `macros-button`, `show-skills-button`, `show-hooks-button`, `show-agent-tools-button`, `add-files-and-images-button` (no `git-tools-button` outside a repository). `control-openhands browser hover 'testid=macros-button'` shows `macros-submenu` with `increase-test-coverage-button`, `fix-readme-button`, `auto-merge-prs-button`, `clean-dependencies-button`. `control-openhands browser click 'testid=fix-readme-button'` closes the menu and fills the composer with `Please look at the README and make the following improvements…`; the `testid=user-message` count is unchanged. Clear with `control-openhands browser fill 'testid=chat-input' ''`. Open the menu again and `control-openhands browser press Escape`: `browser count 'testid=tools-context-menu'` is `0` and `control-openhands browser eval "document.activeElement.dataset.testid"` is `chat-plus-button`.
expected: `+` opens a tools menu (Macros, Show skills/hooks/agent tools, Add Files and Images; Git tools in a repository); a macro fills the composer without sending.

scenarios.name: F05--agent-profile-before-start
scenarios.title: Agent profile before start
scenarios.body: Run `control-openhands browser goto /`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=chat-plus-button'`, `control-openhands browser hover 'testid=switch-agent-profile-button'` and `control-openhands browser text 'testid=agent-profile-submenu'`: `AVAILABLE PROFILES`, `default` (checked; `chat-input-agent-profile-option-default`), `Manage agent profiles`. `control-openhands browser click 'testid=agent-profile-submenu >> text=Manage agent profiles' --expect-url 'settings/agents'` lands on `/settings/agents`. scenarios.name: F05--attach-a-file-and-an-image
scenarios.title: Attach a file and an image
scenarios.body:
On `/conversations/<id>` run `control-openhands browser upload 'testid=upload-image-input' "$OH_VERIFY_RUN/evidence/_fixtures/qa-image.png" "$OH_VERIFY_RUN/evidence/_fixtures/qa-note.txt"` and `control-openhands browser screenshot 'testid=interactive-chat-box' --feature F05.attach-files --name attached`: a `qa-note.txt TXT` chip and a thumbnail. `control-openhands browser count 'testid=interactive-chat-box >> alt=qa-image.png'` is `1`. `control-openhands browser click 'role=button[name="Upload as file"]'` turns the image toggle into `Do not upload as file` (`control-openhands browser attr 'role=button[name="Do not upload as file"]' aria-pressed` is `true`); click it again to restore. The remove buttons are named: `control-openhands browser snapshot 'testid=interactive-chat-box'` lists `button "Remove qa-note.txt"` and `button "Remove image"`. Remove the image with `control-openhands browser click 'testid=interactive-chat-box >> role=button[name="Remove image"]'`; the `alt=qa-image.png` count is `0`. Then `control-openhands browser type 'testid=chat-input' 'Reply with only the content of the attached file.'`, `control-openhands browser press Enter --selector 'testid=chat-input'`, wait as in Type and send, and `control-openhands browser text 'testid=user-message >> nth=-1'`: it ends `NEW FILES ADDED: qa-note.txt`. `control-openhands conversation events <id> --kinds MessageEvent --last 3` shows the reply `QA attachment 7731`, and `qa-note.txt` sits in the conversation `workspace` printed by `control-openhands conversation status <id>`. Attachments added on Home before the conversation exists upload after it is created: with no workspace or a Local Repo workspace they land in it (`browser network --filter upload` shows `200`). Expected: the same in New Worktree mode. Known failure (reproduced 2026-10-16, SDK 1.55.0, [#18421](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/18421)): run `control-openhands fixture git-repo --name qa-repo`, `control-openhands browser goto /`, `control-openhands workspace open qa-repo`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=workspace-mode-selector'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=workspace-mode-selector-option-new_worktree'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=chat-plus-button'`, `control-openhands browser upload-via 'testid=add-files-and-images-button' "$OH_VERIFY_RUN/evidence/_fixtures/qa-note.txt"`, type `Reply with only the word received. Do not run any tools.` and `control-openhands browser click 'testid=home-chat-launcher >> testid=submit-button' --expect-url '/conversations/[^/]+$'`: `control-openhands browser toasts --history` shows `HTTP request failed (422 Unprocessable Entity): {"detail":"path must be inside the conversation workspace"}` and `browser network --filter upload` a `422` for `?path=<run>/workspace/qa-repo/qa-note.txt`, while `conversation status <id>` reports the worktree `/tmp/conversation-worktrees/<id>/qa-repo`; the message is sent without the file. The same file attached inside that conversation afterwards uploads to the worktree (`200`). Restore with `testid=workspace-mode-selector-option-local_repo`.
  ```sh known-bug F05.attach-files home-new-worktree
  control-openhands browser viewport desktop
  control-openhands fixture git-repo --name qa-repo
  control-openhands fixture file --name qa-note.txt --content "QA attachment 7731"
  control-openhands browser goto /
  control-openhands browser fill 'testid=chat-input' ''
  control-openhands workspace open qa-repo
  control-openhands browser click 'testid=workspace-mode-selector'
  control-openhands browser click 'testid=workspace-mode-selector-option-new_worktree'
  control-openhands assert --field text --matches 'New Worktree' -- browser text 'testid=home-git-control-bar-preview'
  control-openhands browser click 'testid=chat-plus-button'
  control-openhands browser upload-via 'testid=add-files-and-images-button' "$OH_VERIFY_RUN/evidence/_fixtures/qa-note.txt"
  control-openhands browser type 'testid=chat-input' 'Reply with only the word received. Do not run any tools.'
  control-openhands browser network --clear
  control-openhands browser click 'testid=home-chat-launcher >> testid=submit-button' --expect-url '/conversations/[^/]+$'
  control-openhands browser wait 'testid=user-message' --timeout 30000
  control-openhands browser eval "new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,5000))"
  control-openhands browser screenshot --feature F05.attach-files --name home-new-worktree
  control-openhands assert --field recent.0.status --equals 200 --bug-shows 422 -- browser network --filter file/upload  # bug
  ```

expected: picked files show as chips and images as thumbnails (with an Upload-as-file toggle), each removable; sent files land in the workspace and are named in the message.
notes: Known issue [#17788](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/17788) (`F05.attach-files`): Cloud attachment upload rejects valid runtime data when cached fields are empty strings. Live prerequisite: A Cloud sandbox whose cached runtime URL/key are blank while the fresh runtime lookup is already ready.

Known issue [#16430](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/16430) (`F05.attach-files`): File upload does not have an indication of progress. Live prerequisite: A remote or throttled real upload that stays in flight long enough to inspect progress and composer state.

Known issue [#16339](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/16339) (`F05.attach-files`): Agent not informed of file location for files uploaded via canvas in cloud. Live prerequisite: An authenticated Cloud upload sandbox and working model to inspect the delivered filename/path notification and read the uploaded file.

Live prerequisite: an owned isolated backend with a controlled mid-upload filesystem failure (the original Linux file-size limit or an equivalent bounded child-process limit), a pre-existing target and a real Canvas overwrite.
