scenarios.name: F05--size-limit
scenarios.title: Size limit
scenarios.body: Arrange `head -c 4194304 /dev/zero > "$OH_VERIFY_RUN/evidence/_fixtures/qa-big.bin"` (and `qa-two-a.bin`, `qa-two-b.bin` with `head -c 2097152`). Run `control-openhands browser upload 'testid=upload-image-input' "$OH_VERIFY_RUN/evidence/_fixtures/qa-big.bin"` and `control-openhands browser toasts`: `Error: Files exceeding 3MB are not allowed: qa-big.bin`. Uploading `qa-two-a.bin` and `qa-two-b.bin` together toasts `Error: Total file size would be 4.0MB, exceeding the 3MB limit. Please select fewer or smaller files.` `control-openhands browser count 'testid=interactive-chat-box >> text=qa-big.bin'` is `0`.
scenarios.raw: **Size limit (`F05.attach-size-limit`).** Arrange `head -c 4194304 /dev/zero > "$OH_VERIFY_RUN/evidence/_fixtures/qa-big.bin"` (and `qa-two-a.bin`, `qa-two-b.bin` with `head -c 2097152`). Run `control-openhands browser upload 'testid=upload-image-input' "$OH_VERIFY_RUN/evidence/_fixtures/qa-big.bin"` and `control-openhands browser toasts`: `Error: Files exceeding 3MB are not allowed: qa-big.bin`. Uploading `qa-two-a.bin` and `qa-two-b.bin` together toasts `Error: Total file size would be 4.0MB, exceeding the 3MB limit. Please select fewer or smaller files.` `control-openhands browser count 'testid=interactive-chat-box >> text=qa-big.bin'` is `0`.
expected: a file over 3 MB, or a selection over 3 MB in total, is refused with an error toast.

scenarios.name: F05--image-alone
scenarios.title: Image alone
scenarios.body: From the home composer: `control-openhands browser goto /`, `control-openhands browser enabled 'testid=submit-button'` (`false`, empty field), `control-openhands browser click 'testid=chat-plus-button'`, `control-openhands browser upload-via 'testid=add-files-and-images-button' "$OH_VERIFY_RUN/evidence/_fixtures/qa-image.png"`, then `control-openhands browser count 'testid=home-chat-launcher >> alt=qa-image.png'` (`1`) and `control-openhands browser enabled 'testid=submit-button'`: `true` while `control-openhands browser eval "document.querySelector('[data-testid=chat-input]').innerText"` is still empty (`control-openhands browser screenshot 'testid=home-chat-launcher' --feature F05.image-only-send --name image-alone-send-enabled`). Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=submit-button' --expect-url '/conversations/'` and read `<image-id>` from `control-openhands browser url`. After `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=user-message'` and `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=chat-message-sending' --state detached --timeout 5000` (the pending bubble carries `testid=user-message` too, so wait for its `Sending...` to go, not only for a bubble; the wait returns `"state": "detached"` at once when the indicator has already gone, the usual case on a local stack), `control-openhands browser count 'testid=user-message >> testid=image-preview'` is `1`, and `control-openhands browser count 'testid=chat-message-sending'` and `control-openhands browser count 'testid=chat-message-retry'` are `0`. Server side, `control-openhands conversation events <image-id> --kinds MessageEvent --grep 'data:image/png;base64'` matches the one user row (`count` `1`; its `text` is a blank `" "`, the row carries `images: 1`, and the excerpt shows the `"type":"image"` block with `image_urls`), and `control-openhands conversation events <image-id> --kinds MessageEvent` (default `--last`) lists the same row with `images: 1` and no excerpt. `--kinds` filters before `--last` counts, so `--kinds MessageEvent --last 1` is that same row. To check that the model is handed the picture, send the image from Home together with `Which two colours are the bars in this image? Answer with the colour names only. Do not run any tools.` and read `control-openhands conversation events <id> --kinds MessageEvent`. Expect `orange` and `blue` in the agent row and `--kinds ActionEvent` `count` `0` (`fixture image` draws those bars).
scenarios.raw: **Image alone (`F05.image-only-send`).** From the home composer: `control-openhands browser goto /`, `control-openhands browser enabled 'testid=submit-button'` (`false`, empty field), `control-openhands browser click 'testid=chat-plus-button'`, `control-openhands browser upload-via 'testid=add-files-and-images-button' "$OH_VERIFY_RUN/evidence/_fixtures/qa-image.png"`, then `control-openhands browser count 'testid=home-chat-launcher >> alt=qa-image.png'` (`1`) and `control-openhands browser enabled 'testid=submit-button'`: `true` while `control-openhands browser eval "document.querySelector('[data-testid=chat-input]').innerText"` is still empty (`control-openhands browser screenshot 'testid=home-chat-launcher' --feature F05.image-only-send --name image-alone-send-enabled`). Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=submit-button' --expect-url '/conversations/'` and read `<image-id>` from `control-openhands browser url`. After `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=user-message'` and `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=chat-message-sending' --state detached --timeout 5000` (the pending bubble carries `testid=user-message` too, so wait for its `Sending...` to go, not only for a bubble; the wait returns `"state": "detached"` at once when the indicator has already gone, the usual case on a local stack), `control-openhands browser count 'testid=user-message >> testid=image-preview'` is `1`, and `control-openhands browser count 'testid=chat-message-sending'` and `control-openhands browser count 'testid=chat-message-retry'` are `0`. Server side, `control-openhands conversation events <image-id> --kinds MessageEvent --grep 'data:image/png;base64'` matches the one user row (`count` `1`; its `text` is a blank `" "`, the row carries `images: 1`, and the excerpt shows the `"type":"image"` block with `image_urls`), and `control-openhands conversation events <image-id> --kinds MessageEvent` (default `--last`) lists the same row with `images: 1` and no excerpt. `--kinds` filters before `--last` counts, so `--kinds MessageEvent --last 1` is that same row. To check that the model is handed the picture, send the image from Home together with `Which two colours are the bars in this image? Answer with the colour names only. Do not run any tools.` and read `control-openhands conversation events <id> --kinds MessageEvent`. Expect `orange` and `blue` in the agent row and `--kinds ActionEvent` `count` `0` (`fixture image` draws those bars).
expected: an attached image alone, with an empty field, enables Send; the sent user message shows the thumbnail and carries the picture as an embedded data URL.
notes: Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5523](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5523) (`F05.image-only-send`): DeepSeek V4.1 Flash images can be sent to another fallback profile because its vision capability is not detected. Live prerequisite: A working DeepSeek V4.1 Flash vision profile and another fallback profile, with an image-bearing turn.

scenarios.name: F05--paste-text
scenarios.title: Paste text
scenarios.body: Run `control-openhands browser type 'testid=chat-input' 'QA paste text'`, `control-openhands browser press Control+a`, `control-openhands browser press Control+c`, `control-openhands browser press Delete`, `control-openhands browser press Control+v`, then `control-openhands browser eval "document.querySelector('[data-testid=chat-input]').innerHTML"`: `QA paste text`, no markup. On a cleared field `control-openhands browser paste 'testid=chat-input' --file "$OH_VERIFY_RUN/evidence/_fixtures/qa-image.png"` attaches the image (`control-openhands browser count 'testid=interactive-chat-box >> alt=qa-image.png'` is `1`, with an `Upload as file` toggle) and `control-openhands browser paste 'testid=chat-input' --text 'QA pasted plain'` inserts plain text (`innerHTML` is `QA pasted plain`). `control-openhands browser drop-files 'testid=chat-input' "$OH_VERIFY_RUN/evidence/_fixtures/qa-note.txt" --stage over` makes `control-openhands browser text 'testid=interactive-chat-box'` start `Drop your files here`; the same command without `--stage` drops it: a `qa-note.txt` `TXT` chip appears. Remove the chip with `control-openhands browser click 'testid=interactive-chat-box >> role=button[name="Remove qa-note.txt"]'` and the image as in Attach; clear the field.
scenarios.raw: **Paste text (`F05.paste`).** Run `control-openhands browser type 'testid=chat-input' 'QA paste text'`, `control-openhands browser press Control+a`, `control-openhands browser press Control+c`, `control-openhands browser press Delete`, `control-openhands browser press Control+v`, then `control-openhands browser eval "document.querySelector('[data-testid=chat-input]').innerHTML"`: `QA paste text`, no markup. expected: pasted clipboard text is inserted as plain text; pasted images and dropped files attach.

scenarios.name: F05--dictation-failure
scenarios.title: Dictation failure
scenarios.body: Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=chat-dictation-button' --observe '[role=status]' --observe-ms 3000`: the observed toasts include `Dictation failed. Check microphone access and your voice input settings.` and `control-openhands browser attr 'testid=chat-dictation-button' aria-label` is back to `Start dictation`. Real dictation is blocked without a microphone.
scenarios.raw: **Dictation failure (`F05.dictation`).** Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=chat-dictation-button' --observe '[role=status]' --observe-ms 3000`: the observed toasts include `Dictation failed. Check microphone access and your voice input settings.` and `control-openhands browser attr 'testid=chat-dictation-button' aria-label` is back to `Start dictation`. Real dictation is blocked without a microphone.
expected: the mic button dictates into the composer; without a microphone it toasts a failure and resets.

scenarios.name: F05--switch-llm-profile
scenarios.title: Switch LLM profile
scenarios.body: Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=chat-input-llm-profile'` and `control-openhands browser text 'testid=chat-input-llm-profile-popover'`: `AVAILABLE PROFILES`, `deepseek-flash` / `deepseek/deepseek-flash`, `deepseek-pro` / `deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro`, `LLM Profiles`. Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=chat-input-llm-profile-option-deepseek-pro'`, `control-openhands browser wait-text 'Switched to profile' --timeout 15000`, `control-openhands browser text 'testid=chat-input-llm-profile'` (`deepseek-pro`) and `control-openhands conversation status <id>` (`model` is `deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro`). Send `Reply with only: pro-ok` as in Type and send; the reply is `pro-ok`. After `control-openhands browser reload` the pill still reads `deepseek-pro`. Switch back with `control-openhands browser click 'testid=chat-input-llm-profile'` and `control-openhands browser click 'testid=chat-input-llm-profile-option-deepseek-flash'`.
scenarios.raw: **Switch LLM profile (`F05.llm-profile-picker`).** Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=chat-input-llm-profile'` and `control-openhands browser text 'testid=chat-input-llm-profile-popover'`: `AVAILABLE PROFILES`, `deepseek-flash` / `deepseek/deepseek-flash`, `deepseek-pro` / `deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro`, `LLM Profiles`. Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=chat-input-llm-profile-option-deepseek-pro'`, `control-openhands browser wait-text 'Switched to profile' --timeout 15000`, `control-openhands browser text 'testid=chat-input-llm-profile'` (`deepseek-pro`) and `control-openhands conversation status <id>` (`model` is `deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro`). Send `Reply with only: pro-ok` as in Type and send; the reply is `pro-ok`. After `control-openhands browser reload` the pill still reads `deepseek-pro`. Switch back with `control-openhands browser click 'testid=chat-input-llm-profile'` and `control-openhands browser click 'testid=chat-input-llm-profile-option-deepseek-flash'`.
expected: the model pill switches the running conversation's LLM profile; the next reply uses the new model.
notes: Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5639](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5639) (`F05.llm-profile-picker`): A profile switched before the first message can be absent from token/cost statistics after its successful turn. Live prerequisite: A working model, a profile switch before the first run, and nonzero usage/cost after that turn.

Known issue [#17239](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/17239) (`F05.llm-profile-picker`): The reported model/profile picker can open above the viewport with unreachable rows. A frozen-target Local check with eight LLM profiles passed on Home at 1512x720, 1440x1000, 390x844 and 320x700, and in a genuine conversation at 1512x720 and 390x844: internal scrolling and selecting the first/last profile worked. The Cloud screenshot and real ACP multi-model picker remain unverified; they need an approved Cloud session or ACP account/adapter with a multi-row model catalogue. Local profile geometry is not proof of those branches. Run `backfill-18309-settings-worker`, Agent Server/SDK 1.54.0; evidence includes `F05.llm-profile-picker/17239-conversation-1512x720.png` and `17239-conversation-phone.png`.

scenarios.name: F05--profile-identity
scenarios.title: Profile identity
scenarios.body: Arrange two profiles on one model right before this bullet: `QA_DUMMY_KEY=qa control-openhands llm set --profile qa-alpha --model openai/gpt-4o --api-key-env QA_DUMMY_KEY --no-validate --no-activate` and `QA_DUMMY_KEY=qa control-openhands llm set --profile qa-zeta --model openai/gpt-4o --api-key-env QA_DUMMY_KEY --no-validate` (`qa-zeta` becomes the default: `control-openhands api GET /api/profiles --pick active_profile` is `qa-zeta`). Run `control-openhands conversation start --prompt "Reply with only: identity-ok"` (no `--wait`; with the dummy key the agent errors at once, which does not matter here) and note its `id` as `<zeta-id>`. `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=chat-input-llm-profile'`, then `control-openhands browser text 'testid=chat-input-llm-profile'` is `qa-zeta`, not the alphabetically first profile on that model. `control-openhands browser reload`, the wait and the text again: still `qa-zeta`. With a DeepSeek key, arrange both profiles on `deepseek/deepseek-flash` with `--api-key-env DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` and without `--no-validate`, and start with `--prompt "Reply with only: identity-ok. Do not run any tools." --wait --timeout 180`. Then the reply also survives the reload: `control-openhands browser text 'testid=agent-message >> nth=-1'` is `identity-ok` before and after it (driven 2026-10-08). The `default` agent profile still names `deepseek-flash` here, so the launch runs the pill's profile through agent settings (`F13.llm-pill-precedence`). The name is stamped on the conversation in this browser: `control-openhands browser eval "JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('openhands-agent-server-conversation-metadata'))['<zeta-id>'].active_profile"` is `qa-zeta`. Change the default in Settings: `control-openhands browser goto /settings/llm`, `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=add-llm-profile'`, `control-openhands browser click '[data-testid=profile-row]:has([title="qa-alpha"]) >> testid=profile-menu-trigger'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=profile-actions-menu >> testid=profile-set-active'`, `control-openhands browser wait-text 'Switched to profile "qa-alpha"'` (`control-openhands api GET /api/profiles --pick active_profile` is `qa-alpha`). The home pill follows the default: `control-openhands browser goto /`, the wait, and `control-openhands browser text 'testid=chat-input-llm-profile'` is `qa-alpha`; the started conversation keeps its own: `control-openhands browser goto /conversations/<zeta-id>`, the wait, and the text is `qa-zeta` (`control-openhands browser screenshot 'testid=interactive-chat-box' --feature F05.profile-identity --name conversation-keeps-qa-zeta`). Restore: make `deepseek-flash` the default again the same way (its row's `profile-menu-trigger`, then `profile-set-active`), then `control-openhands api DELETE /api/profiles/qa-alpha --write` and `control-openhands api DELETE /api/profiles/qa-zeta --write` (arrange, not proof) so `/model` below still counts two profiles. In a model-free run make `qa-zeta` the default instead and delete only `qa-alpha`. Return with `control-openhands browser goto /conversations/<id>`.

Do not run any tools." --wait --timeout 180`. The home pill follows the default: `control-openhands browser goto /`, the wait, and `control-openhands browser text 'testid=chat-input-llm-profile'` is `qa-alpha`; the started conversation keeps its own: `control-openhands browser goto /conversations/<zeta-id>`, the wait, and the text is `qa-zeta` (`control-openhands browser screenshot 'testid=interactive-chat-box' --feature F05.profile-identity --name conversation-keeps-qa-zeta`). expected: the pill names the profile the conversation was started with, also after a reload and when another profile uses the same model; changing the default profile in Settings changes the home pill, not an existing conversation's.
notes: Known issue [#16851](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/16851) (`F05.profile-identity`): wrong model is displayed when loading existing conversation. Live prerequisite: The original conversation/model-switch history and usage record showing Opus with a Fable selector; a dummy-key conversation has no usage evidence.

scenarios.name: F05--overflow-menu
scenarios.title: Overflow menu
scenarios.body: Run `control-openhands browser viewport narrow` and `control-openhands browser snapshot 'testid=interactive-chat-box'`: the model pill is gone and `button "More input actions"` appears (at `phone` and `350x800` the pill stays inline). `control-openhands browser click 'role=button[name="More input actions"]' --observe '[data-testid=chat-input-overflow-menu]' --observe-ms 1000`: `observed` goes from `<absent>` to `Model` (the menu appears in the observed sequence; its delay varies from run to run, so do not assert a time) and has no later `<absent>`. `control-openhands browser count 'testid=chat-input-overflow-menu'` is `1` and `control-openhands browser attr 'role=button[name="More input actions"]' aria-expanded` is `true`. Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=overflow-model-button'`; `control-openhands browser text 'testid=chat-input-overflow-menu'` reads `Model`, `AVAILABLE PROFILES`, `deepseek-flash` / `deepseek/deepseek-flash`, `deepseek-pro` / `deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro`, `LLM Profiles`. Run `control-openhands browser bbox 'testid=chat-input-llm-profile-option-deepseek-flash'` and `control-openhands browser bbox 'role=link[name="LLM Profiles"]'`. Expected: both `insideViewport` `true`. Known failure (#18063): the submenu opens to the right of the menu, so the profile row starts at x about 270 with width 210 and the `LLM Profiles` link sits at y about 725, below the 700 px viewport (both `insideViewport` `false`); the profile clicks below still work because the first two rows keep a strip of about 50 px on screen (from x about 270 to the 320 px edge), while a click on the `LLM Profiles` link times out (`browser screenshot --feature F05.overflow-menu --name model-submenu-narrow`). `control-openhands browser click 'testid=chat-input-llm-profile-option-deepseek-pro'` and `control-openhands browser wait-text 'Switched to profile' --timeout 15000` close the menu (count `0`), and `control-openhands conversation status <id>` shows `deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro`. Switch back the same way: the trigger, `testid=overflow-model-button`, then `testid=chat-input-llm-profile-option-deepseek-flash` (`conversation status <id>` shows `deepseek/deepseek-flash`). Open the menu once more; a second click on the trigger closes it (`aria-expanded` `false`). Escape closes it too: record it with `control-openhands browser record start --feature F05.overflow-menu --name escape-narrow`, open the menu, `control-openhands browser press Escape` and `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=chat-input-overflow-menu' --state detached --timeout 3000`; `browser attr 'role=button[name="More input actions"]' aria-expanded` is `false` and `control-openhands browser eval "document.activeElement.getAttribute('aria-label')"` is `More input actions`. Repeat with focus on a menu item (`control-openhands browser focus 'testid=overflow-model-button'` before Escape) and with the Model submenu open (`browser focus 'testid=chat-input-llm-profile-option-deepseek-flash'`): the same result. `control-openhands browser record stop --gif`. Return with `control-openhands browser viewport desktop`.

Escape closes it too: record it with `control-openhands browser record start --feature F05.overflow-menu --name escape-narrow`, open the menu, `control-openhands browser press Escape` and `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=chat-input-overflow-menu' --state detached --timeout 3000`; `browser attr 'role=button[name="More input actions"]' aria-expanded` is `false` and `control-openhands browser eval "document.activeElement.getAttribute('aria-label')"` is `More input actions`. Repeat with focus on a menu item (`control-openhands browser focus 'testid=overflow-model-button'` before Escape) and with the Model submenu open (`browser focus 'testid=chat-input-llm-profile-option-deepseek-flash'`): the same result. `control-openhands browser record stop --gif`. Return with `control-openhands browser viewport desktop`.

scenarios.name: F05--context-window
scenarios.title: Context window
scenarios.body: Run `control-openhands browser attr 'testid=context-window-meter' aria-label` (`Context window usage: 1% used (99% left)`), `control-openhands browser click 'testid=context-window-meter'` and `control-openhands browser text 'testid=context-window-meter-popover'` (`Context Window`, the percentage, `Compact context`, tokens such as `11.7k / 1.0M`, `Usage`). `control-openhands browser click 'testid=context-window-meter-bar-button'` (the progress bar) closes the popover and opens the Usage tab (`control-openhands browser testids --filter usage` lists `conversation-tab-usage`, `usage-panel`). The popover's `Usage` row does the same: from another tab (`control-openhands browser click 'testid=conversation-tab-files'`), reopen the ring, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=context-window-plan-usage'` and `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=usage-panel'` (the panel mounts a moment later; an immediate `count` is `0`). Reopen the ring, then `control-openhands browser click 'testid=context-window-compact-button' --observe '[role=status]' --observe-ms 25000`: `Context compaction started`, then `Context compacted`; `control-openhands conversation events <id> --kinds CondensationRequest,Condensation --last 5` lists both kinds.
scenarios.raw: **Context window (`F05.context-window-meter`).** Run `control-openhands browser attr 'testid=context-window-meter' aria-label` (`Context window usage: 1% used (99% left)`), `control-openhands browser click 'testid=context-window-meter'` and `control-openhands browser text 'testid=context-window-meter-popover'` (`Context Window`, the percentage, `Compact context`, tokens such as `11.7k / 1.0M`, `Usage`). `control-openhands browser click 'testid=context-window-meter-bar-button'` (the progress bar) closes the popover and opens the Usage tab (`control-openhands browser testids --filter usage` lists `conversation-tab-usage`, `usage-panel`). The popover's `Usage` row does the same: from another tab (`control-openhands browser click 'testid=conversation-tab-files'`), reopen the ring, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=context-window-plan-usage'` and `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=usage-panel'` (the panel mounts a moment later; an immediate `count` is `0`). Reopen the ring, then `control-openhands browser click 'testid=context-window-compact-button' --observe '[role=status]' --observe-ms 25000`: `Context compaction started`, then `Context compacted`; `control-openhands conversation events <id> --kinds CondensationRequest,Condensation --last 5` lists both kinds.
expected: the ring shows context use; its popover opens the Usage tab and compacts the context.
notes: Known issue [#17621](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/17621) (`F05.context-window-meter`): Compact context always fails after exactly 60s — client-side timeout aborts a condensation the server then completes. Live prerequisite: A real summarizing model and conversation whose condensation takes longer than 60 seconds.

Known issue [#17476](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/17476) (`F05.context-window-meter`): Planning socket stats overwrite the main conversation's context meter. Live prerequisite: A real planning sub-conversation and main conversation with distinct nonzero usage stats.

Known issue [#17271](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/17271) (`F05.context-window-meter`): New chat retains context/state from the previous conversation. Live prerequisite: A completed conversation with nonzero token usage before New Chat; a dummy-key run supplies no genuine context usage.

Known issue [#17263](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/17263) (`F05.context-window-meter`): Context meter stays pinned after a successful compaction once the condenser has its own usage entry. Live prerequisite: A real successful compaction whose condenser usage remains larger than the default agent usage.

Known issue [#16835](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/16835) (`F05.context-window-meter`): Agent Canvas sidebar shows "Cache Hit: 0" while backend correctly records nonzero cache_read_tokens. Live prerequisite: A working prompt-caching model/proxy and a real conversation reporting nonzero cache_read_tokens.

Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#4498](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/4498) (`F05.context-window-meter`): Compaction can leave an orphaned tool call/result in the live history and make the next provider request fail. Live prerequisite: A real condensation splitting an action/result pair, followed by the next provider request.

Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#4382](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/4382) (`F05.context-window-meter`): ACP cost can miss cache/thought usage, silently become zero, or inflate after stalled/reset cost updates. Live prerequisite: An authenticated ACP provider emitting cache/thought token usage or reset/stalled cumulative cost updates.

Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5820](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5820) (`F05.context-window-meter`): manual compaction on a null/no-op condenser can return500. Verification is blocked by genuine populated usage/context metrics: idle and refused-loopback runs leave `usage=null`, so neither composer nor Usage panel offers Compact context. A separate direct endpoint check returned500 but is not a Canvas reproduction. Use an existing real conversation with usage and no condenser, or an authorized successful provider run; never fabricate stats to expose the action.

scenarios.name: F05--stop-and-resume-with-a-queued-follow-up
scenarios.title: Stop and resume with a queued follow-up
scenarios.body: Send `Run this shell command: sleep 25 && echo slept. Then reply with only: done` (type + Enter as above), `control-openhands conversation wait <id> --until running --timeout 30` and `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=stop-button'`; `control-openhands browser attr 'testid=stop-button' aria-label` is `Stop`. While it runs, `control-openhands browser enabled 'testid=submit-button'` is `false` with an empty field; type `Also reply with: queued-ok` (enabled turns `true`) and press Enter. Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=stop-button'` and `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=play-button' --timeout 30000`; `control-openhands browser text 'testid=interactive-chat-box'` ends `Stopped`, `control-openhands browser attr 'testid=play-button' aria-label` is `Resume the agent task` and `control-openhands conversation status <id>` is `paused`. Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=play-button'`, wait for `running` then the terminal state: the last agent message is `done queued-ok` and `testid=user-message >> has-text=queued-ok` counts `1`.
scenarios.raw: **Stop and resume (`F05.stop-resume`) with a queued follow-up (`F05.queued-message`).** Send `Run this shell command: sleep 25 && echo slept. Then reply with only: done` (type + Enter as above), `control-openhands conversation wait <id> --until running --timeout 30` and `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=stop-button'`; `control-openhands browser attr 'testid=stop-button' aria-label` is `Stop`. While it runs, `control-openhands browser enabled 'testid=submit-button'` is `false` with an empty field; type `Also reply with: queued-ok` (enabled turns `true`) and press Enter. Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=stop-button'` and `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=play-button' --timeout 30000`; `control-openhands browser text 'testid=interactive-chat-box'` ends `Stopped`, `control-openhands browser attr 'testid=play-button' aria-label` is `Resume the agent task` and `control-openhands conversation status <id>` is `paused`. Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=play-button'`, wait for `running` then the terminal state: the last agent message is `done queued-ok` and `testid=user-message >> has-text=queued-ok` counts `1`.
expected: Stop pauses a running agent (status `Stopped`, Play button); Play resumes it.
a follow-up typed while the agent runs is accepted and answered.

scenarios.name: F05--slash-menu
scenarios.title: Slash menu
scenarios.body: On a cleared composer run `control-openhands browser type 'testid=chat-input' '/'`, `control-openhands browser count 'testid=slash-command-menu >> role=option'` (37 with the bundled skills) and `control-openhands browser text 'testid=slash-command-menu'`: `Commands`, then `/btw`, `/model`, `/goal`, `/plan`, `/code` with descriptions, then skills (`/agent-creator`, …); no `/new` on the local backend. Type `mo`: the count drops (descriptions match too). `control-openhands browser attr 'testid=slash-command-menu >> role=option >> nth=0' aria-selected` is `true`; after `control-openhands browser press ArrowDown` the selected option is `/plan` (read it with `control-openhands browser text 'testid=slash-command-menu >> [aria-selected=true]'`). `control-openhands browser press Escape` closes the menu and keeps `/mo`. On `/btw`, `control-openhands browser press Tab` leaves `/btw ` in the field; on `/model ` (trailing space) the menu lists `/model deepseek-flash` and `/model deepseek-pro`, and `control-openhands browser press Enter` inserts `/model deepseek-flash ` instead of sending.
scenarios.raw: **Slash menu (`F05.slash-menu`).** On a cleared composer run `control-openhands browser type 'testid=chat-input' '/'`, `control-openhands browser count 'testid=slash-command-menu >> role=option'` (37 with the bundled skills) and `control-openhands browser text 'testid=slash-command-menu'`: `Commands`, then `/btw`, `/model`, `/goal`, `/plan`, `/code` with descriptions, then skills (`/agent-creator`, …); no `/new` on the local backend. Type `mo`: the count drops (descriptions match too). `control-openhands browser attr 'testid=slash-command-menu >> role=option >> nth=0' aria-selected` is `true`; after `control-openhands browser press ArrowDown` the selected option is `/plan` (read it with `control-openhands browser text 'testid=slash-command-menu >> [aria-selected=true]'`). `control-openhands browser press Escape` closes the menu and keeps `/mo`. On `/btw`, `control-openhands browser press Tab` leaves `/btw ` in the field; on `/model ` (trailing space) the menu lists `/model deepseek-flash` and `/model deepseek-pro`, and `control-openhands browser press Enter` inserts `/model deepseek-flash ` instead of sending.
expected: `/` opens a filtered command list (built-ins and skills) with arrow, Tab/Enter and Escape handling.

scenarios.name: F05--model

scenarios.name: F05--btw
scenarios.title: `/btw`
scenarios.body: Note `control-openhands conversation events <id> --kinds MessageEvent` count, type `/btw Reply with only: side-ok`, Escape, Enter. `control-openhands browser text 'testid=btw-messages'` is `BTW:` + the question and `testid=btw-spinner` counts `1`; after the answer the card shows `Got it`. `control-openhands browser click 'testid=btw-messages >> role=button[name="Expand"]'` reveals `side-ok`; `control-openhands browser click 'testid=btw-messages >> role=button[name="Got it"]'` removes the card (count `0`). The MessageEvent count is unchanged. Bare `/btw` (Escape, Enter) clears the field and `control-openhands browser toasts` shows `Please provide a question — e.g. /btw <question>`; `control-openhands browser count 'testid=btw-messages'` stays `0`.
scenarios.raw: **`/btw` (`F05.slash-btw`).** Note `control-openhands conversation events <id> --kinds MessageEvent` count, type `/btw Reply with only: side-ok`, Escape, Enter. `control-openhands browser text 'testid=btw-messages'` is `BTW:` + the question and `testid=btw-spinner` counts `1`; after the answer the card shows `Got it`. `control-openhands browser click 'testid=btw-messages >> role=button[name="Expand"]'` reveals `side-ok`; `control-openhands browser click 'testid=btw-messages >> role=button[name="Got it"]'` removes the card (count `0`). The MessageEvent count is unchanged. Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5330](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5330) (`F05.slash-btw`): A /btw side question can prevent reuse of the normal conversation prompt cache. Live prerequisite: A working caching provider and comparable ordinary-message versus /btw prompt/cache records.

scenarios.name: F05--goal
scenarios.title: `/goal`
scenarios.body: Bare `/goal` + Enter: `control-openhands browser toasts` shows `Please provide an objective — e.g. /goal <objective>`. Send `/goal --max 1 Reply with only: goal-ok`: `control-openhands browser text 'testid=goal-status'` reads `Goal: … Round 0/1 running Stop`; `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=goal-done' --timeout 150000`, then `Round 1/1 complete score 100%`. Send `/goal --max 2 Reply with only: goal-two` and at once `control-openhands browser click 'testid=goal-status >> nth=-1 >> testid=goal-stop'`; `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=goal-resume'` and the banner reads `Round 0/2 interrupted Resume`. `control-openhands browser click 'testid=goal-resume'` sets it `running`; poll `control-openhands browser text 'testid=goal-status >> nth=-1'` until a new row ends `Round 1/2 complete score 100%`. The old `Round 0/2 interrupted` row no longer offers Resume: `control-openhands browser count 'testid=goal-resume'` is `0`. After `control-openhands browser reload`, `control-openhands browser count 'testid=goal-status'` is `3` and the `goal-resume` count is still `0`.
scenarios.raw: **`/goal` (`F05.slash-goal`).** Bare `/goal` + Enter: `control-openhands browser toasts` shows `Please provide an objective — e.g. /goal <objective>`. Send `/goal --max 1 Reply with only: goal-ok`: `control-openhands browser text 'testid=goal-status'` reads `Goal: … Round 0/1 running Stop`; `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=goal-done' --timeout 150000`, then `Round 1/1 complete score 100%`. Send `/goal --max 2 Reply with only: goal-two` and at once `control-openhands browser click 'testid=goal-status >> nth=-1 >> testid=goal-stop'`; `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=goal-resume'` and the banner reads `Round 0/2 interrupted Resume`. `control-openhands browser click 'testid=goal-resume'` sets it `running`; poll `control-openhands browser text 'testid=goal-status >> nth=-1'` until a new row ends `Round 1/2 complete score 100%`. The old `Round 0/2 interrupted` row no longer offers Resume: `control-openhands browser count 'testid=goal-resume'` is `0`. After `control-openhands browser reload`, `control-openhands browser count 'testid=goal-status'` is `3` and the `goal-resume` count is still `0`.
expected: `/goal [--max N] <objective>` runs a judged goal loop with a status banner, Stop and Resume; only the newest goal status offers Resume.
notes: Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5627](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5627) (`F05.slash-goal`): After backend restart the goal chip can remain Running while the conversation is paused, and Stop does not clear it. Live prerequisite: A working model goal loop active during graceful backend restart, then goal-status and resume readback.

Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5492](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5492) (`F05.slash-goal`): A goal can stop as Complete when its judge replies with complete as the string false. Live prerequisite: A real goal judge response containing complete as the string false rather than a JSON boolean.

Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5824](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5824) (`F05.slash-goal`): resuming after a failed judge audit can show iteration 2 of a maximum of 1 and run beyond the selected goal cap. Live prerequisite: an agent/judge run whose audit fails, followed by a successful incomplete judge verdict after Resume; a controller-only test does not establish the Canvas banner outcome.

scenarios.name: F05--phone
scenarios.title: Phone

scenarios.name: F05--home-file-re-pick
scenarios.title: Home file re-pick
scenarios.body: As a separate check after the conversation recipes, run `control-openhands browser goto /`, upload the file fixture with `control-openhands browser upload 'testid=upload-image-input' "$OH_VERIFY_RUN/evidence/_fixtures/qa-note.txt"`, remove it with `control-openhands browser click 'role=button[name="Remove qa-note.txt"]'`, upload that same path again, then `control-openhands browser count 'role=button[name="Remove qa-note.txt"]'`. Expected: `1`. Known failure (reproduced 2026-10-12, [#17471](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/17471)): the second pick is ignored and the count is `0`. End with `browser reload` to clear the file input.
scenarios.raw: **Home file re-pick (`F05.attach-files`).** As a separate check after the conversation recipes, run `control-openhands browser goto /`, upload the file fixture with `control-openhands browser upload 'testid=upload-image-input' "$OH_VERIFY_RUN/evidence/_fixtures/qa-note.txt"`, remove it with `control-openhands browser click 'role=button[name="Remove qa-note.txt"]'`, upload that same path again, then `control-openhands browser count 'role=button[name="Remove qa-note.txt"]'`. Expected: `1`. Known failure (reproduced 2026-10-12, [#17471](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/17471)): the second pick is ignored and the count is `0`. End with `browser reload` to clear the file input.
expected: picked files show as chips and images as thumbnails (with an Upload-as-file toggle), each removable; sent files land in the workspace and are named in the message.
notes: Known issue [#17788](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/17788) (`F05.attach-files`): Cloud attachment upload rejects valid runtime data when cached fields are empty strings. Live prerequisite: A Cloud sandbox whose cached runtime URL/key are blank while the fresh runtime lookup is already ready.

Known issue [#16430](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/16430) (`F05.attach-files`): File upload does not have an indication of progress. Live prerequisite: A remote or throttled real upload that stays in flight long enough to inspect progress and composer state.

Known issue [#16339](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/16339) (`F05.attach-files`): Agent not informed of file location for files uploaded via canvas in cloud. Live prerequisite: An authenticated Cloud upload sandbox and working model to inspect the delivered filename/path notification and read the uploaded file.

Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5889](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5889) (`F05.attach-files`): a same-name attachment upload that fails part-way can replace the previous workspace file with partial content. Live prerequisite: an owned isolated backend with a controlled mid-upload filesystem failure (the original Linux file-size limit or an equivalent bounded child-process limit), a pre-existing target and a real Canvas overwrite. Never change resource limits on a shared runtime; a normal successful upload does not verify failure atomicity.
annotations: Known failure (reproduced 2026-10-12, [#17471](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/17471)): the second pick is ignored and the count is `0`. End with `browser reload` to clear the file input.

scenarios.name: F05--unmatched-failed-conversation-profile
scenarios.title: Unmatched failed-conversation profile
scenarios.body: Separate disposable check: record the original active profile with `control-openhands llm show`, then create an empty Local conversation with a new dummy profile pointing to closed loopback `http://127.0.0.1:9` (`llm set --no-validate`, as F06's dummy-profile precondition does); give it model `openai/gpt-4o`. After `browser reset` and `onboard --skip`, reopen it and send `Reply with only QA. Do not run any tools.`. Change the same saved profile to `openai/gpt-4o-mini` with `llm set --no-validate`, then reload and read `browser text 'testid=chat-input-llm-profile'` and `conversation status <id>`. Known failure (reproduced 2026-10-12, [#16263](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/16263)): once the loopback turn errors, the pill reads Select a model despite a loaded active profile and the persisted conversation model. This check covers the missing browser stamp and unmatched-model case, not successful provider output. Reactivate the original profile with `control-openhands api POST /api/profiles/<original-profile>/activate --write`, then delete the disposable conversation and profile afterwards.

families.title: Agent activity: messages, events and lifecycle
families.overview:
Inside a conversation the user watches the agent work: their own messages appear
at once (optimistically), the agent's replies render as markdown, tool calls are
grouped into collapsible "N actions completed" blocks whose cards show commands,
outputs, diffs and task lists, and a live chip says what the agent is doing right
now. Around the transcript sit lifecycle controls and states: the starting pill,
stop and resume, the confirmation prompt when confirmation mode is on, error and
reconnect banners, the no-LLM banner and the skill-installed banner. History
pages in from the server, survives reloads and backend restarts, and any message
can be branched into a new conversation.
families.entry:
- Open any conversation: a sidebar conversation card, or the direct URL `/conversations/<id>`. Leaving one for the home page: the sidebar's **New Chat** link; coming back: its card again.
- Start one from the home composer (**New Chat**, `/`): type and press Send. `control-openhands conversation start` drives exactly this path.
- An empty conversation: the sidebar's create-thread button (`conversation-panel-new-thread-picker`), then **No workspace** (or a workspace).
- Composer status control (right side of the composer): Stop while running, Play while stopped.
- Hover a bubble: Branch from here and Copy to clipboard icons; hover a tool title for its timestamp.
- Confirmation mode and the critic are switched on under Settings → Verification (`/settings/verification`; the page itself belongs to the settings families).
families.given:
Preconditions:

- Baseline state (launched, doctored, `onboard --skip` done) and `control-openhands llm preset deepseek` (deepseek-flash active). Every prompt below is tiny and stays in the conversation's own workspace.
- Conversation ids are printed as `"id"` by `control-openhands conversation start`, or read from `control-openhands browser url` (`/conversations/<id>`). `<id>` below is always the conversation the step just created or opened.
- `F06.llm-not-configured-banner` needs a second, fresh `control-openhands launch --new --build never` with no `llm preset` (export its run dir as `OH_VERIFY_RUN` for those commands, then `control-openhands stop` it).
- `F06.critic-result` is blocked: it needs a model and an OpenHands Cloud critic API key (Settings → Verification → Critic API Key); its bullet says what a scored run shows. The automatic-fetch half of `F06.load-older-history` (its 16-command conversation) needs a model; the scroll-to-top half is driven without one, on the dummy profile below, with thirty refused user messages. `F06.hook-events` needs a configured hook; none is set in a fresh run.
- `F06.clock-skew-send` and `F06.failed-send-persists` need no model reply: a conversation that exists is enough (without a key the agent errors at once, and the user rows still land). Without a key, create the family's conversations with a dummy profile (`QA_DUMMY_KEY=qa control-openhands llm set --profile qa-zeta --model openai/gpt-4o --api-key-env QA_DUMMY_KEY --no-validate`) and `control-openhands conversation start --prompt ...` without `--wait`. `F06.corrective-nudge` is blocked: the nudge needs a model turn with neither text nor a tool call, which a normal prompt to deepseek-flash does not produce. When one happens, `control-openhands browser count 'testid=corrective-nudge-message'` is `1` and `browser count 'testid=user-message >> has-text=Your last response did not include'` is `0`.
- The harness browser grants clipboard access: `control-openhands browser clipboard` reads what a Copy button wrote and `browser clipboard --write qa-empty` resets it first.
- A terminal call can come back as "The terminal session was reset..." after this run's agent server restarts; the model reruns it, which turns one action into a group of two (see Gotchas).
families.gotchas:
- `control-openhands conversation events <id>` returns the last 25 events unless you pass `--last N`; it reads the server's 100-event pages until `N` rows are in hand (`pages` says how many it read, `more: true` that older pages remain), so `--last 500` covers a 150-event conversation in two pages (`total` `152`, `pages` `2`, `more` `false` on the Older history conversation; `--last 25` there reads one page, `more` `true`) and `--from-start` reads from the oldest. `--kinds` and `--grep` filter before `--last` counts, and pages are read until `--last` matching rows are in hand: `--kinds MessageEvent --last 3` is the three newest messages, `--kinds MessageEvent --last 500` all thirty, and `--grep 'qa older 1'` reaches `qa older 1` on the oldest page with the default `--last` (`count` `11`, `pages` `2`). Event texts are cut at about 160 characters.
- `--observe` takes the same selector syntax as the verbs: `testid=` and plain CSS segments (joined with ` >> `) are watched by an in-page MutationObserver (`observedBy` `mutation`; the Older history bullet's `--observe 'testid=loading-older-events'` is one), while other engines (`role=`, `text=`, `nth=`) are polled every 20 ms instead (not driven in this family).
- `role=button[name="Expand"]` also matches "Expand thinking" and "Expand actions"; use `[exact]` to target tool rows. Each click flips the row to Collapse, so `nth=0` walks to the next collapsed row.
- Tool rows show no success icon; the only indicators are the `exit N` badge for non-zero exits and a clock icon (`status-icon`) for timeouts. A single action is not grouped: it renders as a bare row without `event-group`.
- The model writes the tool titles and may append to commands (it turned `ls /missing` into `ls ...; echo "EXIT:$?"`, exit 0). Ask for the command "verbatim, with nothing appended" when the exit code matters.
- The agent itself may open files with `canvas_ui_control` (a third action in the echo/file run). Close the file tab before proving that a path link opens it.
- On Settings → Verification the Security Analyzer field (All tab) is shown only while Confirmation Mode is on: switch Confirmation Mode on first, then pick the analyzer. Check `api GET /api/settings` after saving.
- Confirmation mode with the default Security Analyzer `LLM` uses ConfirmRisky(HIGH): harmless commands run without a prompt. Set the analyzer to `None` to confirm every action, and restore `LLM` afterwards. The composer stays editable while waiting (status "User needed"); the buttons read Cancel / Continue.
- The confirm and cancel shortcuts accept Meta or Ctrl and ignore a held key's auto-repeat; once a response is sent the listener is detached, so a second press sends nothing (#18127). Hints read `Ctrl+↩` / `Ctrl+⇧+⌫` off Apple platforms.
- Known failure, Canvas UI ([#18202](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/18202), reproduced 2026-10-09; [draft fix PR #18203](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/pull/18203)): after a user-message branch the composer holds the prefilled text but Send stays disabled (`browser enabled 'testid=submit-button'` is `false`, and a click on it times out with `element is not enabled`). The prefill is a saved draft that `src/hooks/chat/use-draft-persistence.ts` writes into the field without an input event, and the composer is reused across the client-side switch, so its Send state keeps the source conversation's empty field. Editing the text, a reload, or Enter in the field (`browser press Enter --selector 'testid=chat-input'`) all work. A draft restored by a sidebar switch behaves the same (F05 Gotchas).
- Known failure, likely Agent Server: every message in a branched conversation ends with `ConversationErrorEvent` `LLMAuthenticationError` ("Your LLM API key appears to be invalid or has expired."), while the source conversation keeps working (OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5465). Do not use branches as fixtures for other checks.
- "The terminal session was reset because the underlying tmux server/session disappeared" (clock `status-icon` on the row) appears after a `service stop agent-server` / `restart` cycle. Since `launch` gives each run its own short `TMUX_TMPDIR`, other runs no longer cause it. The underlying product bug is still open (OpenHands/OpenHands#17946) for plain `agent-canvas` instances: `bin/agent-canvas.mjs` → `scripts/dev-with-automation.mjs` passes `TMUX_TMPDIR=<state>/tmux` to the Agent Server but `ensureDirectories` never creates it (`dev-safe.mjs` does), so tmux 3.4 falls back to the shared `/tmp/tmux-<uid>/openhands` socket and another instance's restart or stop kills this run's windows. The model usually reruns the command; expect an extra action.
- The `ConversationErrorEvent` banner is not restored after navigating away and back (or a reload); read the error from the events API instead.
- After `restart`, reconnection takes about 20 s without a click; click `error-message-banner-retry` to reconnect at once. The error banner does not come back after a page reload once the stack is healthy.
- "Sending..." lasts about 100 to 650 ms on a local stack, too short to hover and click `chat-message-stop`; that stop path is not driven here. The `F06.pending-messages` failure path needs `service stop agent-server`.
- `browser clock` installs a fake clock that stays with the page across reloads and client-side navigation. Install it before the `goto` whose page should see it, and put it back with `browser clock --offset-ms 0` plus `browser reload`; compare `browser eval "new Date().toISOString()"` with `date -u` when in doubt.
- The pending-message queue lives in page memory, so a failed bubble survives sidebar navigation and a backend `restart` but not a `browser reload` or `browser goto` of the conversation (`src/stores/optimistic-user-message-store.ts`). Leave and return through the sidebar when proving `F06.failed-send-persists`. The sidebar card's title is the first message or model-written: click its link by id, `'a[href*="/conversations/<id>"] >> nth=0'`.
- Both the pending bubble and the echoed message carry `testid=user-message`, so `count 'testid=user-message >> has-text=...'` is one too high while a failed bubble is still shown; count attempts with `conversation events <id> --kinds MessageEvent` (user rows: `"source": "user"`) and the bubbles with `chat-message-retry`.
- Local `Stop` calls the Agent Server's interrupt (Cloud pauses the sandbox instead, see `pauseConversation`): a command already running in the terminal is cut off, recorded as `AgentErrorEvent` + `InterruptEvent`, and after Play the model only reports the interruption.
- The no-LLM banner reuses the home banner's test ids (`home-llm-not-configured-banner`). It exists only in a run where no LLM was ever configured: use a separate `launch --new`, never remove the profile from the shared run.
- Read the clipboard with `control-openhands browser clipboard`, never `browser eval "navigator.clipboard.readText()"`. An agent bubble that contains a code block holds two `copy-to-clipboard` buttons (the code block's is hidden until hovered): scope the bubble's with `>> nth=0`.
- Plan-mode previews (`plan-preview-*`) and the BTW side messages render in this stream but are reached from the composer's mode controls; they are not mapped here.
- Known issue [#18117](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/18117) (`F06.thinking`): Inline thinking leaks into the agent chat bubble. Live prerequisite: A live model that emits a leading inline think block on a tool-call turn, plus its finalized ActionEvent.
- Known issue [#17559](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/17559) (`F06.load-older-history`): History pagination can show both an action and its observation (ready-for-dev companion to #16947). Live prerequisite: A real persisted history page boundary splitting an action/observation or ACP started/completed pair; dummy-key errors do not produce these tool pairs.
- Known issue [#17492](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/17492) (`F06.tool-visualizers`): Failed browser, glob, grep, and file editor tool calls render as successful in chat. Live prerequisite: A working model emitting failed browser, glob, grep, planning-editor and file-editor observations with is_error=true.
- Known issue [#17490](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/17490) (`F06.tool-visualizers`): Terminal commands that fail with an ordinary non-zero exit render as successful in chat. Live prerequisite: A working model producing a completed terminal command with nonzero exit_code and is_error=false.
- Known issue [#17161](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/17161) (`F06.markdown-rendering`): markdown sanitizer lets untrusted content set rel="opener" and any target on links. Live prerequisite: A real reasoning, activated-skill, tool-description or error-detail body rendered without includeStandard. The attempted skills dialog exposed public skills only and did not reach the affected chat renderer.
- Known issue [#17026](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/17026) (`F06.thinking`): agent-canvas: final-reply thinking block missing for text-only turns (reasoning_content not read for MessageEvents). Live prerequisite: A reasoning-capable live model emitting nonempty MessageEvent.llm_message.reasoning_content on a text-only turn, followed by reload.
- Known issue [#16842](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/16842) (`F06.reconnect`): A late close from a replaced WebSocket marks the active connection disconnected. Live prerequisite: A transport fixture delaying an old socket close until its replacement is open; ordinary server restart cannot select that ordering.
- Known issue [#16719](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/16719) (`F06.live-activity`): Agent status always says "thinking" even when nothing is happening. Live prerequisite: The event/status trace and deterministic stalled or errored state from the original report; its trigger is unspecified.
- Known issue [#16686](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/16686) (`F06.error-events`): LLM errors not propagated to the frontend. Live prerequisite: A Nebius credential and its rejected DeepSeek-V3 request, or the original complete emitted error fixture.
- Known issue [#16582](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/16582) (`F06.stop-resume`): After reconnect, a maximum-iteration error can fail to pause the agent through the legacy event handler. Live prerequisite: A maximum-iteration legacy error delivered after socket replacement, with a real model run reaching that limit.
- Known issue [#16455](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/16455) (`F06.events-match`): Duplicate messages from the agent in 1.12.0. Live prerequisite: The original duplicated event/stream trace or deterministic prompt and timing; the report provides no reproducible trigger.
- Known issue [#16341](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/16341) (`F06.tool-visualizers`): Code-explorer subagent frequently errors. Live prerequisite: A working model with native code-explorer delegation and the original repository task; no delegated-tool output can be generated without credentials.
- Known issue [#15626](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/15626) (`F06.error-events`): Conversation can fail with LiteLLM auth error when database server at 127.0.0.1:5432 is unreachable. Live prerequisite: The original LiteLLM proxy/database-failure event or a disposable proxy with its PostgreSQL dependency unavailable.
- Known issue [#15606](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/15606) (`F06.reload-mid-run`): When re-loading ACP conversations, messages disappear or move. Live prerequisite: An authenticated Codex ACP session emitting intermediate messages while another window reloads history.
- Known issue [#15527](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/15527) (`F06.reconnect`): Canvas briefly shows "disconnected" when coming back to an idle tab. Live prerequisite: The original custom-domain deployment, idle duration and tab-suspension/network transition; those details are missing.
- Known failure [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5635](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5635) (`F06.reconnect`), reproduced 2026-10-12 at `fa1f724ab573` with SDK 1.54.0 and Chromium 153.0.8010.12: sandbox pause returned 204 but an already communicating session socket remained open for more than 10 seconds. A new Canvas tab received a subsequent `run:false` marker while the original tab did not. DELETE returned 200 and GET returned 404, yet both held sockets remained open for more than 10 seconds; Canvas later redirected by metadata polling. Recipe: open an idle dummy-profile conversation and confirm its marker/socket; POST `/api/conversations/prepare-for-sandbox-pause`, retain the original tab for 10 seconds, open a second tab, POST a new unique user event with `run:false`, then compare the two transcripts. DELETE the owned conversation and read lifecycle metadata for another 10 seconds. Use `--run <run>` and `browser events --kinds websocket-created,websocket-open,websocket-close --last 100`; no frame bodies or auth data are recorded. Evidence: `backfill-18309-surface-rechecks/F06.reconnect/pause-delete-sockets-5635.json`, `pause-new-tab-5635.png`, `pause-stale-tab-5635.png`. The expected socket shutdown/reconnect remains unchanged; polling recovery must not be mistaken for socket closure.
- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5465](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5465) (`F06.branch-from-here`): Branch from here can lose encrypted LLM credentials, so the fork fails its first turn with LLMAuthenticationError. Live prerequisite: A working cipher-backed model conversation, then fork and a successful turn on the fork.
- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5447](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5447) (`F06.error-events`): An Anthropic Claude Opus5.5 conversation can fail with400 when its next request ends in an assistant prefill. Live prerequisite: Anthropic Claude Opus5.5 credentials and a real trailing-assistant-prefill request.
- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5354](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5354) (`F06.event-groups`): A mixed valid/invalid tool batch can be split into separate assistant messages, breaking call/result pairing on the next provider request. Live prerequisite: A live model turn mixing valid, invalid and valid tool calls in one response.
- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5225](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5225) (`F06.error-events`): A provider-rejected image tool result can leave the conversation permanently failing on every resume. Live prerequisite: A real provider-rejected poisoned image tool_result in a disposable persisted history, followed by retry.
- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5108](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5108) (`F06.tool-visualizers`): The native SDK Gemini editor can report success while corrupting unrelated invalid-UTF8 bytes in the file. Live prerequisite: An Agent Server configured with the native Gemini edit tool set and a real tool edit of an invalid-UTF8 fixture; Gemini ACP uses a different external executor.
- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5096](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5096) (`F06.tool-visualizers`): The canonical agent file editor can replace a symlink instead of editing its target; Undo does not restore the link. Live prerequisite: A working model invoking canonical file-editor str_replace/insert through a real symlink, then undo.
- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5092](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5092) (`F06.confirmation-mode`): A revocation message sent while waiting for confirmation can implicitly approve the pending action. Live prerequisite: A working model proposing a real confirmation-gated marker action, then a revocation user message.
- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5074](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5074) (`F06.tool-visualizers`): After server restart a native delegated child can remain Running while the parent loses its task mapping/result. Live prerequisite: A native delegated child still running during an owned server crash and parent recovery.
- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5038](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5038) (`F06.tool-visualizers`): The agent file editor can refuse valid Chinese UTF8 text as binary when its sample splits a character; Canvas Files uses a separate preview detector. Live prerequisite: A live canonical file-editor view/edit on the specific UTF8 sample alignment; Canvas Files preview uses a separate NUL sniff, not this validator.
- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#4990](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/4990) (`F06.stop-resume`): An ACP turn can keep executing tool calls while the UI already reports Paused. Live prerequisite: An authenticated Claude Code ACP turn executing separate marker-writing tools while Pause is pressed.
- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#4983](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/4983) (`F06.tool-visualizers`): Agent grep can silently miss extended-regex matches when its runtime falls back to system grep. Live prerequisite: A runtime without ripgrep and a live agent grep call using extended regex and escaped literal punctuation.
- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#4965](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/4965) (`F06.error-events`): A strict OpenAI-compatible provider can reject blank content in the saved history, preventing later turns. Live prerequisite: A strict OpenAI-compatible provider and a real history containing blank text or empty content arrays.
- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#4777](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/4777) (`F06.stop-resume`): Stop can still start a queued tool after it finishes waiting on a resource lock. Live prerequisite: A live batch with a second real tool waiting on a declared-resource lock when Stop is pressed.
- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#4668](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/4668) (`F06.tool-visualizers`): A planning editor card can lose old/new content and fail to show the complete edit diff. Live prerequisite: A live planner create/edit yielding PlanningFileEditorObservation with old/new contents for the chat diff.
- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#4663](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/4663) (`F06.tool-visualizers`): Parallel Python-fallback glob calls can change process cwd and return files from the wrong workspace. Live prerequisite: Concurrent real glob/tool calls in distinct workspaces with the Python fallback active.
- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#4661](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/4661) (`F06.tool-visualizers`): Same-name project subagents can resolve to another conversation workspace definition. Live prerequisite: Two native task-enabled conversations with same-name project subagent definitions and a working model for delegation.
- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#4583](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/4583) (`F06.tool-visualizers`): An agent editor insertion at EOF can join onto the last line when the file has no trailing newline. Live prerequisite: A working model invoking file-editor insert at EOF on a file with no trailing newline.
- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#4558](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/4558) (`F06.error-events`): A saved encrypted fallback profile can send ciphertext as its key and fail authentication, leaving only the primary error visible. Live prerequisite: A working encrypted saved fallback profile and real primary-model failure that triggers fallback resolution.
- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#4540](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/4540) (`F06.tool-visualizers`): Synthetic GLM/Kimi tool calls can render as raw tool_call syntax instead of executing. Live prerequisite: Synthetic provider credentials and a GLM/Kimi turn emitting the raw tool_call wrapper.
- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#4532](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/4532) (`F06.confirmation-mode`): After restarting while awaiting confirmation, approval can execute the tool but the next model request omits its assistant call. Live prerequisite: A real confirmation-paused action persisted across backend restart, then approval and a working provider call.
- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#4077](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/4077) (`F06.reload-mid-run`): Retried or late streaming deltas can duplicate live text; a stalled subscriber can delay Stop and finalization. Live prerequisite: A working stream interrupted/retried or delivered to a controlled stalled subscriber, with delta/state-order capture.
- Known issue [#16947](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/16947) (`F06.load-older-history`): Loading older history can leave both the action and its newer observation visible because UI projection depends on arrival order. Live prerequisite: A real long conversation whose REST boundary splits an action/observation pair; keep companion #17559 linked separately.

- Known issue [#18445](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/18445) (`F06.load-older-history`, `F06.reconnect`): a failed initial Cloud history search can be swallowed into an empty page while the runtime count succeeds, advancing `after_seq` past history that was never displayed. Live prerequisite: a Cloud account and owned conversation with a genuinely failing App API `events/search` and a successful runtime `events/count`. The Local failure path throws instead and is not an equivalent check.

- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5969](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5969) (`F06.stop-resume`): a conversation can report finished but reject Play with already-running, or delay a follow-up, while a slow event webhook is still pending. Live prerequisite: a genuinely successful model run on an owned backend with a bounded slow webhook receiver, then Play or send during that completion window.

- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5740](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5740) (`F06.error-events`): a Responses display delta without `item_id` can terminate the turn with an AttributeError. Live prerequisite: the genuine provider/transformer streaming path producing that incomplete event; the report did not retain its original raw SSE. A credential-free parser diagnostic proves the SDK exception, not a Canvas model turn.

- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5806](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5806) (`F06.branch-from-here`): editing a displayed user message first reads its parent event; if that event has become unreadable/missing on the server, the action can fail with 500 instead of a missing-event response. Live prerequisite: an owned persisted conversation with a still-displayed user message whose event storage is missing, followed by the actual Edit action. A random unknown-ID API call proves neither this UI path nor the batch-get contract, which Canvas does not call.

- Session reconnects use the latest received `after_seq` cursor (`F06.reconnect`). For a local metadata check, retain the open page, send genuine `run:false` user events, record `/events/count`, restart the owned backend and inspect finite WebSocket lifecycle metadata: the reconnect cursor is the previous count minus one and a subsequent recovery marker appears once. This does not measure frame-body replay or Cloud behavior.
- Stop persists `paused` before an in-flight model request completes (`F06.stop-resume`); the persisted state and reloaded Stopped UI survive an Agent Server restart. A bounded credential-free check can use the tracked accept-only endpoint and an exact listener PID proven to descend from the owned launcher; never kill by pattern or resume the paused conversation.

features.description: an empty conversation shows "Let's start building!" with four suggestion chips; a chip fills the composer with its prompt.
user and agent bubbles; a long user message is clipped with a gradient and expands on click ("View More").
hovering a bubble shows Copy to clipboard; it copies the message's markdown source and the label flips to Copied to clipboard for 2 s.
hovering a fenced code block in an agent reply shows its own Copy button, which copies only the code.
hovering a bubble or tool title shows the event's local date and time.
a sent message shows "Sending..." until the server echoes it; a failed send shows Failed to send with Retry and Dismiss; Retry delivers it exactly once.
a message sent while the browser clock runs ahead of the server is still confirmed by the server echo: no lingering "Sending..." and no Retry.

a failed send keeps its Retry row after the backend returns and after leaving and reopening the conversation from the sidebar; sending the same text again succeeds without clearing it, and Retry then delivers that attempt exactly once.
agent replies render markdown: tables inside a horizontal scroller with edge fades, fenced code, inline code.
a workspace file path in an agent reply, and the path chip of a file-editor card, open that file in the Files tab.
model reasoning appears as a collapsed "Thinking" row that expands.
consecutive tool calls collapse into "N actions completed" (or "k/N actions completed" with a spinner while one is pending); expanding lists one titled row per action.
expanding a tool row shows a rich body: terminal command and output (non-zero exit badge `exit N`), file-editor path chip and content.
when the agent creates a Markdown file, its row stays expanded and ungrouped and shows a rendered, height-limited preview card with the file name and View, which opens the file in the Files tab.
task-tracker calls render a "Tasks" card with done / todo icons.
the stream shows one bubble per message event and one row per action, with no duplicates (compare with `conversation events`).

only the newest 50 events load first; the previous 50 are fetched when the user scrolls the transcript to its top (a "Fetching older messages…" row shows until they arrive) and automatically when the content is too short to scroll, so the first prompt and all actions appear.
scrolling up shows a scroll-to-bottom button; clicking it returns to the bottom and hides it.
while the agent runs, a chip above the composer names the current action ("Thinking", then the action title) and the composer status reads Running.
while a new conversation starts, a "Starting" pill shows above the composer.
Stop in the composer interrupts the agent, including a running tool call (status Stopped, play button, an Agent error row for the interrupted call); Play resumes it to completion.
reloading while the agent runs reattaches to the live run; it finishes without duplicated events.
when the Agent Server goes away the composer shows Disconnected; after it returns the page reconnects without a reload.
losing the server shows "Unable to connect to server" with Retry, Copy and Close; Retry reconnects once the server is back.
a conversation error (ConversationErrorEvent) surfaces as a warning banner and the composer status Error.

with confirmation mode on, a lock chip sits above the composer and each action waits for "Do you want to continue with this action?" with Cancel and Continue (hints `⇧⌘⌫` / `⌘↩` on macOS, `Ctrl+⇧+⌫` / `Ctrl+↩` elsewhere, hidden below 640 px); a cancelled action is marked Rejected and counts as resolved in its group.
Cmd+Enter or Ctrl+Enter continues and Shift+Cmd+Backspace or Shift+Ctrl+Backspace cancels a pending action.

hovering a message shows Branch from here; on an agent message it forks inclusively; on a user message it forks without that message and pre-fills its text in the new composer, ready to send. The branch is titled "<title> (branch)" and keeps working.
images sent with a message show as thumbnails in the bubble; expand opens a lightbox that closes with X or Escape.
after the agent installs a skill into the workspace, a banner offers "Start new conversation with this skill" (same workspace) and Close.
with no usable LLM, a conversation shows "Your LLM isn't set up yet..." with Set up LLM; suggestions are hidden and sending is disabled.

with the critic enabled, agent messages and the finishing action each carry a "Critic: agent success likelihood" block (stars labelled `Score: <N.N>%`, one decimal, with the percentage beside them); Expand details lists the issue categories (Potential Issues, Infrastructure, Likely Follow-up).
hook executions render as their own rows in the stream.

when the model answers with neither a message nor a tool call, the SDK's nudge (`Your last response did not include a function call or a message. …`) shows as a muted, italic `role=note` line with an info icon (`corrective-nudge-message`), not as a user bubble (#17864).
at 390 px the transcript fits the viewport; wide tables scroll inside their own container.

scenarios.name: F06--one-run-that-exercises-the-stream

scenarios.body: Run `control-openhands conversation start --prompt "Run the terminal command 'echo qa-f06-hello', then create a file qa_f06.txt containing the word hi. Finally reply with a markdown table with columns Step and Result (two rows) followed by a python code block that prints 1." --wait --timeout 300`, then `control-openhands browser testids 'testid=chat-interface'` and `control-openhands browser snapshot 'testid=agent-message'`. Compare with `control-openhands conversation events <id>`: one user and one agent `MessageEvent`, three `ActionEvent`s (`terminal`, `file_editor`, `canvas_ui_control`), matching one `user-message`, one group of three rows and one `agent-message`. The thinking row (`collapsible-thinking`) lives inside the group, so it is listed only after the next bullet expands it.

scenarios.name: F06--long-table-cell
scenarios.title: Long table cell
scenarios.body: On the stream conversation write a prompt file whose first line is `Reply with only the word OK. Do not run any tools.`, then a blank line and the table `| Name | Description | Status |`, `|---|---|---|`, `| Alpha | This is a really long sentence in a single cell that goes on and on to explain a very involved aspect of the system, which nobody could read on one line without scrolling forever to the right. | ok |`, `| Beta | brief | fail |`. Run `control-openhands browser fill 'testid=chat-input' x --value-file <file>`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=submit-button'` and `control-openhands conversation wait <id> --fresh --timeout 120`; the user bubble renders the table. scenarios.name: F06--non-zero-exit-badge

Then reply OK."`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=submit-button'` and `control-openhands conversation wait <id> --fresh --timeout 150` (without `--fresh` it returns the previous run's `finished` at once). If the reply's actions render as a single row, run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=chat-scroll-container >> role=button[name="Expand"][exact] >> nth=-1'`; if they render as a group (`browser count 'testid=event-group'` grew, e.g. `2 actions completed` after a terminal reset and rerun), run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=event-group-toggle >> nth=-1'` and `control-openhands browser click 'testid=event-group-content >> nth=-1 >> role=button[name="Expand"][exact] >> nth=-1'`. Repeating the check in the same conversation needs a new directory name and a count that grows, because an earlier expanded badge stays on the page.

scenarios.name: F06--server-lost-banner-failed-send-reconnect

scenarios.body: With a conversation open run `control-openhands service stop agent-server` and `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=error-message-banner' --timeout 20000`: the banner reads `Unable to connect to server` with `error-message-banner-retry`, `-copy` and `-dismiss`; the composer shows `Disconnected`. Poll `control-openhands browser text 'testid=interactive-chat-box'` every 10 s: within about a minute after `restart` returns it no longer contains `Disconnected` (reconnected without reload). `control-openhands browser click 'testid=chat-message-retry'`, `control-openhands conversation wait <id> --timeout 120`, then `control-openhands conversation events <id> --kinds MessageEvent`: `Reply with only the word PONG.` appears once and the last `agent-message` is `PONG`.

Poll `control-openhands browser text 'testid=interactive-chat-box'` every 10 s: within about a minute after `restart` returns it no longer contains `Disconnected` (reconnected without reload). `control-openhands browser click 'testid=chat-message-retry'`, `control-openhands conversation wait <id> --timeout 120`, then `control-openhands conversation events <id> --kinds MessageEvent`: `Reply with only the word PONG.` appears once and the last `agent-message` is `PONG`.
