notes: Known issue [#16842](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/16842) (`F06.reconnect`): A late close from a replaced WebSocket marks the active connection disconnected. Live prerequisite: A transport fixture delaying an old socket close until its replacement is open; ordinary server restart cannot select that ordering.

Known issue [#15527](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/15527) (`F06.reconnect`): Canvas briefly shows "disconnected" when coming back to an idle tab. Live prerequisite: The original custom-domain deployment, idle duration and tab-suspension/network transition; those details are missing.

Known failure [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5635](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5635) (`F06.reconnect`), reproduced 2026-10-12 at `fa1f724ab573` with SDK 1.54.0 and Chromium 153.0.8010.12: sandbox pause returned 204 but an already communicating session socket remained open for more than 10 seconds. A new Canvas tab received a subsequent `run:false` marker while the original tab did not. DELETE returned 200 and GET returned 404, yet both held sockets remained open for more than 10 seconds; Canvas later redirected by metadata polling. Recipe: open an idle dummy-profile conversation and confirm its marker/socket; POST `/api/conversations/prepare-for-sandbox-pause`, retain the original tab for 10 seconds, open a second tab, POST a new unique user event with `run:false`, then compare the two transcripts. DELETE the owned conversation and read lifecycle metadata for another 10 seconds. Use `--run <run>` and `browser events --kinds websocket-created,websocket-open,websocket-close --last 100`; no frame bodies or auth data are recorded. Evidence: `backfill-18309-surface-rechecks/F06.reconnect/pause-delete-sockets-5635.json`, `pause-new-tab-5635.png`, `pause-stale-tab-5635.png`. The expected socket shutdown/reconnect remains unchanged; polling recovery must not be mistaken for socket closure.

Known issue [#18445](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/18445) (`F06.load-older-history`, `F06.reconnect`): a failed initial Cloud history search can be swallowed into an empty page while the runtime count succeeds, advancing `after_seq` past history that was never displayed. Live prerequisite: a Cloud account and owned conversation with a genuinely failing App API `events/search` and a successful runtime `events/count`. The Local failure path throws instead and is not an equivalent check.

scenarios.name: F06--failed-send-survives-leaving
scenarios.title: Failed send survives leaving
scenarios.body: With `/conversations/<id>` open and healthy, run `control-openhands service stop agent-server`, `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=error-message-banner' --timeout 20000`, `control-openhands browser fill 'testid=chat-input' 'Reply with only: retry-ok'` and `control-openhands browser click 'testid=submit-button' --observe '[data-testid=chat-message-sending],[data-testid=chat-message-error]' --observe-ms 8000`: `Sending...` turns into `Failed to send Retry Dismiss` and `control-openhands browser count 'testid=chat-message-retry'` is `1` (`control-openhands browser screenshot 'testid=chat-interface' --feature F06.failed-send-persists --name failed-before-leaving`). Run `control-openhands restart` and `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=error-message-banner' --state hidden --timeout 90000` (the page reconnects by itself; `testid=error-message-banner-retry` hurries it while the banner is still up): the Retry row is still there (count `1`). Leave through the sidebar and come back: `control-openhands browser click 'role=link[name="New Chat"]'`, `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=home-chat-launcher'`, `control-openhands browser click 'a[href*="/conversations/<id>"] >> nth=0' --expect-url '/conversations/<id>'`, `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=user-message'`; `control-openhands browser count 'testid=chat-message-retry'` is still `1` after the history reloaded (`control-openhands browser screenshot 'testid=chat-interface' --feature F06.failed-send-persists --name retry-after-reopen`). Send the same text again (fill `Reply with only: retry-ok`, click `testid=submit-button` with the same `--observe`): the new bubble goes `Sending...` and settles while `Failed to send Retry Dismiss` stays; `control-openhands browser count 'testid=chat-message-sending'` is `0`, `control-openhands browser count 'testid=chat-message-retry'` is `1`, and the rows of `control-openhands conversation events <id> --kinds MessageEvent --grep 'retry-ok'` whose `source` is `user` number exactly one, `Reply with only: retry-ok` (in a model-free run `count` is `1`; with a model the agent's `retry-ok` reply matches the grep too, so count the `user` rows, not `count`). Then `control-openhands browser click 'testid=chat-message-retry'` and `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=chat-message-retry' --state detached --timeout 15000`: `control-openhands browser count 'testid=chat-message-sending'` is `0` and the same `--grep` now lists exactly two `user` rows `Reply with only: retry-ok` (one per attempt, none duplicated). scenarios.name: F06--live-chip-stop-and-resume
scenarios.title: Live chip, stop and resume
scenarios.body: Run `control-openhands conversation start --prompt "Run exactly one terminal command: sleep 25 && echo qa-slept. Then reply with only its output."` (no `--wait`), `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=live-activity-chip' --timeout 30000` and `control-openhands browser text 'testid=live-activity-chip'`: first `Thinking`, then the action title (e.g. `Run sleep 25 then echo qa-slept`); `browser text 'testid=interactive-chat-box'` contains `Running`. Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=stop-button'`: `control-openhands conversation status <id>` is `paused`, the composer reads `Stopped`, `count 'testid=play-button'` is `1` and the chip is gone. Stop interrupts the running `sleep` too: `control-openhands conversation events <id>` shows an `AgentErrorEvent` (`Tool call interrupted before completion. The conversation was paused.`) followed by an `InterruptEvent`, and `browser text 'testid=chat-scroll-container'` shows an `Agent error` row under the action title. Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=play-button'`: status `running`, then `control-openhands conversation wait <id> --timeout 120` ends `finished` with a new agent `MessageEvent` (the model reports that the command was interrupted; `qa-slept` never prints).
scenarios.raw: **Live chip, stop and resume (`F06.live-activity`, `F06.stop-resume`).** Run `control-openhands conversation start --prompt "Run exactly one terminal command: sleep 25 && echo qa-slept. Then reply with only its output."` (no `--wait`), `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=live-activity-chip' --timeout 30000` and `control-openhands browser text 'testid=live-activity-chip'`: first `Thinking`, then the action title (e.g. `Run sleep 25 then echo qa-slept`); `browser text 'testid=interactive-chat-box'` contains `Running`. Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=stop-button'`: `control-openhands conversation status <id>` is `paused`, the composer reads `Stopped`, `count 'testid=play-button'` is `1` and the chip is gone. Stop interrupts the running `sleep` too: `control-openhands conversation events <id>` shows an `AgentErrorEvent` (`Tool call interrupted before completion. The conversation was paused.`) followed by an `InterruptEvent`, and `browser text 'testid=chat-scroll-container'` shows an `Agent error` row under the action title. Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=play-button'`: status `running`, then `control-openhands conversation wait <id> --timeout 120` ends `finished` with a new agent `MessageEvent` (the model reports that the command was interrupted; `qa-slept` never prints).
expected: while the agent runs, a chip above the composer names the current action ("Thinking", then the action title) and the composer status reads Running.
Stop in the composer interrupts the agent, including a running tool call (status Stopped, play button, an Agent error row for the interrupted call); Play resumes it to completion.
notes: Known issue [#16719](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/16719) (`F06.live-activity`): Agent status always says "thinking" even when nothing is happening. Live prerequisite: The event/status trace and deterministic stalled or errored state from the original report; its trigger is unspecified.

Known issue [#16582](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/16582) (`F06.stop-resume`): After reconnect, a maximum-iteration error can fail to pause the agent through the legacy event handler. Live prerequisite: A maximum-iteration legacy error delivered after socket replacement, with a real model run reaching that limit.

Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#4990](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/4990) (`F06.stop-resume`): An ACP turn can keep executing tool calls while the UI already reports Paused. Live prerequisite: An authenticated Claude Code ACP turn executing separate marker-writing tools while Pause is pressed.

Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#4777](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/4777) (`F06.stop-resume`): Stop can still start a queued tool after it finishes waiting on a resource lock. Live prerequisite: A live batch with a second real tool waiting on a declared-resource lock when Stop is pressed.

Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5969](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5969) (`F06.stop-resume`): a conversation can report finished but reject Play with already-running, or delay a follow-up, while a slow event webhook is still pending. Live prerequisite: a genuinely successful model run on an owned backend with a bounded slow webhook receiver, then Play or send during that completion window.

scenarios.name: F06--reload-mid-run
scenarios.title: Reload mid-run
scenarios.body: Run `control-openhands conversation start --prompt "Run exactly one terminal command: sleep 15 && echo qa-reloaded. Then reply with only its output."`, wait for `testid=live-activity-chip`, then `control-openhands browser reload`. The composer still reads `Running` and the chip is back. After `control-openhands conversation wait <id> --timeout 120`: `testid=agent-message` is `qa-reloaded`, `count 'testid=user-message'` is `1`, `control-openhands browser eval "document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=chat-scroll-container] [data-testid=generic-event-message-title]').length"` is `1`.
scenarios.raw: **Reload mid-run (`F06.reload-mid-run`).** Run `control-openhands conversation start --prompt "Run exactly one terminal command: sleep 15 && echo qa-reloaded. Then reply with only its output."`, wait for `testid=live-activity-chip`, then `control-openhands browser reload`. The composer still reads `Running` and the chip is back. After `control-openhands conversation wait <id> --timeout 120`: `testid=agent-message` is `qa-reloaded`, `count 'testid=user-message'` is `1`, `control-openhands browser eval "document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=chat-scroll-container] [data-testid=generic-event-message-title]').length"` is `1`.
expected: reloading while the agent runs reattaches to the live run; it finishes without duplicated events.
notes: Known issue [#15606](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/15606) (`F06.reload-mid-run`): When re-loading ACP conversations, messages disappear or move. Live prerequisite: An authenticated Codex ACP session emitting intermediate messages while another window reloads history.

Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#4077](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/4077) (`F06.reload-mid-run`): Retried or late streaming deltas can duplicate live text; a stalled subscriber can delay Stop and finalization. Live prerequisite: A working stream interrupted/retried or delivered to a controlled stalled subscriber, with delta/state-order capture.

scenarios.name: F06--older-history

Then reply DONE." --wait --timeout 400` (note `<history-id>`); `control-openhands conversation events <history-id> --last 500` reports a count above 50. The other trigger is the user scrolling to the top, driven without a model on the dummy profile from Preconditions (`qa-zeta` active; in a keyed run create and activate it with that same `llm set` command for this bullet, then re-run `control-openhands llm preset deepseek` and remove it with `control-openhands api DELETE /api/profiles/qa-zeta --write`, so later families still count two profiles; arrange, not proof). Run `control-openhands conversation start --prompt "qa older 1"` (no `--wait`; note `<older-id>`), then `for N in $(seq 2 30); do control-openhands conversation send <older-id> --prompt "qa older $N"; done`: every send is accepted while the agent sits in error, about 1.5 s apiece (42 s for the 29 here), and each refused message adds five events (a `MessageEvent`, three `ConversationStateUpdateEvent`s, a `ConversationErrorEvent`), so the conversation ends with about 150 events (152 here). `control-openhands conversation events <older-id> --last 500` reports `"total": 152`, `"pages": 2`, `"more": false` (both server pages read, see Gotchas); its first row is the `SystemPromptEvent` and the first `MessageEvent` is `qa older 1`, while `--last 25` reports `"pages": 1`, `"more": true` and starts at `qa older 26`. Run `control-openhands browser network --clear`, `control-openhands browser reload`, `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=chat-input'`, then `control-openhands browser network --filter 'events/search' --last 10`: two requests, `?limit=50&sort_order=TIMESTAMP_DESC` and one with `timestamp__lt=<ts of qa older 21>`, because the newest 50 events hold only ten bubbles, shorter than the viewport, so the automatic fetch ran once and then stopped. `control-openhands browser count 'testid=user-message'` is `20`, `control-openhands browser text 'testid=chat-scroll-container'` starts `qa older 11` and holds none of `qa older 1`…`qa older 10`, and `control-openhands browser bbox 'testid=chat-scroll-container'` has `scrollHeight` `1576` against `clientHeight` `814`: taller than the viewport, so the third page waits for the user. Run `control-openhands browser scroll 'testid=chat-scroll-container' --by -100000`: `control-openhands browser network --filter 'events/search' --last 5` gains a request with `timestamp__lt=<ts of qa older 11>`, `control-openhands browser count 'testid=user-message'` is `29` and the text starts `qa older 2` (that page held messages 2–10 plus the tail of the first message's events; not seen in two runs: if the first refusal ever logs six events instead of seven, the arithmetic gives count `30`, text `qa older 1` and a last page of only the `SystemPromptEvent`), and the view stays on `qa older 11`: `control-openhands browser eval "document.querySelector('[data-testid=chat-scroll-container]').scrollTop"` is `684`, the height of the prepended rows. Scroll to the top again the same way: a fourth request (`timestamp__lt=` the oldest loaded event), the count is `30`, the text starts `qa older 1` and `scrollTop` is `76` (`control-openhands browser screenshot 'testid=chat-interface' --feature F06.load-older-history --name scroll-top-loaded-qa-older-1`). A third scroll adds no request: the short page ended the paging. `control-openhands browser count 'testid=loading-older-events'` is `0` after each scroll because the `Fetching older messages…` row lasts a few tens of milliseconds on a local stack; to see it, scroll with `control-openhands browser scroll 'testid=chat-scroll-container' --by -100000 --observe 'testid=loading-older-events' --observe-ms 1500` instead (both scrolls were driven this way here, with the same counts), whose `observed` goes `<absent>` at `0` ms, `Fetching older messages…` at about 20 ms and `<absent>` again within about 40 to 120 ms (`116` ms on the first scroll, `39` on the second; `observedBy` `mutation`); the `timestamp__lt=` network rows remain the durable proof. Return to the 16-command conversation for the next bullet: `control-openhands browser goto /conversations/<history-id>` and `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=chat-input'`.

expected: only the newest 50 events load first; the previous 50 are fetched when the user scrolls the transcript to its top (a "Fetching older messages…" row shows until they arrive) and automatically when the content is too short to scroll, so the first prompt and all actions appear.
notes: Known issue [#17559](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/17559) (`F06.load-older-history`): History pagination can show both an action and its observation (ready-for-dev companion to #16947). Live prerequisite: a Cloud account and owned conversation with a genuinely failing App API `events/search` and a successful runtime `events/count`. The Local failure path throws instead and is not an equivalent check.

scenarios.name: F06--scroll-to-bottom
scenarios.title: Scroll to bottom
scenarios.body: On the 16-command conversation (`<history-id>`; in a model-free run this bullet is blocked with the automatic-fetch half, prerequisite `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`), `control-openhands browser click 'testid=event-group-toggle'` makes the transcript taller than the viewport while the view stays where it was. Run `control-openhands browser scroll 'testid=chat-scroll-container' --by 2000` first (the button only reacts to scroll events, so a page that is already at the top never shows it): `count 'testid=scroll-to-bottom'` is `0`. Run `control-openhands browser scroll 'testid=chat-scroll-container' --by -2000`; the count is `1`. `control-openhands browser click 'testid=scroll-to-bottom'`, then the count is `0` and `control-openhands browser eval "(()=>{const e=document.querySelector('[data-testid=chat-scroll-container]');return Math.round(e.scrollHeight-e.scrollTop-e.clientHeight)})()"` is `0`.
scenarios.raw: **Scroll to bottom (`F06.scroll-to-bottom`).** On the 16-command conversation (`<history-id>`; in a model-free run this bullet is blocked with the automatic-fetch half, prerequisite `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`), `control-openhands browser click 'testid=event-group-toggle'` makes the transcript taller than the viewport while the view stays where it was. Run `control-openhands browser scroll 'testid=chat-scroll-container' --by 2000` first (the button only reacts to scroll events, so a page that is already at the top never shows it): `count 'testid=scroll-to-bottom'` is `0`. Run `control-openhands browser scroll 'testid=chat-scroll-container' --by -2000`; the count is `1`. `control-openhands browser click 'testid=scroll-to-bottom'`, then the count is `0` and `control-openhands browser eval "(()=>{const e=document.querySelector('[data-testid=chat-scroll-container]');return Math.round(e.scrollHeight-e.scrollTop-e.clientHeight)})()"` is `0`.
expected: scrolling up shows a scroll-to-bottom button; clicking it returns to the bottom and hides it.

scenarios.name: F06--confirmation-mode-on
scenarios.title: Confirmation mode on
scenarios.body: Arrange through the settings UI, in this order (the Security Analyzer field appears only once Confirmation Mode is on): `control-openhands browser goto /settings/verification`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=verification-settings-screen >> text=Confirmation Mode'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=sdk-section-all-toggle'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=verification-settings-screen >> role=button[name="Show suggestions"]'`, `control-openhands browser click 'role=listbox >> role=option[name="None"]'`, `control-openhands browser value 'testid=verification-settings-screen >> role=combobox[name="Security Analyzer"]'` (`None`), `control-openhands browser click 'testid=verification-settings-screen >> testid=save-button'`; `control-openhands api GET /api/settings` shows `"confirmation_mode": true` and `"security_analyzer": "none"` (None means every action is confirmed; the default LLM analyzer only stops HIGH-risk actions, so `echo` would run unprompted). Run `control-openhands conversation start --prompt "Run the terminal command 'echo qa-confirm-ok' and reply with its output." --wait --timeout 180`: it returns `"status": "waiting_for_confirmation"`. `control-openhands browser text 'testid=chat-scroll-container'` ends `Do you want to continue with this action? Cancel Ctrl+⇧+⌫ Continue Ctrl+↩` on Linux (`Cancel ⇧⌘⌫ Continue ⌘↩` on macOS, #18127), `control-openhands browser tooltip 'testid=action-confirm-button'` is `Confirm the requested action`, and a lock icon sits above the composer (screenshot). The tooltip stays open over the Cancel button, so move the pointer first: `control-openhands browser hover 'testid=chat-input'`. Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=action-reject-button'`: status `idle`, the buttons are gone, `conversation events <id> --last 6` ends with `UserRejectObservation`, and the action's row reads `Rejected` (`control-openhands browser count 'testid=rejected-indicator'` is `1`) with no spinner. Send `Run the terminal command 'echo qa-confirm-two' and reply with its output.` through `testid=chat-input` / `testid=submit-button`, `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=action-confirm-button' --timeout 20000`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=action-confirm-button'`; about 15 s later the status is `finished` and the events contain the observation `qa-confirm-two`. A rejection inside a group resolves it too: send `Run the terminal command 'echo qa-g1'. After it finishes, run the terminal command 'echo qa-g2' as a separate tool call. Then reply DONE.`, continue the first action (`browser wait 'testid=action-confirm-button'`, then `control-openhands browser press Control+Enter`, which is also the next bullet's shortcut) and cancel the second (`browser wait 'testid=action-confirm-button' --timeout 60000`, `control-openhands browser press Control+Shift+Backspace`): status `idle`, `control-openhands browser text 'testid=event-group >> nth=-1'` ends `2 actions completed`, `control-openhands browser count 'testid=event-group >> nth=-1 >> .animate-spin'` is `0`, the same after `browser reload`, and the expanded group (`control-openhands browser click 'testid=event-group >> nth=-1 >> button >> nth=0'`) shows `Rejected` on the `qa-g2` row (`browser screenshot 'testid=chat-interface' --feature F06.confirmation-mode --name group-after-reload`). Each button keeps its label and hint on one line: while the prompt is waiting, `control-openhands browser eval "[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=action-reject-button],[data-testid=action-confirm-button]')].map(b=>b.offsetHeight+'/'+b.scrollHeight).join(' ')"` is `26/26 26/26` at desktop, also with the side panel open (`testid=right-panel-toggle`). At phone width (`browser viewport phone`) the shortcut hints are hidden (no hardware keyboard), the buttons read `Cancel` and `Continue`, and `browser text 'testid=chat-scroll-container'` ends `Do you want to continue with this action? Cancel Continue` (screenshot the awaiting prompt at phone width).
scenarios.raw: **Confirmation mode on (`F06.confirmation-mode`).** Arrange through the settings UI, in this order (the Security Analyzer field appears only once Confirmation Mode is on): `control-openhands browser goto /settings/verification`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=verification-settings-screen >> text=Confirmation Mode'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=sdk-section-all-toggle'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=verification-settings-screen >> role=button[name="Show suggestions"]'`, `control-openhands browser click 'role=listbox >> role=option[name="None"]'`, `control-openhands browser value 'testid=verification-settings-screen >> role=combobox[name="Security Analyzer"]'` (`None`), `control-openhands browser click 'testid=verification-settings-screen >> testid=save-button'`; `control-openhands api GET /api/settings` shows `"confirmation_mode": true` and `"security_analyzer": "none"` (None means every action is confirmed; the default LLM analyzer only stops HIGH-risk actions, so `echo` would run unprompted). Run `control-openhands conversation start --prompt "Run the terminal command 'echo qa-confirm-ok' and reply with its output." --wait --timeout 180`: it returns `"status": "waiting_for_confirmation"`. `control-openhands browser text 'testid=chat-scroll-container'` ends `Do you want to continue with this action? Cancel Ctrl+⇧+⌫ Continue Ctrl+↩` on Linux (`Cancel ⇧⌘⌫ Continue ⌘↩` on macOS, #18127), `control-openhands browser tooltip 'testid=action-confirm-button'` is `Confirm the requested action`, and a lock icon sits above the composer (screenshot). The tooltip stays open over the Cancel button, so move the pointer first: `control-openhands browser hover 'testid=chat-input'`. Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=action-reject-button'`: status `idle`, the buttons are gone, `conversation events <id> --last 6` ends with `UserRejectObservation`, and the action's row reads `Rejected` (`control-openhands browser count 'testid=rejected-indicator'` is `1`) with no spinner. Send `Run the terminal command 'echo qa-confirm-two' and reply with its output.` through `testid=chat-input` / `testid=submit-button`, `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=action-confirm-button' --timeout 20000`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=action-confirm-button'`; about 15 s later the status is `finished` and the events contain the observation `qa-confirm-two`. A rejection inside a group resolves it too: send `Run the terminal command 'echo qa-g1'. After it finishes, run the terminal command 'echo qa-g2' as a separate tool call. Then reply DONE.`, continue the first action (`browser wait 'testid=action-confirm-button'`, then `control-openhands browser press Control+Enter`, which is also the next bullet's shortcut) and cancel the second (`browser wait 'testid=action-confirm-button' --timeout 60000`, `control-openhands browser press Control+Shift+Backspace`): status `idle`, `control-openhands browser text 'testid=event-group >> nth=-1'` ends `2 actions completed`, `control-openhands browser count 'testid=event-group >> nth=-1 >> .animate-spin'` is `0`, the same after `browser reload`, and the expanded group (`control-openhands browser click 'testid=event-group >> nth=-1 >> button >> nth=0'`) shows `Rejected` on the `qa-g2` row (`browser screenshot 'testid=chat-interface' --feature F06.confirmation-mode --name group-after-reload`). Each button keeps its label and hint on one line: while the prompt is waiting, `control-openhands browser eval "[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=action-reject-button],[data-testid=action-confirm-button]')].map(b=>b.offsetHeight+'/'+b.scrollHeight).join(' ')"` is `26/26 26/26` at desktop, also with the side panel open (`testid=right-panel-toggle`). At phone width (`browser viewport phone`) the shortcut hints are hidden (no hardware keyboard), the buttons read `Cancel` and `Continue`, and `browser text 'testid=chat-scroll-container'` ends `Do you want to continue with this action? Cancel Continue` (screenshot the awaiting prompt at phone width).
expected: with confirmation mode on, a lock chip sits above the composer and each action waits for "Do you want to continue with this action?" with Cancel and Continue (hints `⇧⌘⌫` / `⌘↩` on macOS, `Ctrl+⇧+⌫` / `Ctrl+↩` elsewhere, hidden below 640 px); a cancelled action is marked Rejected and counts as resolved in its group.
notes: Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5092](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5092) (`F06.confirmation-mode`): A revocation message sent while waiting for confirmation can implicitly approve the pending action. Live prerequisite: A working model proposing a real confirmation-gated marker action, then a revocation user message.

Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#4532](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/4532) (`F06.confirmation-mode`): After restarting while awaiting confirmation, approval can execute the tool but the next model request omits its assistant call. Live prerequisite: A real confirmation-paused action persisted across backend restart, then approval and a working provider call.

scenarios.name: F06--branch-from-here
scenarios.title: Branch from here
scenarios.body: Open a conversation with at least two exchanges (the OK/PONG one above): `control-openhands browser goto /conversations/<id>` with its id (the previous bullet left `/settings/verification`). Agent message: `control-openhands browser hover 'testid=agent-message >> nth=0'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=agent-message >> nth=0 >> role=button[name="Branch from here"]' --expect-url '/conversations/(?!<id>)'`; after `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=user-message'` (the history mounts a moment after the URL changes, so an immediate count reads `0`) the new conversation has `count 'testid=user-message'` `1`, the agent message `OK`, and `browser eval "document.title"` contains `(branch)`. User message (edit): back on the OK/PONG conversation (`control-openhands browser goto /conversations/<id>`; the branch above has one user message), `control-openhands browser hover 'testid=user-message >> nth=1'` and `control-openhands browser click 'testid=user-message >> nth=1 >> role=button[name="Branch from here"]' --observe '[data-testid=chat-input]' --observe-ms 4000`: `observed` shows the composer change from empty to `Reply with only the word PONG.` and stay. The new conversation (`<branch-id>` from `browser url`) omits that message, `control-openhands browser text 'testid=chat-input'` is `Reply with only the word PONG.`, and nothing was sent: `control-openhands conversation events <branch-id> --kinds MessageEvent` lists only the copied first exchange (count `2`: the long message that starts `Reply with only the word OK.`, then `OK`; no `PONG`). `control-openhands browser enabled 'testid=submit-button'` should be `true` with the prefilled text; today it is `false` until the text is edited or the page is reloaded (see Gotchas). Send it with `control-openhands browser press Enter --selector 'testid=chat-input'` (Enter sends whatever the Send button's state is) and `control-openhands conversation wait <branch-id> --fresh --timeout 120`: expected `finished` with a reply; today it ends `error` (Agent Server bug, see Gotchas).
scenarios.raw: **Branch from here (`F06.branch-from-here`).** Open a conversation with at least two exchanges (the OK/PONG one above): `control-openhands browser goto /conversations/<id>` with its id (the previous bullet left `/settings/verification`). Agent message: `control-openhands browser hover 'testid=agent-message >> nth=0'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=agent-message >> nth=0 >> role=button[name="Branch from here"]' --expect-url '/conversations/(?!<id>)'`; after `control-openhands browser wait 'testid=user-message'` (the history mounts a moment after the URL changes, so an immediate count reads `0`) the new conversation has `count 'testid=user-message'` `1`, the agent message `OK`, and `browser eval "document.title"` contains `(branch)`. User message (edit): back on the OK/PONG conversation (`control-openhands browser goto /conversations/<id>`; the branch above has one user message), `control-openhands browser hover 'testid=user-message >> nth=1'` and `control-openhands browser click 'testid=user-message >> nth=1 >> role=button[name="Branch from here"]' --observe '[data-testid=chat-input]' --observe-ms 4000`: `observed` shows the composer change from empty to `Reply with only the word PONG.` and stay. The new conversation (`<branch-id>` from `browser url`) omits that message, `control-openhands browser text 'testid=chat-input'` is `Reply with only the word PONG.`, and nothing was sent: `control-openhands conversation events <branch-id> --kinds MessageEvent` lists only the copied first exchange (count `2`: the long message that starts `Reply with only the word OK.`, then `OK`; no `PONG`). `control-openhands browser enabled 'testid=submit-button'` should be `true` with the prefilled text; today it is `false` until the text is edited or the page is reloaded (see Gotchas). Send it with `control-openhands browser press Enter --selector 'testid=chat-input'` (Enter sends whatever the Send button's state is) and `control-openhands conversation wait <branch-id> --fresh --timeout 120`: expected `finished` with a reply; today it ends `error` (Agent Server bug, see Gotchas).
expected: hovering a message shows Branch from here; on an agent message it forks inclusively; on a user message it forks without that message and pre-fills its text in the new composer, ready to send. The branch is titled "<title> (branch)" and keeps working.
notes: Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5465](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5465) (`F06.branch-from-here`): Branch from here can lose encrypted LLM credentials, so the fork fails its first turn with LLMAuthenticationError. Live prerequisite: A working cipher-backed model conversation, then fork and a successful turn on the fork.

Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5806](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5806) (`F06.branch-from-here`): editing a displayed user message first reads its parent event; if that event has become unreadable/missing on the server, the action can fail with 500 instead of a missing-event response. Live prerequisite: an owned persisted conversation with a still-displayed user message whose event storage is missing, followed by the actual Edit action. A random unknown-ID API call proves neither this UI path nor the batch-get contract, which Canvas does not call.

scenarios.name: F06--error-events
scenarios.title: Error events
scenarios.body: Any run that ends in a `ConversationErrorEvent` (today: any message sent in a branched conversation) leaves `conversation wait <id>` at `"status": "error"`; `control-openhands browser testids 'testid=chat-interface'` lists `error-message-banner` with `warning-message-banner-icon` and the error's text, and the composer status reads `Error`. Read the code with `control-openhands api GET "/api/conversations/<id>/events/search?limit=3&sort_order=TIMESTAMP_DESC"`.
scenarios.raw: **Error events (`F06.error-events`).** Any run that ends in a `ConversationErrorEvent` (today: any message sent in a branched conversation) leaves `conversation wait <id>` at `"status": "error"`; `control-openhands browser testids 'testid=chat-interface'` lists `error-message-banner` with `warning-message-banner-icon` and the error's text, and the composer status reads `Error`. Read the code with `control-openhands api GET "/api/conversations/<id>/events/search?limit=3&sort_order=TIMESTAMP_DESC"`.
expected: a conversation error (ConversationErrorEvent) surfaces as a warning banner and the composer status Error.
notes: Known issue [#16686](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/16686) (`F06.error-events`): LLM errors not propagated to the frontend. Live prerequisite: A Nebius credential and its rejected DeepSeek-V3 request, or the original complete emitted error fixture.

Known issue [#15626](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/15626) (`F06.error-events`): Conversation can fail with LiteLLM auth error when database server at 127.0.0.1:5432 is unreachable. Live prerequisite: The original LiteLLM proxy/database-failure event or a disposable proxy with its PostgreSQL dependency unavailable.

Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5447](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5447) (`F06.error-events`): An Anthropic Claude Opus5.5 conversation can fail with400 when its next request ends in an assistant prefill. Live prerequisite: Anthropic Claude Opus5.5 credentials and a real trailing-assistant-prefill request.

Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5225](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5225) (`F06.error-events`): A provider-rejected image tool result can leave the conversation permanently failing on every resume. Live prerequisite: A real provider-rejected poisoned image tool_result in a disposable persisted history, followed by retry.

Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#4965](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/4965) (`F06.error-events`): A strict OpenAI-compatible provider can reject blank content in the saved history, preventing later turns. Live prerequisite: A strict OpenAI-compatible provider and a real history containing blank text or empty content arrays.

Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#4558](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/4558) (`F06.error-events`): A saved encrypted fallback profile can send ciphertext as its key and fail authentication, leaving only the primary error visible. Live prerequisite: A working encrypted saved fallback profile and real primary-model failure that triggers fallback resolution.

Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5740](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5740) (`F06.error-events`): a Responses display delta without `item_id` can terminate the turn with an AttributeError. Live prerequisite: the genuine provider/transformer streaming path producing that incomplete event; the report did not retain its original raw SSE. A credential-free parser diagnostic proves the SDK exception, not a Canvas model turn.

scenarios.name: F06--planner-discovery-with-many-children
scenarios.title: Planner discovery with many children
scenarios.body:
Expected: reloading a parent still discovers its `plannerparent`-tagged planner when it has100 child conversations. Known failure (reproduced 2026-10-16, SDK 1.55.0, [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5790](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5790)): the unchunked100-ID request returns500, shows `Internal Server Error` and omits the planner session connection. A99-child control returns200 and opens both planner and parent sockets. notes: Known issue [#17492](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/17492) (`F06.tool-visualizers`): Failed browser, glob, grep, and file editor tool calls render as successful in chat. Known issue [#17490](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/17490) (`F06.tool-visualizers`): Terminal commands that fail with an ordinary non-zero exit render as successful in chat. Live prerequisite: A working model producing a completed terminal command with nonzero exit_code and is_error=false.

Known issue [#16341](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/16341) (`F06.tool-visualizers`): Code-explorer subagent frequently errors. Live prerequisite: A working model with native code-explorer delegation and the original repository task; no delegated-tool output can be generated without credentials.

Live prerequisite: An Agent Server configured with the native Gemini edit tool set and a real tool edit of an invalid-UTF8 fixture; Gemini ACP uses a different external executor.

Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5096](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5096) (`F06.tool-visualizers`): The canonical agent file editor can replace a symlink instead of editing its target; Undo does not restore the link. Live prerequisite: A working model invoking canonical file-editor str_replace/insert through a real symlink, then undo.

Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5074](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5074) (`F06.tool-visualizers`): After server restart a native delegated child can remain Running while the parent loses its task mapping/result. Live prerequisite: A native delegated child still running during an owned server crash and parent recovery.

Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5038](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5038) (`F06.tool-visualizers`): The agent file editor can refuse valid Chinese UTF8 text as binary when its sample splits a character; Canvas Files uses a separate preview detector. Live prerequisite: A live canonical file-editor view/edit on the specific UTF8 sample alignment; Canvas Files preview uses a separate NUL sniff, not this validator.

Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#4983](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/4983) (`F06.tool-visualizers`): Agent grep can silently miss extended-regex matches when its runtime falls back to system grep. Live prerequisite: A runtime without ripgrep and a live agent grep call using extended regex and escaped literal punctuation.

Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#4668](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/4668) (`F06.tool-visualizers`): A planning editor card can lose old/new content and fail to show the complete edit diff. Live prerequisite: Concurrent real glob/tool calls in distinct workspaces with the Python fallback active.

Live prerequisite: Two native task-enabled conversations with same-name project subagent definitions and a working model for delegation.

families.title: Conversation page, header and management menu
families.overview:
The conversation page (`/conversations/<id>`) shows the chat pane: a header with
the runtime status dot, the editable title, the "..." management menu and the
Git actions, Overview and panel toggles, then the message history and the
composer. From the header a user renames, stops or resumes the runtime, opens
the skills, hooks and agent-tools dialogs, exports or downloads the
conversation, jumps to usage and deletes it.
families.entry:
- Sidebar conversation row (`conversation-card`), or the home composer submit, which navigates to the new conversation.
- Direct URL `/conversations/<id>`.
- Direct URL `/conversations/<id>/panel`, or the header panel button, at phone width (up to 1024 px); at desktop width that URL redirects to `/conversations/<id>` with the drawer open.
- Hovering a message in the history: **Branch from here** (local backends only).
- Chips under the composer (git control bar) for conversations in a git workspace (home **Open Workspace**).
- Header controls inside `testid=chat-pane-header`: the status dot (`server-status-menu-trigger`), the title (`conversation-name-title`), the "..." button (`ellipsis-button`, aria "More options"), `conversation-git-actions-toggle`, `conversation-overview-toggle`, `right-panel-toggle`.
families.given:
Preconditions:

- Baseline state (launched, doctored, `onboard --skip` done) and an active LLM profile (`control-openhands llm preset deepseek`).
- A finished conversation: `control-openhands conversation start --prompt "Reply with the single word: pong" --wait --timeout 240` prints its `<id>`.
- A running conversation for the active-only items: `control-openhands conversation start --prompt "Run the shell command: sleep 90 ; then reply with the word done" --wait --until running --timeout 120` prints `<running-id>`. It finishes after about 90 s, so start it right before `F07.stop-confirm` (after a Stop it stays `paused` until Start Runtime).
- A conversation in a git workspace for the git control bar: `control-openhands fixture git-repo --name qa-f07-repo`, then `control-openhands browser goto /` (`conversation start` left the browser on `<id>`), `control-openhands browser click 'testid=open-workspace-button'`, `control-openhands browser click 'role=dialog >> role=combobox[name="Select a workspace"]'`, `control-openhands browser click 'role=dialog >> role=button[name="+ Add Workspace"]'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=folder-browser-sidebar-workspace'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=folder-browser-up'` three times (to the run directory), `control-openhands browser click 'testid=folder-browser-entry-workspace'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=folder-browser-entry-qa-f07-repo'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=folder-browser-use'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=workspace-launch-button'`, then `control-openhands conversation start --prompt "Reply with the single word: ok" --stay --wait --timeout 240` prints `<git-id>`.
- An automation setup conversation for the setup-leaving bullet, made right after the finished conversation: `control-openhands browser goto /automations`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=automations-add-automation'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=automations-add-automation-create' --expect-url '/automations/setup'`, `control-openhands conversation start --stay --prompt 'Reply with only the word ok. Do not run any tools.' --wait --timeout 180` (prints `<setup-id>`), then `control-openhands browser goto /`.
- Cloud-only rows (`F07.cloud-only`) are blocked without an OpenHands Cloud account.
- Desktop viewport unless a bullet says otherwise.
families.gotchas:
- The stop and delete confirmation buttons carry `cancel-button` and `confirm-button`; role names inside `role=dialog` work too.
- `stop-button`, `show-skills-button`, `show-hooks-button` and `show-agent-tools-button` also exist in the composer, and `ellipsis-button` in sidebar rows: always scope to `testid=chat-pane-header` or `testid=conversation-name-context-menu`.
- Stop Runtime (status menu) and Stop Conversation (menu) both navigate to `/conversations`. On a finished local conversation the agent server keeps `finished`; use a running conversation to see `paused` and Start Runtime.
- Rename has no Escape-to-cancel: Escape leaves the input open and the next blur saves whatever was typed.
- Escape closes the status-dot menu, as it closes the "..." and Git actions menus (`browser count 'testid=server-status-context-menu'` is `0`). A menu opened by click or Enter returns focus to `server-status-menu-trigger`; one opened by hover closes without moving focus (focus left on a menu item falls to `body`). Touch taps cannot be driven with the CLI, so the tap path is unverified.
- The status menu reads `Running` / `Stop Runtime` for a finished local conversation too; only a paused one shows `Server Stopped` / `Start Runtime`.
- Panel and Overview columns animate: read their state with `browser wait <sel> --state hidden|visible`, not an immediate `browser visible`.
- The Skills dialog shows the list read with the page or at the last Refresh: a project skill added later appears after Refresh (or `browser reload`), not on reopening the dialog within 10 minutes. Its own text says to click Refresh.
- `tabs-pane-header` and `conversation-overview-column` stay in the DOM when hidden: assert with `browser visible` or `aria-pressed`, not `count`.
- `browser visible 'testid=usage-panel'` right after Display Usage and Cost can read `false`; `browser wait` first.
- Exports and the zip land in `<run>/private/downloads`; the transcript holds the prompts and the zip holds the full event store. Review before sharing.
- `--observe` accepts the same selector syntax as other verbs (`'testid=chat-messages-skeleton'`) as well as CSS.
- A sidebar row click lands on `/conversations/<id>?backend=default-local`: end `--expect-url` regexes without `$` there.
- `role=button[name="Pull"]` also matches `Pull Request`; add `[exact]`.
- The Open Workspace folder browser has no path field: walk it with `folder-browser-up` and `folder-browser-entry-<name>`. `fixture git-repo` puts the repo in `<run>/workspace`, three levels above the `workspace` favorite.
- The repo, branch and Pull/Push chips come from `git remote get-url origin` in the workspace, read when the page loads: reload after changing the remote.
- The Usage tab logs `GET /api/llm/balance` 404 on a local backend (F27); count it in `browser errors --app-only` but it is not an F07 failure.
- The Overview drawer has no Automations, Skills, MCP or Secrets sections. The Overview menu offers Workspace and Git rows only, and its drawer opens only Pull Requests (`F27.overview-drawer`).
- Dialogs move focus inside when they open and keep Tab inside: the Skills and Hooks dialogs start on their close button, Stop and Delete on `cancel-button`, Export on `close-transcript-export-modal`, Agent Tools on `close-system-message-modal`. In the Hooks dialog, focusing Refresh with Tab opens its tooltip, which takes the first Escape; a second Escape closes the dialog.
- The Hooks dialog shows the workspace's `hooks.json` as of its last read (its first open for the conversation after a page load, or Refresh), not the hooks the conversation started with: after the hooks steps above, `browser goto /conversations/<git-id>` (started before the file existed; its `hook_config` is `null`) and opening the dialog lists both events too. A reopen within 5 minutes of that read shows the same list and sends no request: click Refresh after editing `hooks.json`.
- A prompt- or agent-type hook shows its text under Commands (the `prompt`, or an agent hook's `system_prompt`). With the Hooks dialog closed (the hooks steps above end that way; otherwise `control-openhands browser click 'testid=close-hooks-modal'`), write `<run>/workspace/qa-f07-repo/.openhands/hooks.json` as `{"stop":[{"hooks":[{"type":"prompt","prompt":"QA_F07 prompt hook"}]}],"session_start":[{"hooks":[{"type":"agent","system_prompt":"QA_F07 agent hook"}]}]}`, run `control-openhands browser goto /conversations/<hooks-id>`, open the menu and `control-openhands browser click 'testid=conversation-name-context-menu >> testid=show-hooks-button'`, click `testid=hooks-modal >> testid=refresh-hooks`, then `role=button[name="Session Start 1 hook"]` and `role=button[name="Stop 1 hook"]` inside `testid=hooks-modal` (an event expanded before a Refresh stays expanded, and a second click collapses it, so start from a reopened dialog). In `control-openhands browser snapshot 'testid=hooks-modal'` they expand, in that order, to `Matcher * Commands QA_F07 agent hook Type: agent Timeout: 60s` and `Matcher * Commands QA_F07 prompt hook Type: prompt Timeout: 60s`, and `browser text 'testid=hooks-modal >> pre'` returns `QA_F07 agent hook` and `QA_F07 prompt hook` (`control-openhands browser screenshot --feature F07.hooks-modal --name prompt-agent-hooks`). An agent hook without `system_prompt` shows no box: with `{"session_start":[{"hooks":[{"type":"agent"}]}]}`, close, reopen and Refresh, `Session Start 1 hook` expands to `Matcher * Commands Type: agent Timeout: 60s` and `browser count 'testid=hooks-modal >> pre'` is `0`.
- An agent hook shows its `system_prompt`, the text it runs with, even when it also carries a `prompt`, and an agent hook with only a `prompt` shows no box. With `{"session_start":[{"hooks":[{"type":"agent","prompt":"QA_F07 stray prompt","system_prompt":"QA_F07 agent system prompt"}]}],"stop":[{"hooks":[{"type":"agent","prompt":"QA_F07 prompt only"}]}]}` in `hooks.json`, close, reopen and Refresh the dialog, then expand both events: `Session Start 1 hook` reads `Matcher * Commands QA_F07 agent system prompt Type: agent Timeout: 60s`, `Stop 1 hook` reads `Matcher * Commands Type: agent Timeout: 60s`, and `control-openhands browser count 'text=QA_F07 stray prompt'` and `browser count 'text=QA_F07 prompt only'` are `0` (`browser screenshot --feature F07.hooks-modal --name agent-hook-system-prompt`). Agent hooks in `hooks.json` really run on the next turn in that workspace (the session-start one shows a `Hook: SessionStart failed` row), so write the recipe's two-event `hooks.json` (`pre_tool_use` and `stop`) back and Refresh afterwards.
- With the Agent Server down, Refresh in the Hooks dialog shows its own fetch error (#18177): after `control-openhands service stop agent-server` on an open dialog, `refresh-hooks` and `browser wait 'testid=hooks-modal >> text=Failed to fetch hooks' --timeout 30000`, the dialog reads `Failed to fetch hooks. Please try again later.` under its explanation (`browser count 'testid=hooks-modal >> text=Failed to fetch skills'` is `0`). The 502s and the closed WebSocket that `browser errors --app-only` then lists are the outage itself. Run it last, or `restart` afterwards.
- After the user-message branch in `F07.branch-from-message`, Send stays disabled next to the prefilled text (`browser enabled 'testid=submit-button'` is `false`; Known failure #18202, see F05 Gotchas). Enter in the field sends it.
- Known issue [#18136](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/18136) (`F07.cloud-only`): Connect Repo on a cloud conversation does not save the repository on the server. Live prerequisite: An authenticated Cloud sandbox/repository provider and a second fresh browser to compare server repository metadata.
- Known issue [#17494](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/17494) (`F07.export-transcript`): Transcript export leaks raw i18n template for ACP tool calls without a title. Live prerequisite: An authenticated ACP session that emits a titleless tool call, then Markdown and HTML export.
- Known issue [#16876](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/16876) (`F07.history-skeleton`): Planning-agent history flag stays true forever when sub-conversations fetch fails — infinite chat loading skeleton. Live prerequisite: A real planning sub-conversation whose batch lookup fails or yields null, with the main history available.
- Known issue [#16727](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/16727) (`F07.open-by-url`): Conversation corrupted after VM restart: "Missing event file". Live prerequisite: A disposable VM interrupted at the event-write boundary or the original missing-event persisted fixture.
- Known issue [#16356](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/16356) (`F07.open-by-url`): Conversation LLM config is frozen at creation time — resuming after API key rotation fails permanently with LLMAuthenticationError. Live prerequisite: A working provider key that can be rotated/revoked, an existing conversation using it, and a replacement profile.
- Known issue [#15543](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/15543) (`F07.git-control-bar`): Bad parsing for branch retrieval. Live prerequisite: The original Git probe stdout/interleaving that temporarily puts a filename in the branch badge; dirty state alone is not a deterministic trigger.
- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5640](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5640) (`F07.download-zip`): Download conversation data can return404 after a warm-pool server initializes a custom conversation-storage path. Although closed upstream, the pinned SDK 1.55.0 still reads the default configuration path here; this remains a supported-version distinction, not a freshly reproduced failure. Live prerequisite: A deferred-init warm-pool Agent Server initialized with a non-default conversations_path; this launcher starts an already-initialized server.
- Known failure [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5629](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5629) (`F07.rename-inline`), reproduced 2026-10-12 at `fa1f724ab573`, SDK 1.54.0. A second server's native first load rewrote a newer saved title with its startup copy; the connected Canvas header showed that older title. Recipe: create an idle conversation on A and PATCH its title to `QA_SHARED_BEFORE_B_5629_REPEAT`; run pinned SDK Python `python .agents/skills/verify-openhands/scripts/fixtures/shared-storage-server.py --run <run> --seconds 300` in the background. It starts only a bounded no-editor SDK B sharing this run's conversation directory/cipher/session key; its private `server.json` supplies the port and owned operator/PGID. After B listens, PATCH A to `QA_SHARED_AFTER_B_5629_REPEAT` and confirm disk. Run `control-openhands service stop agent-server --run <run>`, then `python .../fixtures/shared-storage-server.py --run <run> --load-id <id>`: native B `/events/count` returned 200 and disk reverted to BEFORE_B. Restart A only to serve Canvas, choose default-local and doctor; use the Add Backend recipe from [F25](F25-backends-and-cloud.md) to connect B at its recorded port with the private key file, then open its card: the header reads BEFORE_B. SIGTERM only the recorded helper operator and verify its port/PGID gone; the helper also bounds runtime and terminates remaining group descendants. Evidence: `backfill-18309-surface-rechecks/F07.rename-inline/metadata-repeat-before-b-load-5629.json`, `metadata-repeat-after-b-load-5629.json`, `shared-first-load-reverted-5629.png`. The native first-load request is explicit; stale catalog display alone is insufficient proof of this overwrite.
- Known failure [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5539](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5539) (`F07.download-zip`), reproduced 2026-10-12 at `fa1f724ab573`, SDK 1.54.0: three real overlapping receivers of one idle conversation made 929 requests in 20 seconds, including 31 completed corrupt ZIPs with status 200, 106 server 500s, 269 ingress 502s and 133 RemoteProtocolErrors. A sequential 2,000-request control returned valid ZIPs. Recipe (use the pinned SDK Python with httpx): `python .agents/skills/verify-openhands/scripts/fixtures/download-trajectory-overlap.py --base-url <own-base-url> --conversation-id <id> --api-key-file <run>/private/session-key --output-dir <run>/private/trajectory-overlap --seconds 20 --clients 3 --rounds 5000 --slow-ms 2`. It enforces loopback, request/duration/network/uncompressed/member budgets and bounded CRC reads; aborts and unsupported archives remain unverified. While it runs, use `browser goto /conversations/<id>`, open `chat-pane-header >> ellipsis-button`, click `download-trajectory-button`, then `browser downloads --last 3 --inspect` (all CLI commands with `--run <run>`). That Canvas click downloaded an inspectable ZIP; its particular result is not claimed corrupt. Private raw samples stay private. Evidence: `backfill-18309-surface-rechecks/F07.download-zip/trajectory-overlap-5539-summary.json` and `overlapping-download-5539.png`. The summary correction excludes two ambiguous Content-Length differences that could be intentional deadline aborts; only completed corrupt ZIPs count as corrupt downloads.
- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5094](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5094) (`F07.open-by-url`): After ACP session/load fails, the backend can create a fresh model session while Canvas still shows the old context. Live prerequisite: An authenticated Codex ACP session whose original session/load fails while persisted history remains.

features.description: `/conversations/<id>` shows header, history and composer, and remembers the id as the backend's last conversation.
an unknown id toasts "This conversation does not exist…" and redirects to `/conversations`.
opening a conversation shows a message skeleton until its history has loaded.

at phone width (up to 1024 px) the header panel button opens `/conversations/<id>/panel`, the tabs panel full width with a Back button; wider, that URL redirects to `/conversations/<id>` with the drawer open beside the chat.
double-click the title (or menu Rename), Enter or blur saves with a toast; an empty value reverts.
hovering the status dot (or tapping it on touch) opens a menu with the state and Stop Runtime (active) or Start Runtime (paused).
the "..." menu opens under the title; Escape closes it and returns focus to "...", and so does an outside click (without the focus move).
Show Available Hooks and Stop Conversation appear only while the conversation is active.
Show Available Skills lists the loaded skills with expandable rows and Refresh.

Show Available Hooks lists the workspace's `.openhands/hooks.json` hooks by event (read when it first opens for a conversation after a page load, and on Refresh; a reopen within 5 minutes of the last read shows the cached list), or "No hooks configured for this conversation."

a workspace with `.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` adds a "Project skills" section above the public ones; each row expands to its triggers and body. The list is read with the page and on Refresh; opening the dialog within 10 minutes of the last read shows the cached list.
Show Agent Tools & Metadata shows the system message and the tool list.
Export… downloads a Markdown or HTML transcript with optional tool details and timestamps.
Download conversation data downloads `conversation_<id>.zip`.
Display Usage and Cost opens the right panel on the Usage tab.
Stop Conversation asks for confirmation; Confirm Close pauses the conversation and returns to `/conversations`.
Delete Conversation names the title in a confirmation; Cancel keeps it, Confirm Delete removes it and returns to `/conversations`.
Branch from here on a message forks the conversation as `<title> (branch)`; on a user message the message is left out and its text goes back into the composer.
the header panel button shows and hides the right tabs panel (closed again after a reload).
the header (i) button shows and hides the Overview column, which is exclusive with the right panel.

the header Git actions menu offers Commits, Pull, Push, Create PR and Create New Branch; each pre-fills the composer without sending, and Send becomes enabled so the user can submit or edit the prompt.
under the composer, a folder workspace shows an inert workspace chip and the branch; with a GitHub `origin` the repo and branch chips link to GitHub and Pull, Push and Pull Request appear.
the Pull, Push and Pull Request chips send their git prompt to the agent at once.
Share publicly, Connect Repo, `task-<uuid>` start URLs, paused-sandbox resume, archived read-only state and the shared-conversation redirect exist only on a Cloud backend.
at 390 px the header keeps its controls and the info dialogs fit the viewport.

scenarios.name: F07--rename-inline
scenarios.title: Rename inline
scenarios.body: On `/conversations/<id>` (`control-openhands browser goto /conversations/<id>`; the unknown id redirected to `/conversations`) run `control-openhands browser dblclick 'testid=conversation-name-title'`, `control-openhands browser fill 'testid=conversation-name-input' 'QA_F07 renamed'`, `control-openhands browser press Enter`, `control-openhands browser toasts` (`Conversation title updated successfully`), then `control-openhands browser reload` and `control-openhands browser text 'testid=conversation-name-title'`. It reads `QA_F07 renamed`, and so does `control-openhands browser text 'testid=conversation-card >> testid=conversation-card-title'`.
scenarios.raw: **Rename inline (`F07.rename-inline`).** On `/conversations/<id>` (`control-openhands browser goto /conversations/<id>`; the unknown id redirected to `/conversations`) run `control-openhands browser dblclick 'testid=conversation-name-title'`, `control-openhands browser fill 'testid=conversation-name-input' 'QA_F07 renamed'`, `control-openhands browser press Enter`, `control-openhands browser toasts` (`Conversation title updated successfully`), then `control-openhands browser reload` and `control-openhands browser text 'testid=conversation-name-title'`. It reads `QA_F07 renamed`, and so does `control-openhands browser text 'testid=conversation-card >> testid=conversation-card-title'`.
expected: double-click the title (or menu Rename), Enter or blur saves with a toast; an empty value reverts.
notes: Known failure [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5629](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5629) (`F07.rename-inline`), reproduced 2026-10-12 at `fa1f724ab573`, SDK 1.54.0. A second server's native first load rewrote a newer saved title with its startup copy; the connected Canvas header showed that older title. Recipe: create an idle conversation on A and PATCH its title to `QA_SHARED_BEFORE_B_5629_REPEAT`; run pinned SDK Python `python .agents/skills/verify-openhands/scripts/fixtures/shared-storage-server.py --run <run> --seconds 300` in the background. It starts only a bounded no-editor SDK B sharing this run's conversation directory/cipher/session key; its private `server.json` supplies the port and owned operator/PGID. After B listens, PATCH A to `QA_SHARED_AFTER_B_5629_REPEAT` and confirm disk. Run `control-openhands service stop agent-server --run <run>`, then `python .../fixtures/shared-storage-server.py --run <run> --load-id <id>`: native B `/events/count` returned 200 and disk reverted to BEFORE_B. Restart A only to serve Canvas, choose default-local and doctor; use the Add Backend recipe from [F25](F25-backends-and-cloud.md) to connect B at its recorded port with the private key file, then open its card: the header reads BEFORE_B. SIGTERM only the recorded helper operator and verify its port/PGID gone; the helper also bounds runtime and terminates remaining group descendants. Evidence: `backfill-18309-surface-rechecks/F07.rename-inline/metadata-repeat-before-b-load-5629.json`, `metadata-repeat-after-b-load-5629.json`, `shared-first-load-reverted-5629.png`. The native first-load request is explicit; stale catalog display alone is insufficient proof of this overwrite.

Arrange the empty conversation with `api POST /api/conversations --write --data @<idle-autotitle-disabled-payload>`, open `/conversations/<id>`, clear `browser network`, leave the tab foreground, then read `browser network --filter ids= --last 100` and `conversation status <id>`. No model call or response was used.

scenarios.name: F07--status-menu-stop
scenarios.title: Status menu, stop
scenarios.body: On `/conversations/<id>` run `control-openhands browser hover 'testid=server-status-menu-trigger'` (for a mouse the hover opens the menu and a click on the open menu's dot closes it; a CLI `click` from elsewhere usually opens it only because the click lands before the hover renders, a race that sometimes leaves it closed, so do not click), `control-openhands browser text 'testid=server-status-context-menu'` (`Running` / `Stop Runtime`), then `control-openhands browser click 'testid=server-status-context-menu >> testid=stop-server-button' --expect-url '/conversations$'` and `control-openhands browser toasts`. The toasts read `Stopping conversation...` and `Conversation stopped` and the URL is `/conversations`.
scenarios.raw: **Status menu, stop (`F07.status-menu`).** On `/conversations/<id>` run `control-openhands browser hover 'testid=server-status-menu-trigger'` (for a mouse the hover opens the menu and a click on the open menu's dot closes it; a CLI `click` from elsewhere usually opens it only because the click lands before the hover renders, a race that sometimes leaves it closed, so do not click), `control-openhands browser text 'testid=server-status-context-menu'` (`Running` / `Stop Runtime`), then `control-openhands browser click 'testid=server-status-context-menu >> testid=stop-server-button' --expect-url '/conversations$'` and `control-openhands browser toasts`. The toasts read `Stopping conversation...` and `Conversation stopped` and the URL is `/conversations`.
expected: hovering the status dot (or tapping it on touch) opens a menu with the state and Stop Runtime (active) or Start Runtime (paused).
notes: Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#4893](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/4893) (`F07.status-menu`): A sandbox frozen mid-run can resume with a stale Running state that rejects normal resume requests. Live prerequisite: A disposable sandbox/VM frozen mid-run with a live model and persisted ownership state.

scenarios.name: F07--menu
scenarios.title: Menu
scenarios.body: Stop Runtime left the browser on `/conversations`: run `control-openhands browser goto /conversations/<git-id>` (a finished conversation whose runtime was not stopped), then `control-openhands browser click 'testid=chat-pane-header >> testid=ellipsis-button'` and `control-openhands browser testids 'testid=conversation-name-context-menu'`. On a finished or running conversation the items are `rename-button`, `show-skills-button`, `show-hooks-button`, `show-agent-tools-button`, `export-transcript-button` (`Export…`), `download-trajectory-button`, `display-cost-button` (`Display Usage and Cost`), `stop-button`, `delete-button`. `control-openhands browser press Escape` closes it (`control-openhands browser count 'testid=conversation-name-context-menu'` is `0`) and focus is back on the trigger (`control-openhands browser eval "document.activeElement.dataset.testid"` is `ellipsis-button`). Open it again: `control-openhands browser mouse-click 900 500` closes it too (count `0`).
scenarios.raw: **Menu (`F07.menu-open`).** Stop Runtime left the browser on `/conversations`: run `control-openhands browser goto /conversations/<git-id>` (a finished conversation whose runtime was not stopped), then `control-openhands browser click 'testid=chat-pane-header >> testid=ellipsis-button'` and `control-openhands browser testids 'testid=conversation-name-context-menu'`. On a finished or running conversation the items are `rename-button`, `show-skills-button`, `show-hooks-button`, `show-agent-tools-button`, `export-transcript-button` (`Export…`), `download-trajectory-button`, `display-cost-button` (`Display Usage and Cost`), `stop-button`, `delete-button`. `control-openhands browser press Escape` closes it (`control-openhands browser count 'testid=conversation-name-context-menu'` is `0`) and focus is back on the trigger (`control-openhands browser eval "document.activeElement.dataset.testid"` is `ellipsis-button`). Open it again: `control-openhands browser mouse-click 900 500` closes it too (count `0`).
expected: the "..." menu opens under the title; Escape closes it and returns focus to "...", and so does an outside click (without the focus move).

scenarios.name: F07--stop-with-confirmation
scenarios.title: Stop with confirmation
scenarios.body: On `/conversations/<running-id>` run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=chat-pane-header >> testid=ellipsis-button'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=conversation-name-context-menu >> testid=stop-button'` and `control-openhands browser snapshot 'role=dialog'` (`Confirm Stop Conversation`, buttons `Cancel` and `Confirm Close`, test ids `cancel-button` and `confirm-button`). `control-openhands browser click 'role=dialog >> testid=cancel-button'` closes it and `control-openhands conversation status <running-id>` stays `running`. Repeat the two clicks, then `control-openhands browser click 'role=dialog >> testid=confirm-button' --expect-url '/conversations$'`; the toasts read `Conversation stopped` and `conversation status <running-id>` is `paused`.
scenarios.raw: **Stop with confirmation (`F07.stop-confirm`).** On `/conversations/<running-id>` run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=chat-pane-header >> testid=ellipsis-button'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=conversation-name-context-menu >> testid=stop-button'` and `control-openhands browser snapshot 'role=dialog'` (`Confirm Stop Conversation`, buttons `Cancel` and `Confirm Close`, test ids `cancel-button` and `confirm-button`). `control-openhands browser click 'role=dialog >> testid=cancel-button'` closes it and `control-openhands conversation status <running-id>` stays `running`. Repeat the two clicks, then `control-openhands browser click 'role=dialog >> testid=confirm-button' --expect-url '/conversations$'`; the toasts read `Conversation stopped` and `conversation status <running-id>` is `paused`.
expected: Stop Conversation asks for confirmation; Confirm Close pauses the conversation and returns to `/conversations`.

scenarios.name: F07--branch-from-a-message
scenarios.title: Branch from a message
scenarios.body: On `/conversations/<id>` (`control-openhands browser goto /conversations/<id>`; Stop with confirmation ended on `/conversations`) run `control-openhands browser hover 'testid=agent-message'`, then `control-openhands browser click 'testid=agent-message >> role=button[name="Branch from here"]' --expect-url '/conversations/(?!<id>)[0-9a-f-]+'`, `control-openhands browser text 'testid=conversation-name-title'` (`QA_F07 renamed (branch)`) and `control-openhands browser count 'testid=chat-interface >> testid=user-message'` (`1`, the history is copied up to that reply). Back on `/conversations/<id>` (`control-openhands browser goto /conversations/<id>`), `control-openhands browser hover 'testid=user-message'` and `control-openhands browser click 'testid=user-message >> role=button[name="Branch from here"]' --expect-url '/conversations/(?!<id>)[0-9a-f-]+'` (it prints `/conversations/<branch-id>`): the new branch has `0` user messages and `control-openhands browser text 'testid=chat-input'` reads the original prompt `Reply with the single word: pong`, still there a few seconds later and not sent (`control-openhands conversation events <branch-id> --kinds MessageEvent` has count `0`).
scenarios.raw: **Branch from a message (`F07.branch-from-message`).** On `/conversations/<id>` (`control-openhands browser goto /conversations/<id>`; Stop with confirmation ended on `/conversations`) run `control-openhands browser hover 'testid=agent-message'`, then `control-openhands browser click 'testid=agent-message >> role=button[name="Branch from here"]' --expect-url '/conversations/(?!<id>)[0-9a-f-]+'`, `control-openhands browser text 'testid=conversation-name-title'` (`QA_F07 renamed (branch)`) and `control-openhands browser count 'testid=chat-interface >> testid=user-message'` (`1`, the history is copied up to that reply). Back on `/conversations/<id>` (`control-openhands browser goto /conversations/<id>`), `control-openhands browser hover 'testid=user-message'` and `control-openhands browser click 'testid=user-message >> role=button[name="Branch from here"]' --expect-url '/conversations/(?!<id>)[0-9a-f-]+'` (it prints `/conversations/<branch-id>`): the new branch has `0` user messages and `control-openhands browser text 'testid=chat-input'` reads the original prompt `Reply with the single word: pong`, still there a few seconds later and not sent (`control-openhands conversation events <branch-id> --kinds MessageEvent` has count `0`).
expected: Branch from here on a message forks the conversation as `<title> (branch)`; on a user message the message is left out and its text goes back into the composer.
notes: After the user-message branch in `F07.branch-from-message`, Send stays disabled next to the prefilled text (`browser enabled 'testid=submit-button'` is `false`; Known failure #18202, see F05 Gotchas). Enter in the field sends it.

scenarios.name: F07--delete-with-confirmation

scenarios.body: On a disposable conversation (for example the branch from `F07.branch-from-message`) run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=chat-pane-header >> testid=ellipsis-button'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=conversation-name-context-menu >> testid=delete-button'` and `control-openhands browser snapshot 'role=dialog'`: `Confirm Delete Are you sure you want to delete the "<title>" conversation? scenarios.name: F07--paused-conversation
scenarios.title: Paused conversation
scenarios.body: Run `control-openhands browser goto /conversations/<running-id>`, open the "..." menu and `control-openhands browser testids 'testid=conversation-name-context-menu'`: `show-hooks-button` and `stop-button` are absent. The status is `running` again and the menu reads `Running` / `Stop Runtime`.
scenarios.raw: **Paused conversation (`F07.menu-items-by-state`, `F07.status-menu`).** Run `control-openhands browser goto /conversations/<running-id>`, open the "..." menu and `control-openhands browser testids 'testid=conversation-name-context-menu'`: `show-hooks-button` and `stop-button` are absent. Close it with `control-openhands browser mouse-click 900 500`. Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=server-status-menu-trigger'` and `control-openhands browser text 'testid=server-status-context-menu'` (`Server Stopped` / `Start Runtime`), then `control-openhands browser click 'testid=server-status-context-menu >> testid=start-server-button'` and `control-openhands conversation wait <running-id> --until running,finished,idle --timeout 60`. The status is `running` again and the menu reads `Running` / `Stop Runtime`.
expected: Show Available Hooks and Stop Conversation appear only while the conversation is active.
hovering the status dot (or tapping it on touch) opens a menu with the state and Stop Runtime (active) or Start Runtime (paused).

scenarios.name: F07--project-skills-and-configured-hooks

scenarios.body: Arrange (outside the UI) a project skill and a hook in the git fixture: `mkdir -p <run>/workspace/qa-f07-repo/.agents/skills/qa-f07-skill <run>/workspace/qa-f07-repo/.openhands`, write `<run>/workspace/qa-f07-repo/.agents/skills/qa-f07-skill/SKILL.md` with front matter `name: qa-f07-skill`, `description: QA fixture skill for F07.`, `triggers: [qaf07trigger]` and the body `QA_F07 skill body.`, and write `<run>/workspace/qa-f07-repo/.openhands/hooks.json` as `{"pre_tool_use":[{"matcher":"terminal","hooks":[{"type":"command","command":"true","timeout":10}]}]}`. scenarios.name: F07--export-transcript
scenarios.title: Export transcript
scenarios.body: Open the menu, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=conversation-name-context-menu >> testid=export-transcript-button'`; `control-openhands browser snapshot 'role=dialog'` shows `Export conversation`, radio `Markdown document (.md)` checked, `Standalone web page (.html)`, and checkboxes `Include tool call details` and `Include timestamps` checked. `control-openhands browser click 'testid=confirm-transcript-export'` then `control-openhands browser downloads --last 1 --inspect`: a `<ms>-conversation-<id>.md` (the harness prefixes a timestamp to the suggested `conversation-<id>.md`) lands in `<run>/private/downloads` starting `# QA_F07 renamed`, `**Model:** deepseek/deepseek-flash`, `## User` with `<sub>` timestamps. Reopen, `control-openhands browser click 'role=dialog >> role=radio[name="Standalone web page (.html)"]'`, `control-openhands browser click 'role=dialog >> role=checkbox[name="Include timestamps"]'`, export: the `.html` has `<title>QA_F07 renamed</title>` and no timestamps.
