scenarios.name: F07--download-data
scenarios.title: Download data
scenarios.body: Open the menu, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=conversation-name-context-menu >> testid=download-trajectory-button'`, then `control-openhands browser downloads`. A `<ms>-conversation_<id>.zip` lands in `<run>/private/downloads`; `browser downloads --last 1 --inspect` lists `<id-without-dashes>/base_state.json` and `bash_events/`, and every LLM `api_key` in `base_state.json` is masked as asterisks (`**********`).
scenarios.raw: **Download data (`F07.download-zip`).** Open the menu, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=conversation-name-context-menu >> testid=download-trajectory-button'`, then `control-openhands browser downloads`. A `<ms>-conversation_<id>.zip` lands in `<run>/private/downloads`; `browser downloads --last 1 --inspect` lists `<id-without-dashes>/base_state.json` and `bash_events/`, and every LLM `api_key` in `base_state.json` is masked as asterisks (`**********`).
expected: Download conversation data downloads `conversation_<id>.zip`.
notes: Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5640](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5640) (`F07.download-zip`): Download conversation data can return404 after a warm-pool server initializes a custom conversation-storage path. Although closed upstream, the pinned SDK 1.55.0 still reads the default configuration path here; this remains a supported-version distinction, not a freshly reproduced failure. Live prerequisite: A deferred-init warm-pool Agent Server initialized with a non-default conversations_path; this launcher starts an already-initialized server.

Known failure [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5539](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5539) (`F07.download-zip`), reproduced 2026-10-12 at `fa1f724ab573`, SDK 1.54.0: three real overlapping receivers of one idle conversation made 929 requests in 20 seconds, including 31 completed corrupt ZIPs with status 200, 106 server 500s, 269 ingress 502s and 133 RemoteProtocolErrors. A sequential 2,000-request control returned valid ZIPs. Recipe (use the pinned SDK Python with httpx): `python .agents/skills/verify-openhands/scripts/fixtures/download-trajectory-overlap.py --base-url <own-base-url> --conversation-id <id> --api-key-file <run>/private/session-key --output-dir <run>/private/trajectory-overlap --seconds 20 --clients 3 --rounds 5000 --slow-ms 2`. It enforces loopback, request/duration/network/uncompressed/member budgets and bounded CRC reads; aborts and unsupported archives remain unverified. While it runs, use `browser goto /conversations/<id>`, open `chat-pane-header >> ellipsis-button`, click `download-trajectory-button`, then `browser downloads --last 3 --inspect` (all CLI commands with `--run <run>`). That Canvas click downloaded an inspectable ZIP; its particular result is not claimed corrupt. Private raw samples stay private. Evidence: `backfill-18309-surface-rechecks/F07.download-zip/trajectory-overlap-5539-summary.json` and `overlapping-download-5539.png`. The summary correction excludes two ambiguous Content-Length differences that could be intentional deadline aborts; only completed corrupt ZIPs count as corrupt downloads.

scenarios.name: F07--whitespace-only-header-rename
scenarios.title: Whitespace-only header rename
scenarios.body: After the named-title check, run `control-openhands browser network --clear`, double-click `testid=conversation-name-title`, fill `testid=conversation-name-input` with one space, and `control-openhands browser press Enter`. Read `control-openhands browser network --filter '/api/conversations' --bodies`, then reload and read the title. Expected: restore the previous title with no write. Known failure (reproduced 2026-10-12, [#17061](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/17061)): Canvas submits `PATCH` with an empty title. Agent Server 1.54.0 rejects it with 422 and restores the prior title; a persistently blank server title was not observed.
scenarios.raw: **Whitespace-only header rename (`F07.rename-inline`).** After the named-title check, run `control-openhands browser network --clear`, double-click `testid=conversation-name-title`, fill `testid=conversation-name-input` with one space, and `control-openhands browser press Enter`. Read `control-openhands browser network --filter '/api/conversations' --bodies`, then reload and read the title. Expected: restore the previous title with no write. Known failure (reproduced 2026-10-12, [#17061](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/17061)): Canvas submits `PATCH` with an empty title. Agent Server 1.54.0 rejects it with 422 and restores the prior title; a persistently blank server title was not observed.
expected: double-click the title (or menu Rename), Enter or blur saves with a toast; an empty value reverts.
notes: Known failure [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5629](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5629) (`F07.rename-inline`), reproduced 2026-10-12 at `fa1f724ab573`, SDK 1.54.0. A second server's native first load rewrote a newer saved title with its startup copy; the connected Canvas header showed that older title. Recipe: create an idle conversation on A and PATCH its title to `QA_SHARED_BEFORE_B_5629_REPEAT`; run pinned SDK Python `python .agents/skills/verify-openhands/scripts/fixtures/shared-storage-server.py --run <run> --seconds 300` in the background. It starts only a bounded no-editor SDK B sharing this run's conversation directory/cipher/session key; its private `server.json` supplies the port and owned operator/PGID. After B listens, PATCH A to `QA_SHARED_AFTER_B_5629_REPEAT` and confirm disk. Run `control-openhands service stop agent-server --run <run>`, then `python .../fixtures/shared-storage-server.py --run <run> --load-id <id>`: native B `/events/count` returned 200 and disk reverted to BEFORE_B. Restart A only to serve Canvas, choose default-local and doctor; use the Add Backend recipe from [F25](F25-backends-and-cloud.md) to connect B at its recorded port with the private key file, then open its card: the header reads BEFORE_B. SIGTERM only the recorded helper operator and verify its port/PGID gone; the helper also bounds runtime and terminates remaining group descendants. Evidence: `backfill-18309-surface-rechecks/F07.rename-inline/metadata-repeat-before-b-load-5629.json`, `metadata-repeat-after-b-load-5629.json`, `shared-first-load-reverted-5629.png`. The native first-load request is explicit; stale catalog display alone is insufficient proof of this overwrite.

Known failure [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#4800](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/4800) (`F07.rename-inline`), reproduced 2026-10-12 at `fa1f724ab573`, SDK 1.54.0. A refused rename changed the server's GET title while `meta.json` kept the previous title; graceful shutdown subsequently persisted the rejected title. Recipe: create an idle dummy-profile conversation, then double-click `conversation-name-title`, fill `conversation-name-input` with `QA_META_BEFORE_4800` and press Enter; verify GET/disk. Record the original mode and temporarily `chmod 0500 <run>/private/state/dev_conversations/<id-hex>` to deny an atomic metadata replacement. Rename through that UI to `QA_META_REFUSED_4800`: the permission-denied toast/HTTP 500 appears, GET shows REFUSED, disk still shows BEFORE. Restore the exact original directory mode in `finally`, then `restart`, `doctor`, GET and reload (CLI with `--run <run>`): REFUSED was persisted during graceful shutdown. Only the owned temporary directory is changed; evidence contains title/timestamp fields, not stored secrets. Evidence: `backfill-18309-surface-rechecks/F07.rename-inline/metadata-before-4800.json`, `metadata-denied-4800.json`, `refused-title-4800.png`, `metadata-after-graceful-restart-4800.json`. Tags/autotitle and ownership-conflict branches remain untested.

scenarios.name: F07--already-deleted-conversation
scenarios.title: Already-deleted conversation
scenarios.body:
Expected: a stale action reports that the conversation is missing, and a stale rename never reports success. Known failure (reproduced 2026-10-16, SDK 1.55.0, [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5800](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5800)): confirming Delete after another client removed this disposable conversation returns400 and displays `Bad Request`, instead of a missing-conversation404. The separate stale-rename control receives PATCH200 but re-fetches missing metadata and displays not-found, so its false-success variant is prevented by Canvas. Pause/interrupt were not tested.
  ```sh known-bug F07.delete-confirm already-deleted
  control-openhands browser viewport desktop
  QA_ID="$(python3 - <<'PY'
  import json, os, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile
  base = pathlib.Path(os.environ["OH_VERIFY_RUN"]) / "workspace"
  base.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
  fixture = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="qa-surface-", dir=base))
  llm = {"model":"openai/gpt-4o", "base_url":"http://127.0.0.1:1/v1", "api_key":"qa-not-real", "num_retries":0, "timeout":2}
  def create(workspace, parent=None, tags=None):
      payload = {"agent":{"kind":"Agent", "llm":llm, "tools":[]}, "workspace":{"working_dir":str(workspace)}, "autotitle":False}
      if parent: payload["parent_conversation_id"] = parent
      if tags: payload["tags"] = tags
      request = fixture / "request.json"
      request.write_text(json.dumps(payload))
      result = subprocess.run(["control-openhands", "api", "POST", "/api/conversations", "--write", "--data", "@"+str(request), "--pick", "id"], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
      return json.loads(result.stdout)["value"]
  def git(directory, *args):
      subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(directory), *args], check=True, capture_output=True)
  workspace = fixture / "workspace"
  workspace.mkdir()
  print(create(workspace))
  PY
  )"
  control-openhands browser goto "/conversations/$QA_ID"
  control-openhands browser click 'testid=chat-pane-header >> testid=ellipsis-button'
  control-openhands browser click 'testid=conversation-name-context-menu >> testid=delete-button'
  control-openhands assert --field status --equals 200 -- api DELETE "/api/conversations/$QA_ID" --write
  control-openhands browser network --clear
  control-openhands browser click 'role=dialog >> testid=confirm-button' --observe 'role=status' --observe-ms 1000
  control-openhands browser screenshot --feature F07.delete-confirm --name stale-delete
  control-openhands assert --field recent.0.status --equals 404 --bug-shows 400 -- browser network --filter "/api/conversations/$QA_ID"  # bug
  ```

notes: Known failure [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5629](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5629) (`F07.rename-inline`), reproduced 2026-10-12 at `fa1f724ab573`, SDK 1.54.0. A second server's native first load rewrote a newer saved title with its startup copy; the connected Canvas header showed that older title. Recipe: create an idle conversation on A and PATCH its title to `QA_SHARED_BEFORE_B_5629_REPEAT`; run pinned SDK Python `python .agents/skills/verify-openhands/scripts/fixtures/shared-storage-server.py --run <run> --seconds 300` in the background. It starts only a bounded no-editor SDK B sharing this run's conversation directory/cipher/session key; its private `server.json` supplies the port and owned operator/PGID. After B listens, PATCH A to `QA_SHARED_AFTER_B_5629_REPEAT` and confirm disk. Run `control-openhands service stop agent-server --run <run>`, then `python .../fixtures/shared-storage-server.py --run <run> --load-id <id>`: native B `/events/count` returned 200 and disk reverted to BEFORE_B. Restart A only to serve Canvas, choose default-local and doctor; use the Add Backend recipe from [F25](F25-backends-and-cloud.md) to connect B at its recorded port with the private key file, then open its card: the header reads BEFORE_B. SIGTERM only the recorded helper operator and verify its port/PGID gone; the helper also bounds runtime and terminates remaining group descendants. Evidence: `backfill-18309-surface-rechecks/F07.rename-inline/metadata-repeat-before-b-load-5629.json`, `metadata-repeat-after-b-load-5629.json`, `shared-first-load-reverted-5629.png`. The native first-load request is explicit; stale catalog display alone is insufficient proof of this overwrite.

Known failure [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#4800](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/4800) (`F07.rename-inline`), reproduced 2026-10-12 at `fa1f724ab573`, SDK 1.54.0. A refused rename changed the server's GET title while `meta.json` kept the previous title; graceful shutdown subsequently persisted the rejected title. Recipe: create an idle dummy-profile conversation, then double-click `conversation-name-title`, fill `conversation-name-input` with `QA_META_BEFORE_4800` and press Enter; verify GET/disk. Record the original mode and temporarily `chmod 0500 <run>/private/state/dev_conversations/<id-hex>` to deny an atomic metadata replacement. Rename through that UI to `QA_META_REFUSED_4800`: the permission-denied toast/HTTP 500 appears, GET shows REFUSED, disk still shows BEFORE. Restore the exact original directory mode in `finally`, then `restart`, `doctor`, GET and reload (CLI with `--run <run>`): REFUSED was persisted during graceful shutdown. Only the owned temporary directory is changed; evidence contains title/timestamp fields, not stored secrets. Evidence: `backfill-18309-surface-rechecks/F07.rename-inline/metadata-before-4800.json`, `metadata-denied-4800.json`, `refused-title-4800.png`, `metadata-after-graceful-restart-4800.json`. Tags/autotitle and ownership-conflict branches remain untested.

families.title: Workspace drawer: files and changes
families.overview:
Next to the chat, a conversation has a right-hand drawer with tabs. This family
covers the drawer itself (toggle, tab bar, overflow menu with pinning, the phone
panel page) and its two workspace tabs. **Files** is a read-only browser of the
conversation's working directory: a path row with copy, a strip of open files,
a collapsible tree, and a Rich/Plain viewer for code, Markdown, HTML, images and
binaries. **Commits** lists an "Uncommitted" row and the git history, newest
first. Each expands into per-file Monaco diffs with old/diff/new modes. The
Terminal, Browser, Planner, Task list and Usage tab bodies belong to F27. The
Files tab has no upload, download or edit.
families.entry:
- Chat header: the panel toggle (`right-panel-toggle`, block-drawer icon, right of the overview `i` button). At desktop width it shows or hides the drawer; at 1024 px or narrower it navigates to the panel page.
- Drawer tab bar (`tabs-pane-header`): `conversation-tab-files`, `conversation-tab-commits`. The ellipsis (`tabs-pane-header >> testid=ellipsis-button`) opens the menu with `conversation-tabs-menu-open-<tab>` and `conversation-tabs-menu-pin-<tab>`.
- Direct URL `/conversations/<id>/panel` (the phone panel page at 1024 px or narrower; wider, it redirects to `/conversations/<id>` with the drawer open).
- Overview (`conversation-overview-toggle`) → Changes row (`conversation-overview-diffs`) → Commits tab with Uncommitted expanded.
- Files toolbar: `File discovery` (`file-discovery-settings`, left of `files-tab-refresh`) opens the File discovery dialog.
- Workspace paths in agent messages written as inline code (`markdown-file-path-link`), plus path chips in file-editor tool cards (`file-path-chip`) → Files tab with that file selected.
- There is no command-menu entry or keyboard shortcut for the drawer or these tabs.
families.given:
Preconditions: - Baseline state (launched, doctored, `onboard --skip` done) and `control-openhands llm preset deepseek` (three short model turns, deepseek-flash). - A git fixture: `control-openhands fixture git-repo` (creates `/workspace/qa-repo` with `README.md`, `src/calc.py`, `src/test_calc.py` and one commit by `QA Fixture`). - The conversation runs in that repo. From `/` run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=open-workspace-button'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=workspace-dropdown'`, `control-openhands browser click 'role=button[name="+ Add Workspace"]'`. The folder browser opens at `/private/home`, so then run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=folder-browser-up'` twice, `control-openhands browser dblclick 'testid=folder-browser-entry-workspace'`, `control-openhands browser dblclick 'testid=folder-browser-entry-qa-repo'`, `control-openhands browser click 'testid=folder-browser-use'` and `control-openhands browser click 'testid=workspace-launch-button'`. The composer now shows a `qa-repo` chip. Start with `--stay`, which keeps that chip; a plain `conversation start` navigates home and loses it. - Seed changes with a prompt file, because the command contains quotes. Write `qa-f08-1.txt` (anywhere outside the workspace) containing: ``In the current workspace directory run exactly this one bash command and then reply only "done": printf '# QA notes\n\nHello **world**\n' > qa-notes.md && printf '

QA page

\n' > qa-page.html && printf 'def sub(a, b):\n return a - b\n' >> src/calc.py && rm src/test_calc.py && printf 'PK\003\004' > qa-deck.pptx && head -c 64 /dev/urandom > qa-blob.bin && git status --short``. Then run `control-openhands conversation start --stay --prompt "$(cat qa-f08-1.txt)" --wait --timeout 240`. Read `` from its `id` (or `control-openhands browser url`); the browser stays on `/conversations/`. - Viewport desktop (1440×1000) unless a bullet says phone.
families.gotchas:
- When the drawer is closed, its tabs stay mounted at width 0. `browser count 'testid=files-tab'` is `1` even then, so assert with `browser visible` or `right-panel-toggle` `aria-pressed`.
- The tab row is a `tablist "Conversation panels"` of `role=tab` controls, each named after its tab even when inactive (#17612), so `role=tab[name="Commits"]` finds the Commits tab whether or not it is active; `role=button[name="Commits"]` finds nothing. `aria-selected` marks the selected tab. The `conversation-tab-*` test ids still work.
- The tab row ends with the ellipsis menu (`Customize tabs`), then the `VSCode` button (`drawer-vscode-link`, named `Open in VS Code`) when the runtime reports a running editor. #17660 removed that button and #18048 restored it, so on a checkout between the two the drawer has no editor control at all.
- The overflow menu is not a `role=menu`. Escape closes it and returns focus to the tab bar's `ellipsis-button`, both in the desktop drawer and on the phone `/panel` page; choosing a row or an outside click (`browser mouse-click`) closes it too.
- The Files list and the open preview do not follow bash edits: `use-auto-refresh-files-on-edit.ts` refreshes the file queries only for file-editor observations, and its comment says shell observations skip them on purpose (so that every shell command does not reload canvas iframes). This map still expects files the agent writes to appear (`F08.files-auto-refresh`), so the bash case stays a fail row. Click `files-tab-refresh` once before asserting on files the agent made with the shell. Since #18032 that one click also re-reads the open file (the content fetch revalidates instead of using the browser HTTP cache, and the rich preview gets a new `?v=`), and a page reload shows the current body without a click.
- The chat also fetches the file list (to linkify paths). A conversation page left open while the agent works can therefore show a stale tree the moment the drawer first opens.
- Binary detection is a NUL-byte sniff of the first 8 KB, and the Office message also needs that sniff to trip. A 4-byte `PK\003\004` "pptx" or random bytes without a NUL render as text in the plain viewer. Fixtures must contain a NUL.
- `control-openhands fixture folder` writes a plain folder with `notes.md`, but by the time the conversation has run the folder holds an empty `.git`, so a conversation that leaves `notes.md` in place shows `Uncommitted 1 file` rather than the empty state. Delete it first (as in the recipe).
- Diff views are Monaco. `testid=file-diff-viewer` and `file-single-viewer` are not on the DOM; read text through `testid=editor-container`. The narrow drawer falls back to an inline (not side-by-side) diff. The view-mode buttons are named `Old version`, `Diff` and `New version`, and `collapse` is named `Expand` or `Collapse` after its state (#18033).
- `browser eval "navigator.clipboard.readText()"` hangs for about 2 minutes (no clipboard permission). Use `control-openhands browser clipboard` to read what Copy wrote.
- `browser click ... --observe` accepts the usual selector syntax (`testid=...`).
- Two `.cursor-ew-resize` grips sit in the conversation page (chat/drawer, then the Files tree); scope the tree one with `testid=files-tab-tree-resize-handle`.
- At phone width, chat path links (and the agent's `canvas_ui_control` tab and file requests, through `src/services/canvas-ui.ts`) navigate to `/conversations/<id>/panel` (#18045); at desktop width they open the side drawer and the URL does not change. A `/panel` URL above 1024 px redirects to `/conversations/<id>`, so a bullet that leaves the phone viewport on `/panel` ends on the chat route.
- If the agent's terminal resets mid-command ("terminal session was reset", for example after a `restart`), the agent reruns the command. Check the workspace with `git status` through a second prompt rather than trusting the first observation. Runs no longer share a tmux server (OpenHands/OpenHands#17946).
- Known issue: [#17567](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/17567) (Monaco disposed-model page error on diff unmount; it also fires on collapse and on a diff→old switch).
- Known issue [#18108](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/18108) (`F08.files-tree`): Files tab shows "No files in workspace" on cloud when the agent writes outside /workspace/project. Live prerequisite: An authenticated Enterprise Cloud sandbox, no repository selected, with files outside its default working directory.
- Known issue [#17773](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/17773) (`F08.files-tree`): Files tab always shows "No files in workspace" on Windows local backend. Live prerequisite: A Windows local Agent Server using cmd.exe; this run is macOS.
- Known issue [#16949](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/16949) (`F08.files-refresh`): Keep Files and Changes views source-driven after refresh. Live prerequisite: An authenticated Cloud repository for the refresh-query mismatch, or real file-editor observations causing an in-place M-to-D Git refetch.
- Known issue [#16716](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/16716) (`F08.uncommitted-changes`): Diff view is regularly out of sync. Live prerequisite: The original simultaneous-agent/shared-repository state or a deterministic stale-diff trigger; the report only suggests that timing.
- Known issue [#16689](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/16689) (`F08.files-load-error`): When `workspace/` paths throw a 401, call the workspace-session endpoint. Live prerequisite: The original fresh-VM URL, auth/cookie state and exact request sequence; the report says the trigger is unclear.
- Known issue [#16454](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/16454) (`F08.uncommitted-changes`): Diff list is showing duplicate entries. Live prerequisite: The original Git changes response and update sequence producing duplicate rows; the report provides no trigger.
- Known issue [#16331](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/16331) (`F08.files-tree`): file preview panel stops working during streaming. Live prerequisite: A real streaming/tool-running conversation while selecting a second workspace file.
- Known issue [#15692](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/15692) (`F08.uncommitted-changes`): Diff still shows after agent has committed and pushed. Live prerequisite: A real agent commit/push terminal observation while the diff remains mounted, plus a disposable Git remote.
- Known issue [#15567](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/15567) (`F08.files-load-error`): Workspace file preview returns 401 Unauthorized on non-HTTPS non-loopback hosts. Live prerequisite: A plain-HTTP non-loopback deployment and browser accessing that origin, with workspace-cookie observation.
- Known issue [#15519](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/15519) (`F08.files-load-error`): "files" tab in Files side panel throws 401 Unauthorized. Live prerequisite: The reported Linux Docker deployment/auth topology; this isolated run uses the macOS source launcher.
- Known issue [#15501](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/15501) (`F08.files-rich-plain`): Generated-page JavaScript was blocked by an iframe sandbox. Files Rich intentionally disables scripts; the report does not identify whether Files or Browser was used. Live prerequisite: The original preview panel and file URL or minimal page identifying the intended surface; Files Rich deliberately blocks scripts, while Browser is separate.
- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#4562](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/4562) (`F08.files-load-error`): Plain-HTTP non-loopback workspace previews can return401 after the browser rejects the workspace-session cookie. Live prerequisite: A plain-HTTP non-loopback same-origin browser deployment with real workspace-cookie observation.
- Known issue [#16871](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/16871) (`F08.vscode-link`): the shared `transformVSCodeUrl` still accepts arbitrary schemes, and the current Cloud `use-unified-vscode-url.ts` branch passes sandbox `exposed_urls` editor values through it without the Local origin gate. Live prerequisite: an authorized Cloud account/sandbox whose editor `exposed_urls` value can be controlled for safe URL-scheme rejection checks. Local inspection on 2026-10-12 at `fa1f724ab573` found no Download via VS Code action in the real card menu: its only production caller does not supply the required `showOptions` prop. The current drawer opens with `noopener,noreferrer`. Neither the old opener exploit nor the remaining Cloud scheme scenario was reproduced. Evidence: `backfill-18309-surface-rechecks/F04.download/vscode-card-action-absent-16871.png` and its ARIA snapshot. Keep this linked to the live editor-link consumer; do not infer the whole issue resolved from the removed card action.
- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5845](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5845) (`F08.vscode-link`): reserved characters in the workspace path can split the editor URL's unencoded `folder` parameter and open the wrong folder. Live prerequisite: a supported origin serving a genuinely enabled/running editor and an owned conversation in a path containing `&` or `#`. A direct URL-constructor call does not exercise the link; Cloud `exposed_urls` takes another path.
- Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5784](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5784) (`F08.files-rich-plain`, `F08.files-fallbacks`, `F08.files-open-new-window`): a path-prefixed Agent Server can set a workspace cookie whose Path omits the prefix, leaving HTML/image/file previews unauthorized. Live prerequisite: an authenticated path-prefixed owned Local server with `OH_WEB_URL` and a real cookie-authenticated preview; the ordinary root-path launch cannot exercise that cookie Path.

features.description: the chat-header toggle (`Show panel`/`Hide panel`, `aria-pressed`) opens and closes the drawer; the first open shows Files.

the tab bar (Files, Commits, Planner, Terminal, Browser, Usage; Task list only when the agent has one) switches the drawer body, and only the active tab shows its label. Clicking the active tab closes the drawer.
after a reload the drawer starts closed, and reopening it restores the last selected tab for that conversation.
the ellipsis menu at the end of the tab bar lists every tab. Choosing a row opens that tab and closes the menu, and so does clicking outside.
the pill on each menu row pins or unpins a tab. Unpinning the active tab selects another pinned one, and the choice persists across reloads.
dragging the chat/drawer divider resizes both panes (chat 30–80 %, default 50 %, stored in `desktop-layout-panel-width`).
a `VSCode` button at the right of the tab bar opens the editor in a new window; it is hidden when the runtime has no editor.
on an archived conversation the toggle is disabled with the tooltip `Unavailable for Archives`.
at 1024 px or narrower the toggle navigates to `/conversations/<id>/panel`, a full-screen page with a Back chevron, the same tab bar and the tab body.

opening `/conversations/<id>/panel` directly renders the panel page at 1024 px or narrower, and Back returns to the chat; wider, the URL is replaced with `/conversations/<id>` and the drawer opens beside the chat.
`Workspace: <working_dir>` with the full path in its tooltip; the copy button turns into `Copied to clipboard` for about 2 s.
a tree of folders, collapsed at first, and files. Clicking a file selects it and adds it to the open-file strip.
a workspace with no files shows `No files in workspace`.
the list-tree button hides or shows the tree, and the choice persists per conversation. The tree is 224 px wide by default.
dragging the divider between the tree and the preview resizes the tree (160–480 px, default 224) and the width persists across reloads (`files-tab-tree-width` in localStorage).

the Files toolbar's `File discovery` button opens a dialog (excluded directory patterns, maximum files, symbolic links) whose Save applies to every conversation on that workspace and backend; an excluded directory leaves the tree, Restore defaults brings the default patterns back, an invalid limit disables Save.
the open-file strip, each tab with a close X. Closing the selected file selects a neighbour. Open files and the selection survive a reload and do not leak into other conversations.
with no file selected the pane reads `Select a file to view its contents` and the Rich/Plain toggle is absent.
Rich highlights code, renders Markdown and shows HTML in an iframe sandboxed without scripts. Plain shows highlighted source. The mode persists across reloads.
images render as `` in Rich mode. Files with NUL bytes show `Binary file – preview not available`, and Office files show `Preview isn't available for Word files.` (or PowerPoint/Excel).
a selected file that can no longer be read shows the error (`Failed to read <path>: 404`).
the external-link icon opens the file from the workspace fileserver in a new browser tab.
`Refresh files` re-reads the file list and the selected file's content.
files the agent writes appear without a manual refresh.
clicking a workspace path in an agent (or user) message opens the drawer on Files with that file selected.
the path chip on a file-editor tool card (absolute path) opens the drawer on Files with that file selected.
with no commits and no changes the Commits tab shows `No commits yet`. While the runtime is inactive it shows `Waiting for runtime to start...`, and while loading `Loading changes...`.
the top row reads `-`, `Uncommitted` and a file count; expanding it lists the changed paths.
each commit row shows the short SHA, subject, author (only when there are several authors) and relative time. Rows are single-open accordions, and new agent commits appear without a reload.
the history loads the latest 50 commits; a longer history ends with `Showing the latest 50 commits`.
expanding a changed file shows its diff; the view-mode buttons (`Old version`, `Diff`, `New version`) switch between old, diff and new without page errors.
a Markdown file in new (or old) mode renders as a prose preview.
a deleted working-tree file reads `This file was deleted. Its previous contents are no longer available for preview.`
the overview's Changes row opens the drawer on Commits with Uncommitted expanded and closes the overview.

scenarios.name: F08--open-the-drawer
scenarios.title: Open the drawer
scenarios.body: Run `control-openhands browser attr 'testid=right-panel-toggle' aria-pressed` (`false`) and `control-openhands browser tooltip 'testid=right-panel-toggle'` (`Show panel`). Then run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=right-panel-toggle'`, followed by `control-openhands browser attr 'testid=right-panel-toggle' aria-label` and `control-openhands browser visible 'testid=files-tab'`. The label is `Hide panel`, `aria-pressed` is `true`, and Files is visible with the workspace path and tree (`browser screenshot --feature F08.panel-toggle --name drawer-open-files`).
scenarios.raw: **Open the drawer (`F08.panel-toggle`).** Run `control-openhands browser attr 'testid=right-panel-toggle' aria-pressed` (`false`) and `control-openhands browser tooltip 'testid=right-panel-toggle'` (`Show panel`). scenarios.name: F08--switch-and-close-by-tab

Click `testid=right-panel-toggle`; `control-openhands browser visible 'testid=commit-list'` is `true`.

scenarios.name: F08--overflow-menu

Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=conversation-tabs-menu-open-usage'`; then `control-openhands browser count 'testid=conversation-tabs-menu-open-usage'` is `0` (menu closed) and the bar's active label is `Usage`. Reopen the menu and run `control-openhands browser mouse-click 560 600` (over the chat); the menu count is `0`.

scenarios.name: F08--pin-unpin

scenarios.name: F08--resize
scenarios.title: Resize
scenarios.body: The divider has no test id; its grip is the first `.cursor-ew-resize` on the page (the second is the Files tree divider). With the drawer open, `control-openhands browser bbox 'testid=chat-interface'` and `control-openhands browser bbox 'testid=tabs-pane-header'` are about 570 px wide each and `control-openhands browser eval "localStorage.getItem('desktop-layout-panel-width')"` is `"50"`. Run `control-openhands browser drag '.cursor-ew-resize >> nth=0' --by 200,0`: the chat is 770 px, the drawer about 369 px and the key about `67.5`. `--by 900,0` clamps at `"80"`, `--by -1200,0` at `"30"` (chat 342 px), and after `browser reload` plus the toggle the chat is still 342 px. Restore with `control-openhands browser drag '.cursor-ew-resize >> nth=0' --by 228,0` (chat 570 px, key `"50"`).

With the drawer open, `control-openhands browser bbox 'testid=chat-interface'` and `control-openhands browser bbox 'testid=tabs-pane-header'` are about 570 px wide each and `control-openhands browser eval "localStorage.getItem('desktop-layout-panel-width')"` is `"50"`. Restore with `control-openhands browser drag '.cursor-ew-resize >> nth=0' --by 228,0` (chat 570 px, key `"50"`).

scenarios.name: F08--vs-code-link
scenarios.title: VS Code link
scenarios.body: Blocked in a runtime without a running VS Code server: `control-openhands browser count 'testid=drawer-vscode-link'` is `0` (hidden, as designed), and `control-openhands api GET /api/vscode/status` explains why (`enabled: false`, or `running: false` when the agent-server has no editor binary, as in these stacks; see F26 Gotchas). It needs a runtime with `enable_vscode` and a running editor, on an origin that serves `/vscode/`.
scenarios.raw: **VS Code link (`F08.vscode-link`).** Blocked in a runtime without a running VS Code server: `control-openhands browser count 'testid=drawer-vscode-link'` is `0` (hidden, as designed), and `control-openhands api GET /api/vscode/status` explains why (`enabled: false`, or `running: false` when the agent-server has no editor binary, as in these stacks; see F26 Gotchas). It needs a runtime with `enable_vscode` and a running editor, on an origin that serves `/vscode/`.
expected: a `VSCode` button at the right of the tab bar opens the editor in a new window; it is hidden when the runtime has no editor.
notes: Known issue [#16871](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/16871) (`F08.vscode-link`): the shared `transformVSCodeUrl` still accepts arbitrary schemes, and the current Cloud `use-unified-vscode-url.ts` branch passes sandbox `exposed_urls` editor values through it without the Local origin gate. Live prerequisite: an authorized Cloud account/sandbox whose editor `exposed_urls` value can be controlled for safe URL-scheme rejection checks. Local inspection on 2026-10-12 at `fa1f724ab573` found no Download via VS Code action in the real card menu: its only production caller does not supply the required `showOptions` prop. The current drawer opens with `noopener,noreferrer`. Neither the old opener exploit nor the remaining Cloud scheme scenario was reproduced. Evidence: `backfill-18309-surface-rechecks/F04.download/vscode-card-action-absent-16871.png` and its ARIA snapshot. Keep this linked to the live editor-link consumer; do not infer the whole issue resolved from the removed card action.

Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5845](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5845) (`F08.vscode-link`): reserved characters in the workspace path can split the editor URL's unencoded `folder` parameter and open the wrong folder. Live prerequisite: a supported origin serving a genuinely enabled/running editor and an owned conversation in a path containing `&` or `#`. A direct URL-constructor call does not exercise the link; Cloud `exposed_urls` takes another path.

scenarios.name: F08--rich-plain

Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=files-tab-content-mode-toggle-option-plain'`; `control-openhands browser text 'testid=files-tab-content >> testid=file-content-viewer-highlighted'` reads `1

QA page

`. After `browser reload` and reopening, `control-openhands browser attr 'testid=files-tab-content-mode-toggle-option-plain' aria-checked` is `true`. Switch back with `testid=files-tab-content-mode-toggle-option-rich`.

**Rich/Plain (`F08.files-rich-plain`).** Click `testid=file-tree-file-qa-notes.md`; `testid=file-content-viewer-markdown` exists. Click `testid=file-tree-file-qa-page.html`, then run `control-openhands browser attr 'testid=file-content-viewer-iframe' sandbox` (`allow-same-origin`) and `control-openhands browser eval "document.querySelector('[data-testid=file-content-viewer-iframe]').contentDocument.body.innerText"` (`QA page`). Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=files-tab-content-mode-toggle-option-plain'`; `control-openhands browser text 'testid=files-tab-content >> testid=file-content-viewer-highlighted'` reads `1

`. After `browser reload` and reopening, `control-openhands browser attr 'testid=files-tab-content-mode-toggle-option-plain' aria-checked` is `true`. Switch back with `testid=files-tab-content-mode-toggle-option-rich`.

scenarios.title: Open-file strip

Select `qa-notes.md` with `control-openhands browser click 'testid=file-quick-row-item-qa-notes.md'`, then close it with `control-openhands browser click 'testid=file-quick-row-close-qa-notes.md'`. `control-openhands browser eval "[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid^=file-quick-row-item-]')].filter(e=>e.getAttribute('aria-selected')==='true').map(e=>e.dataset.testid)"` names the neighbour. Run `browser reload`, reopen the drawer and `control-openhands browser text 'testid=file-quick-row'`: the same files remain. Opening a different conversation (see Commits empty state) shows no quick-row items: `browser text 'testid=file-quick-row'` is empty. `browser testids` omits strip tabs scrolled out of view; count them with `browser eval "[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid^=file-quick-row-item-]')].length"`.
scenarios.raw: **Open-file strip (`F08.files-open-tabs`).** With several files opened, run `control-openhands browser attr 'testid=file-quick-row-item-qa-page.html' title` (the path). Select `qa-notes.md` with `control-openhands browser click 'testid=file-quick-row-item-qa-notes.md'`, then close it with `control-openhands browser click 'testid=file-quick-row-close-qa-notes.md'`. `control-openhands browser eval "[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid^=file-quick-row-item-]')].filter(e=>e.getAttribute('aria-selected')==='true').map(e=>e.dataset.testid)"` names the neighbour. Run `browser reload`, reopen the drawer and `control-openhands browser text 'testid=file-quick-row'`: the same files remain. Opening a different conversation (see Commits empty state) shows no quick-row items: `browser text 'testid=file-quick-row'` is empty. `browser testids` omits strip tabs scrolled out of view; count them with `browser eval "[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid^=file-quick-row-item-]')].length"`.
expected: the open-file strip, each tab with a close X. Closing the selected file selects a neighbour. Open files and the selection survive a reload and do not leak into other conversations.

scenarios.name: F08--second-agent-turn-commit-binaries-auto-refresh
scenarios.title: Second agent turn: commit, binaries, auto-refresh
scenarios.body: Keep Files open with `qa-notes.md` selected in Rich mode. Write `qa-f08-2.txt` with: ``In the current workspace directory run exactly this one bash command and then reply only "done": printf 'BIN\000\001' > qa-nul.bin && printf 'PK\003\004\000\000' > qa-real.docx && python3 -c "import base64;open('qa-dot.png','wb').write(base64.b64decode('iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8z8BQDwAEhQGAhKmMIQAAAABJRU5ErkJggg=='))" && printf '\n- edited by agent\n' >> qa-notes.md && git add qa-notes.md && git -c user.name=QA-Agent -c user.email=qa@example.invalid commit -qm 'QA agent commit' && git log --oneline``. Run `control-openhands conversation start --stay --prompt "$(cat qa-f08-2.txt)" --wait --timeout 240`, then `control-openhands browser testids 'testid=files-tab-tree'` and `control-openhands browser text 'testid=file-content-viewer-markdown'`. Expected: `qa-nul.bin`, `qa-real.docx` and `qa-dot.png` are listed, and the preview ends with `edited by agent`. Known failure (reproduced 2026-10-06): neither changes until Refresh, because the auto-refresh hook skips the file queries for shell commands on purpose (see Gotchas). Repro candidate, not yet filed; a report would ask to revisit that choice. Click `testid=files-tab-refresh` once: the list gains the three files and the open preview ends with `edited by agent`.

scenarios.name: F08--fallbacks
scenarios.title: Fallbacks
scenarios.body: After a refresh, click `testid=file-tree-file-qa-nul.bin` (`testid=file-content-viewer-binary-fallback`, text `Binary file – preview not available`). Then click `testid=file-tree-file-qa-real.docx` (`testid=file-content-viewer-unsupported-document`, `Preview isn't available for Word files.`). Then click `testid=file-tree-file-qa-dot.png` and run `control-openhands browser eval "document.querySelector('[data-testid=file-content-viewer-image] img').naturalWidth"` (`1`). In Plain mode the PNG shows the binary fallback. `qa-deck.pptx` and `qa-blob.bin` from the first prompt have no NUL byte and render as text (see Gotchas).
scenarios.raw: **Fallbacks (`F08.files-fallbacks`).** After a refresh, click `testid=file-tree-file-qa-nul.bin` (`testid=file-content-viewer-binary-fallback`, text `Binary file – preview not available`). Then click `testid=file-tree-file-qa-real.docx` (`testid=file-content-viewer-unsupported-document`, `Preview isn't available for Word files.`). Then click `testid=file-tree-file-qa-dot.png` and run `control-openhands browser eval "document.querySelector('[data-testid=file-content-viewer-image] img').naturalWidth"` (`1`). In Plain mode the PNG shows the binary fallback. `qa-deck.pptx` and `qa-blob.bin` from the first prompt have no NUL byte and render as text (see Gotchas).
expected: images render as `` in Rich mode. Files with NUL bytes show `Binary file – preview not available`, and Office files show `Preview isn't available for Word files.` (or PowerPoint/Excel).
notes: Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5784](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5784) (`F08.files-rich-plain`, `F08.files-fallbacks`, `F08.files-open-new-window`): a path-prefixed Agent Server can set a workspace cookie whose Path omits the prefix, leaving HTML/image/file previews unauthorized. Live prerequisite: an authenticated path-prefixed owned Local server with `OH_WEB_URL` and a real cookie-authenticated preview; the ordinary root-path launch cannot exercise that cookie Path.

scenarios.name: F08--file-editor-edits-auto-refresh-deleted-file-errors
scenarios.title: File-editor edits auto-refresh; deleted file errors
scenarios.body: Keep Files open with `testid=file-tree-file-qa-blob.bin` selected. Run `control-openhands conversation start --stay --prompt 'Do two steps, then reply only "done". Step 1: run the bash command: rm qa-blob.bin. Step 2: use your file editor tool (not bash) to create the file qa-editor.txt in the current workspace directory with the single line: created by file editor' --wait --timeout 240`. Without clicking Refresh, `control-openhands browser count 'testid=file-tree-file-qa-editor.txt'` is `1` and `browser count 'testid=file-tree-file-qa-blob.bin'` is `0` (the editor observation refetches the whole list). `qa-blob.bin` stays in the open-file strip, and the same observation re-reads the open file: `control-openhands browser text 'testid=file-content-viewer-error'` reads `Failed to read qa-blob.bin: 404` and `control-openhands browser network --filter qa-blob` shows the 404 (`browser screenshot --feature F08.files-load-error --name deleted-open-file`).
scenarios.raw: **File-editor edits auto-refresh; deleted file errors (`F08.files-auto-refresh`, `F08.files-load-error`).** Keep Files open with `testid=file-tree-file-qa-blob.bin` selected. Step 2: use your file editor tool (not bash) to create the file qa-editor.txt in the current workspace directory with the single line: created by file editor' --wait --timeout 240`. Without clicking Refresh, `control-openhands browser count 'testid=file-tree-file-qa-editor.txt'` is `1` and `browser count 'testid=file-tree-file-qa-blob.bin'` is `0` (the editor observation refetches the whole list). `qa-blob.bin` stays in the open-file strip, and the same observation re-reads the open file: `control-openhands browser text 'testid=file-content-viewer-error'` reads `Failed to read qa-blob.bin: 404` and `control-openhands browser network --filter qa-blob` shows the 404 (`browser screenshot --feature F08.files-load-error --name deleted-open-file`).

a selected file that can no longer be read shows the error (`Failed to read <path>: 404`).
notes: Known issue [#16689](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/16689) (`F08.files-load-error`): When `workspace/` paths throw a 401, call the workspace-session endpoint. Live prerequisite: The original fresh-VM URL, auth/cookie state and exact request sequence; the report says the trigger is unclear.

Known issue [#15567](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/15567) (`F08.files-load-error`): Workspace file preview returns 401 Unauthorized on non-HTTPS non-loopback hosts. Live prerequisite: A plain-HTTP non-loopback deployment and browser accessing that origin, with workspace-cookie observation.

Known issue [#15519](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/15519) (`F08.files-load-error`): "files" tab in Files side panel throws 401 Unauthorized. Live prerequisite: The reported Linux Docker deployment/auth topology; this isolated run uses the macOS source launcher.

Known issue [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#4562](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/4562) (`F08.files-load-error`): Plain-HTTP non-loopback workspace previews can return401 after the browser rejects the workspace-session cookie. Live prerequisite: A plain-HTTP non-loopback same-origin browser deployment with real workspace-cookie observation.

scenarios.name: F08--open-from-chat
scenarios.title: Open from chat
scenarios.body: Run `control-openhands conversation start --stay --prompt 'Without running any tool, reply with exactly this text and nothing else: See `src/calc.py` for the code.' --wait --timeout 180`. Close the drawer, then run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=agent-message >> nth=-1 >> testid=markdown-file-path-link'`. `right-panel-toggle` `aria-pressed` turns `true`, `testid=files-tab` is visible and `file-quick-row-item-src/calc.py` is the selected tab. The same path in the prompt bubble works too: close the drawer and click `'testid=user-message >> testid=markdown-file-path-link'`. Phone: select another file (`control-openhands browser click 'testid=file-quick-row-item-qa-notes.md'`), run `control-openhands browser viewport phone`, then the same agent-message click with `--expect-url '/panel$'`: the URL becomes `/conversations/<id>/panel`, `browser visible 'testid=files-tab'` is `true` and `control-openhands browser attr 'testid=file-quick-row-item-src/calc.py' aria-selected` is `true` (`browser screenshot --feature F08.files-open-from-chat --name phone-after-click`). Return with `control-openhands browser viewport desktop`: the app replaces `/panel` with `/conversations/<id>` (`control-openhands browser wait-url '/conversations/[^/]+$'`) and shows the drawer beside the chat.
scenarios.raw: **Open from chat (`F08.files-open-from-chat`).** Run `control-openhands conversation start --stay --prompt 'Without running any tool, reply with exactly this text and nothing else: See `src/calc.py` for the code.' --wait --timeout 180`. Close the drawer, then run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=agent-message >> nth=-1 >> testid=markdown-file-path-link'`. `right-panel-toggle` `aria-pressed` turns `true`, `testid=files-tab` is visible and `file-quick-row-item-src/calc.py` is the selected tab. The same path in the prompt bubble works too: close the drawer and click `'testid=user-message >> testid=markdown-file-path-link'`. Phone: select another file (`control-openhands browser click 'testid=file-quick-row-item-qa-notes.md'`), run `control-openhands browser viewport phone`, then the same agent-message click with `--expect-url '/panel$'`: the URL becomes `/conversations/<id>/panel`, `browser visible 'testid=files-tab'` is `true` and `control-openhands browser attr 'testid=file-quick-row-item-src/calc.py' aria-selected` is `true` (`browser screenshot --feature F08.files-open-from-chat --name phone-after-click`). Return with `control-openhands browser viewport desktop`: the app replaces `/panel` with `/conversations/<id>` (`control-openhands browser wait-url '/conversations/[^/]+$'`) and shows the drawer beside the chat.
expected: clicking a workspace path in an agent (or user) message opens the drawer on Files with that file selected.

scenarios.name: F08--tool-card-path-chip

scenarios.raw: **Tool-card path chip (`F08.files-open-from-tool-chip`).** After the file-editor turn above, close the drawer and expand its tool group and card: `control-openhands browser click 'text=2 actions completed'`, then `control-openhands browser click 'role=region[name="Collapse actions"] >> role=button[name="Expand"] >> nth=-1'` (the `Create qa-editor.txt` card). `control-openhands browser text 'testid=file-path-chip'` is the absolute `<run>/workspace/qa-repo/qa-editor.txt`. scenarios.name: F08--commits-list
scenarios.title: Commits list
scenarios.body: Click `testid=conversation-tab-commits` and run `control-openhands browser text 'testid=commit-list'`. After the first prompt it reads `-`, `Uncommitted`, `6 files`, then `4bf8272`-style SHA, `Initial fixture commit` and `… ago`; after the second prompt `QA agent commit` appears above it, with author names `QA-Agent` and `QA Fixture` shown because there are now two authors. Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=uncommitted-changes-row-toggle'` and `control-openhands browser text 'testid=uncommitted-changes-row-content'` (the changed paths; `aria-expanded` is `true`). Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=commit-row >> has-text=Initial fixture commit >> testid=commit-row-toggle'`; Uncommitted's `aria-expanded` turns `false`, and `control-openhands browser text 'testid=commit-row-content'` lists `README.md`, `src/calc.py`, `src/test_calc.py`. After the third prompt the Uncommitted count is `8 files`.
scenarios.raw: **Commits list (`F08.uncommitted-changes`, `F08.commit-rows`).** Click `testid=conversation-tab-commits` and run `control-openhands browser text 'testid=commit-list'`. After the first prompt it reads `-`, `Uncommitted`, `6 files`, then `4bf8272`-style SHA, `Initial fixture commit` and `… ago`; after the second prompt `QA agent commit` appears above it, with author names `QA-Agent` and `QA Fixture` shown because there are now two authors. Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=uncommitted-changes-row-toggle'` and `control-openhands browser text 'testid=uncommitted-changes-row-content'` (the changed paths; `aria-expanded` is `true`). Run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=commit-row >> has-text=Initial fixture commit >> testid=commit-row-toggle'`; Uncommitted's `aria-expanded` turns `false`, and `control-openhands browser text 'testid=commit-row-content'` lists `README.md`, `src/calc.py`, `src/test_calc.py`. After the third prompt the Uncommitted count is `8 files`.
expected: the top row reads `-`, `Uncommitted` and a file count; expanding it lists the changed paths.
each commit row shows the short SHA, subject, author (only when there are several authors) and relative time. Rows are single-open accordions, and new agent commits appear without a reload.
notes: Known issue [#16716](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/16716) (`F08.uncommitted-changes`): Diff view is regularly out of sync. Live prerequisite: The original simultaneous-agent/shared-repository state or a deterministic stale-diff trigger; the report only suggests that timing.

Known issue [#16454](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/16454) (`F08.uncommitted-changes`): Diff list is showing duplicate entries. Live prerequisite: The original Git changes response and update sequence producing duplicate rows; the report provides no trigger.

Known issue [#15692](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/15692) (`F08.uncommitted-changes`): Diff still shows after agent has committed and pushed. Live prerequisite: A real agent commit/push terminal observation while the diff remains mounted, plus a disposable Git remote.

scenarios.name: F08--diff-modes
scenarios.title: Diff modes
scenarios.body: In the expanded Uncommitted row, run `control-openhands browser click 'testid=uncommitted-changes-row-content >> testid=file-diff-viewer-outer >> has-text=src/calc.py >> testid=collapse'`. `control-openhands browser text 'testid=uncommitted-changes-row-content >> testid=file-diff-viewer-outer >> has-text=src/calc.py >> testid=editor-container'` shows the added `def sub` lines, and `view-mode-diff` has `aria-pressed` `true`. The row's buttons are named: `control-openhands browser snapshot 'testid=uncommitted-changes-row-content >> testid=file-diff-viewer-outer >> has-text=src/calc.py'` lists `button "Old version"`, `button "Diff" [pressed]`, `button "New version"` and `button "Collapse"` (the same `collapse` button reads `Expand` while the row is collapsed), so `… >> role=button[name="Old version"]` works as well as the test id. Click `… >> testid=view-mode-old` (2 lines), then `… >> testid=view-mode-new` (4 lines), then `view-mode-diff`. Run `control-openhands browser errors --app-only` before and after: each collapse and each diff→old switch adds `TextModel got disposed before DiffEditorWidget model got reset` (fail, #17567).

expected: expanding a changed file shows its diff; the view-mode buttons (`Old version`, `Diff`, `New version`) switch between old, diff and new without page errors.

scenarios.name: F08--empty-states
scenarios.title: Empty states
scenarios.body: Run `control-openhands fixture folder`, which makes `<run>/workspace/qa-folder`, a plain folder (no `.git`) with `notes.md`; by the time the conversation has run it holds an empty `.git` (seen live; not created by the prompt), so it ends up a repo with no commits. Run `control-openhands browser goto /` (the browser is on the qa-repo conversation) and pick it with the workspace picker as in Preconditions (`folder-browser-entry-qa-folder`). Then run `control-openhands conversation start --stay --prompt 'Run exactly this bash command, then reply only "done": rm notes.md && git status --short' --wait --timeout 180`. Open the drawer and click `testid=conversation-tab-commits`; `control-openhands browser count 'text="No commits yet"'` is `1` (`browser screenshot --feature F08.commits-states --name no-commits`). On Files, click `testid=files-tab-refresh`; `control-openhands browser text 'testid=files-tab-tree'` reads `No files in workspace`. `Loading changes...` (`testid=commits-tab-status`) shows briefly on the first Commits open after a load: on `/conversations/<id>` with Files selected, `browser reload`, open the drawer, then `control-openhands browser click 'testid=conversation-tab-commits' --observe 'testid=commits-tab-status' --observe-ms 4000` records `Loading changes...` for a few ms. `Waiting for runtime to start...` (agent state init/loading/error) was not reached: `service stop agent-server` and `restart` both left `No commits yet` on screen.

scenarios.name: F08--commit-cap

On the qa-repo conversation (`control-openhands browser goto /conversations/<id>`; Empty states left the qa-folder conversation) run `browser reload`, open the drawer on Commits and wait for `testid=commit-list`. `control-openhands browser text 'testid=commit-list-cap-notice'` reads `Showing the latest 50 commits` and `browser count 'testid=commit-row'` is `50`. scenarios.name: F08--direct-panel-url
scenarios.title: Direct panel URL
scenarios.body: At desktop run `control-openhands browser goto /conversations/<id>/panel`. The app replaces the URL with `/conversations/<id>` (the `goto` result already shows it; `control-openhands browser url` confirms), `control-openhands browser count 'testid=conversation-mobile-panel-back'` is `0`, `browser visible 'testid=chat-interface'` is `true` and `right-panel-toggle` `aria-pressed` is `true` (the drawer opens beside the chat; `browser screenshot --feature F08.panel-direct-url --name desktop-redirect`). Return with `control-openhands browser viewport desktop`.

scenarios.name: F08--subdirectory-git-paths
scenarios.title: Subdirectory Git paths
scenarios.body:
Expected: a workspace at `repo/src` lists changes beneath that folder relative to it, and its diffs open. Known failure (reproduced 2026-10-16, SDK 1.55.0, [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5843](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5843)): tracked paths retain the repository prefix while untracked paths are relative to `src`; opening displayed `src/app.py` requests `repo/src/src/app.py` and returns400. The ordinary repository-root control lists correct paths. The recipe creates only disposable, idle offline conversations.
  ```sh known-bug F08.diff-view-modes subdirectory-paths
  control-openhands browser viewport desktop
  QA_ID="$(python3 - <<'PY'
  import json, os, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile
  base = pathlib.Path(os.environ["OH_VERIFY_RUN"]) / "workspace"
  base.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
  fixture = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="qa-surface-", dir=base))
  llm = {"model":"openai/gpt-4o", "base_url":"http://127.0.0.1:1/v1", "api_key":"qa-not-real", "num_retries":0, "timeout":2}
  def create(workspace, parent=None, tags=None):
      payload = {"agent":{"kind":"Agent", "llm":llm, "tools":[]}, "workspace":{"working_dir":str(workspace)}, "autotitle":False}
      if parent: payload["parent_conversation_id"] = parent
      if tags: payload["tags"] = tags
      request = fixture / "request.json"
      request.write_text(json.dumps(payload))
      result = subprocess.run(["control-openhands", "api", "POST", "/api/conversations", "--write", "--data", "@"+str(request), "--pick", "id"], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
      return json.loads(result.stdout)["value"]
  def git(directory, *args):
      subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(directory), *args], check=True, capture_output=True)
  repo = fixture / "repo"
  (repo / "src").mkdir(parents=True)
  git(repo, "init", "-q", "-b", "main")
  (repo / "README.md").write_text("root before\n")
  (repo / "src/app.py").write_text("x = 1\n")
  git(repo, "add", ".")
  git(repo, "-c", "user.name=QA", "-c", "user.email=qa@example.invalid", "commit", "-qm", "Owned fixture")
  (repo / "README.md").write_text("root after\n")
  (repo / "src/app.py").write_text("x = 2\n")
  (repo / "src/new.py").write_text("new\n")
  print(create(repo / "src"))
  PY
  )"
  control-openhands browser goto "/conversations/$QA_ID"
  control-openhands browser click 'testid=right-panel-toggle'
  control-openhands browser click 'testid=conversation-tab-commits'
  control-openhands browser wait-text Uncommitted --timeout 10000
  control-openhands browser click 'testid=uncommitted-changes-row-toggle'
  control-openhands browser network --clear
  control-openhands browser click 'testid=file-diff-viewer-outer >> has-text=src/app.py >> testid=collapse' --observe 'testid=uncommitted-changes-row-content' --observe-ms 1000
  control-openhands browser screenshot --feature F08.diff-view-modes --name subdir-mixed-paths
  control-openhands assert --field recent.0.status --equals 200 --bug-shows 400 -- browser network --filter '/git/diff'  # bug
  ```

scenarios.name: F08--plain-parent-containing-a-repository
scenarios.title: Plain parent containing a repository
scenarios.body:
Expected: a plain workspace holding one dirty repository exposes that repository's changes. Known failure (reproduced 2026-10-16, pinned SDK 1.55.0, [OpenHands/software-agent-sdk#5641](https://github.com/OpenHands/software-agent-sdk/issues/5641)): the changes request returns200 with no changes and Commits reads `No commits yet` although the child repository is dirty. The upstream fix is closed but not included in the current pin. The recipe removes only its own verified empty parent `.git`; never remove a user's repository.
  ```sh known-bug F08.uncommitted-changes nested-repository
  control-openhands browser viewport desktop
  QA_ID="$(python3 - <<'PY'
  import json, os, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile
  base = pathlib.Path(os.environ["OH_VERIFY_RUN"]) / "workspace"
  base.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
  fixture = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="qa-surface-", dir=base))
  llm = {"model":"openai/gpt-4o", "base_url":"http://127.0.0.1:1/v1", "api_key":"qa-not-real", "num_retries":0, "timeout":2}
  def create(workspace, parent=None, tags=None):
      payload = {"agent":{"kind":"Agent", "llm":llm, "tools":[]}, "workspace":{"working_dir":str(workspace)}, "autotitle":False}
      if parent: payload["parent_conversation_id"] = parent
      if tags: payload["tags"] = tags
      request = fixture / "request.json"
      request.write_text(json.dumps(payload))
      result = subprocess.run(["control-openhands", "api", "POST", "/api/conversations", "--write", "--data", "@"+str(request), "--pick", "id"], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
      return json.loads(result.stdout)["value"]
  def git(directory, *args):
      subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(directory), *args], check=True, capture_output=True)
  import shutil
  parent = fixture / "parent"
  child = parent / "proj"
  child.mkdir(parents=True)
  git(child, "init", "-q", "-b", "main")
  (child / "README.md").write_text("before\n")
  git(child, "add", ".")
  ```

families.title: Settings shell and navigation
families.overview:
Settings is one shell around eight pages (Agent, LLM, Model Router, Condenser,
Agent Context, Verification, Application, Secrets). On desktop a pinned left
column lists the pages, highlights the current one and ends with an "Agent
Canvas" version card and a "synced from … backend" note; each page gets a title
and a grey subline. Below 1024 px (phones and tablets) `/settings` is a hub list
instead, at tablet widths (768–1023 px) each subpage has a compact Settings selector, and at phone width every page shows a Back chevron to the hub. Users reach Settings from the sidebar gear,
the collapsed rail, the command menu and several deep links (LLM banner, getting
started checklist, composer pickers). The individual pages are other families
(F10–F16; Secrets is F14).
families.entry:
- Sidebar footer gear next to the backend selector (`backend-selector-settings-link`), on desktop or inside the phone drawer (`sidebar-mobile-menu-toggle`, then `sidebar-mobile-drawer >> backend-selector-settings-link`).
- Collapsed sidebar: the gear icon at the bottom of the rail (`collapsed-settings-link`).
- Command menu (`Control+k`/`Meta+k` or `command-menu-trigger`): group **Settings** with Settings, Agent settings, LLM profiles, Model Router, Condenser settings, Agent Context, Verification settings, Application settings, Secrets settings.
- Deep links: Home banner **Set up LLM** (`home-llm-not-configured-action`, only while no LLM key is configured); getting-started checklist **Add LLM API key** and **Customize your agent**; composer LLM pill (`chat-input-llm-profile`) → **LLM Profiles**; composer **+** (`chat-plus-button`) → **Switch agent profile** → **Manage agent profiles**. Application settings also links "Manage LLM profiles" (F15's page).
- Direct URLs: `/settings`, `/settings/agents`, `/settings/llm`, `/settings/meta-llm`, `/settings/condenser`, `/settings/agent-context`, `/settings/verification`, `/settings/app`, `/settings/secrets`, and the legacy `/settings/agent`.
- Inside Settings: the left nav (`sidebar-settings-/settings/<page>`) on desktop; the hub list (`settings-mobile-hub`) plus the top-bar Back chevron (`sidebar-mobile-back-button`) on phones.
families.given:
Preconditions:

- Baseline state (launched, doctored, `onboard --skip` done), desktop viewport.
- Run the banner and checklist deep links (`F09.entry-deep-links`, first bullet) **before** configuring a model: the banner only exists while no LLM key is set.
- The composer picker deep links need a configured profile: `control-openhands llm preset deepseek` (no model call is made).
- `F09.cloud-links` positive case and `F09.locked-cloud-landing` need a Cloud backend/account (blocked in a local run). `F09.hidden-llm-redirect` is blocked: the frontend hardcodes `hide_llm_settings: false`. The update states depend on the browser reaching `registry.npmjs.org`: with access and a current client you get `F09.update-up-to-date`; `F09.update-available` and the version tile also need an npm `latest` newer than the client (blocked while the client is the latest release); the failure text of `F09.update-modal` needs the registry to be unreachable (no mocks).
families.gotchas:
- `browser click` returns the URL *before* client-side navigation and redirects settle (it prints `/` or `/settings`). Always follow a navigating click with `browser wait-url '<regex>$'` before asserting.
- At phone width there are two `backend-selector-settings-link` elements (hidden desktop sidebar plus the drawer); scope with `testid=sidebar-mobile-drawer >> ...` or the click fails in strict mode. The hub's nav links share testids with the desktop nav, so scope them with `testid=settings-mobile-hub >> ...`.
- The page does not scroll inside the settings `<main>`; the app shell column does. `browser scroll <selector> --by N` only scrolls the element into view and ignores `--by`; hover the content first, then `browser scroll --by N` (mouse wheel at the pointer).
- Only `/settings/app` is taller than a 1000 px viewport in a fresh run; use it for the pinned-nav check.
- Visiting `/settings/agents` ticks the checklist item "Customize your agent" for good (struck through, still a working link, so the bullet order above is fine), and configuring a model hides the Home banner. Run the banner deep link before `llm preset` on a fresh run.
- Registry reachability depends on the sandbox and changes between runs. When the browser cannot reach `registry.npmjs.org` (seen as `ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID` through a proxy), the version badge and sidebar tile stay hidden and the dialog shows the failure state; that is environment, not product. When it can, a checkout at the latest release shows "Up to date" and the failure text cannot be produced. Check `browser network` for the registry request before deciding which update rows are `blocked`.
- The update dialog's `role="dialog"` wrapper has no accessible name, so `role=dialog[name=...]` does not match it; use `testid=agent-canvas-update-modal`.
- The `/settings` → `/settings/agents` redirect only happens at ≥1024 px. Below that (phones and tablets) `/settings` is the hub; do not expect a redirect there.
- From 768 to 1023 px the sidebar rail stays and the phone top bar is gone; the Settings selector above each subpage provides sibling navigation. The rail's gear (`backend-selector-settings-link`) still returns to the hub.
- The phone hub is indented 32 px while sub-pages start at 16 px (hub padding inside the page padding); that is current layout, not overflow.
- The "LLM Profiles" rename in `useSettingsNavItems` targets a `/settings` nav item that does not exist, so it never applies; the LLM nav item always reads "LLM".
- Known issue [#17508](https://github.com/OpenHands/OpenHands/issues/17508) (`F09.update-available`): After installing a newer package, an older running bundle can keep showing its own version and an update banner. Live prerequisite: Isolated old/new package installs with the old process still serving, or the original stale bundle/cache capture after update.
- The public `SettingsNavigation` export renders the legacy `SettingsMobileDrawer` with a half-opacity black scrim (`bg-black/50`). Check its modern and fallback compiled CSS as a build contract. The routed phone hub uses `SettingsMobileHub`, so its navigation recipe does not exercise the exported drawer; visual verification of that export needs an embedding host.

features.description: the sidebar gear opens Settings on the Agent page; the gear is marked active on every settings URL; at phone width the drawer's gear opens the hub and closes the drawer.
with the sidebar collapsed, the rail's Settings icon opens the Agent page.
the command menu's Settings group (Settings, Agent settings, LLM profiles, Model Router, Condenser, Agent Context, Verification, Application, Secrets settings) opens the matching page.
every page in the settings nav, including Model Router and Agent Context, can be found in the command menu and opens from it.

the Home "Set up LLM" banner, the checklist items "Add LLM API key" and "Customize your agent", the composer LLM picker's "LLM Profiles" link and the + menu's "Manage agent profiles" link each land on `/settings/llm` or `/settings/agents`.
on desktop, `/settings` replaces itself with `/settings/agents` (Back skips `/settings`).
on a canvas locked to a Cloud host, `/settings` lands on `/settings/app` instead.
the retired `/settings/agent` URL replaces itself with `/settings/agents`.
with the `hide_llm_settings` feature flag, the LLM link disappears and `/settings/llm` redirects to `/settings/agents`.
the desktop nav lists the eight pages in order, exactly one link is `aria-current="page"`, and the nav stays pinned while the page content scrolls.
each page shows its nav title as an H2 with a grey subline; Secrets draws its own header instead, and the Agent profile editor hides the shell header until you leave it.
the settings screen exposes a single `main` landmark, on desktop pages and on the phone hub.
below 1024 px (phones and tablets), `/settings` stays put and shows a "Settings" heading, the eight links, the version card and the synced note, with no page header and no horizontal overflow.
widening the window to ≥1024 px while the phone hub is open replaces `/settings` with `/settings/agents`; narrowing on a sub-page keeps its URL and adds the Back chevron.

at 767, 768, 820, 1023, 1024 and 1440 px, `/settings` is the hub below 1024 px and redirects to the desktop nav from 1024 px up, and the Application page's `main` is at least 340 px wide with no horizontal overflow. Below 1024 px the settings `<main>` fills the column down to the viewport bottom and scrolls itself, so a popover inside it (the tablet selector) is not clipped on a short page (#18256).

at 768–1023 px, a Settings selector above the subpage opens the same visible section links as the desktop sidebar, including Cloud links when available. Selecting a sibling navigates directly and closes it; Tab reaches links, Escape closes and returns focus, and outside clicks dismiss it. The current section uses a slash-boundary match, so a trailing slash does not hide the selector or its selected link. It is absent on the hub, phones and desktops.
at phone width each settings page shows a Back chevron (label "Settings") in the top bar that returns to the hub.
the nav footer reads "These settings are synced from Local backend (<origin>)" for the active backend.
on a Cloud backend only, the nav adds "Integrations" and "All Cloud Settings" external links; on a local backend neither exists.
the "Agent Canvas / Version x.y.z" card opens a dialog; its "Up to date" / "Update" badge appears only once the npm check succeeded.

the dialog shows the version, a "Check for updates" button that re-runs the check, and an inline status; a failed check reads "Couldn't check for updates. Try again later."; Close and Escape dismiss it.

when the npm check succeeds and the client is current, the card badge reads "Up to date", the dialog status reads "You're running the latest version." with a "What's new" link to the GitHub releases page (new tab), and "Check for updates" briefly shows "Checking for updates…".
when npm has a newer version, the dialog shows "Version … is available.", a "What's new" link, and npm/Docker command tabs with a copy button.
the update dialog fits a 390 px (and a 320 px) viewport with its title and Close button on screen, and Close dismisses it.
the main sidebar shows an "Agent Canvas" version tile only when an update is available.
an unknown `/settings/<x>` URL shows the app's "Page not found" page inside the app shell (sidebar and a Home link), without the settings shell.
