Click Save draft: the validity text is `Value error, Invalid cron expression: every day`. `browser network --clear`, click `testid=automation-setup-test`: `browser text 'testid=automation-setup-draft-runs-page'` contains the same cron error, `browser network` lists only the draft `PATCH` (200) and nothing under `dispatch`; click `testid=automation-setup-draft-runs-back`. scenarios.raw: **Invalid drafts save (`F28.draft-save`, `F28.draft-validation`).** Fill `testid=automation-setup-name` with `QA_F28 Probe`, leave the prompt empty, `browser network --clear`, click `testid=automation-setup-save-draft`. `browser wait-url 'draftId='`; `browser toasts --history` includes `Draft saved in this conversation.`; `browser text 'testid=automation-setup-draft-validity'` is `Field required`; `control-openhands api GET /api/automation/v1/drafts/<draft-id>` (the id in the URL) has `validation_errors` `[{"field":"prompt","code":"missing",…}]` and `dispatchable: false` (`browser network --bodies` shows request bodies, not the response); `browser text 'testid=automation-setup-save-state'` is `Saved just now`. Now fill the prompt with `Reply pong. Do not run any tools.`, click `testid=automation-setup-frequency-custom`, fill `testid=automation-setup-custom-schedule` with `every day`, `browser network --clear`, press Tab, and `browser network --filter 'automation/v1'` lists no request (no blur validation). Click Save draft: the validity text is `Value error, Invalid cron expression: every day`. `browser network --clear`, click `testid=automation-setup-test`: `browser text 'testid=automation-setup-draft-runs-page'` contains the same cron error, `browser network` lists only the draft `PATCH` (200) and nothing under `dispatch`; click `testid=automation-setup-draft-runs-back`. Fill the cron with `0 0 1 1 *` and Save draft: it reads `Ready to test`.
expected: **Save draft** works on any form, valid or not; the first save replaces the URL with `?draftId=<id>`, shows the **Draft saved** bar (relative time, **View test runs**, **Test**) and the toast `Draft saved in this conversation.`, and the save state reads **Saved just now**. The draft appears in the dashboard Drafts group (F21).

the server validates on save, not on blur. An invalid draft is still saved (`dispatchable: false`) and its first error replaces **Ready to test** in the draft bar: an empty prompt shows `Field required` (also under Prompt), a bad custom cron shows `Value error, Invalid cron expression: every day`. A field error stays until the next save. **Test** stays enabled on a saved invalid draft: it saves again, opens **Test runs** with the same error in a red alert and dispatches nothing.

scenarios.name: F28--timeout
scenarios.title: Timeout
scenarios.body: Click `testid=automation-setup-add-timeout`, fill `testid=automation-setup-timeout` with `1800`, Save draft: `Ready to test`. Fill `1801`, `browser toasts --history --clear`, `browser network --clear`, Save draft. `browser network --filter 'automation/v1/drafts'` shows `PATCH … 422` (`--bodies` adds the request body, not the response) and `browser text 'testid=automation-setup-save-state'` is `Save failed`. `browser toasts --history` holds one toast, `Value error, timeout must not exceed 1800 seconds (30 minutes)`, and `browser count 'testid=automation-setup-draft-validity'` is `0`. Click `testid=automation-setup-timeout-remove` and Save draft.
scenarios.raw: **Timeout (`F28.timeout`, `F28.draft-save-error`).** Click `testid=automation-setup-add-timeout`, fill `testid=automation-setup-timeout` with `1800`, Save draft: `Ready to test`. Fill `1801`, `browser toasts --history --clear`, `browser network --clear`, Save draft. `browser network --filter 'automation/v1/drafts'` shows `PATCH … 422` (`--bodies` adds the request body, not the response) and `browser text 'testid=automation-setup-save-state'` is `Save failed`. `browser toasts --history` holds one toast, `Value error, timeout must not exceed 1800 seconds (30 minutes)`, and `browser count 'testid=automation-setup-draft-validity'` is `0`. Click `testid=automation-setup-timeout-remove` and Save draft.
expected: **Add Timeout** adds an optional **Timeout seconds** number field with a remove button; `1800` saves and the draft reads **Ready to test**.

a draft the server refuses outright (a timeout above 1800 returns `422`) sets the save state to **Save failed** and shows one error toast with the reason the API gives (a timeout of 1801 reads `Value error, timeout must not exceed 1800 seconds (30 minutes)`). The draft bar drops its validity pill (no stale **Ready to test**) until a save succeeds.

scenarios.name: F28--custom-kind-and-draft-test
scenarios.title: Custom kind and draft Test
scenarios.body: Click `testid=automation-setup-kind-custom` and `browser wait 'testid=automation-setup-custom-code'`; once the crossfade ends `browser count 'testid=automation-setup-prompt'` is `0` (right after the click it can still read `1`, and `visible` `true`) and `browser value 'testid=automation-setup-custom-code'` contains `AUTOMATION_CALLBACK_URL`. Click `testid=automation-setup-custom-details-toggle`: Entrypoint `python3 main.py`, Setup script path `setup.sh`. Save draft (`Ready to test`), click `testid=automation-setup-test` and `browser wait 'testid=automation-setup-draft-run'`: the row reads Pending and the page shows `Test run started.` Expected: `browser wait 'testid=automation-setup-draft-run >> text=Successful' --timeout 45000`. Known failure #18263 (reproduced 2026-10-15): the row stays Pending for 45 s with a single runs request in `browser network --filter '/runs'`; after `browser reload`, `testid=automation-setup-view-test-runs` shows it Successful. Click `testid=automation-setup-draft-runs-back`. Switching back with `testid=automation-setup-kind-prompt` restores the Prompt; leave the draft on Custom for the next bullet.

Known failure #18263 (reproduced 2026-10-15): the row stays Pending for 45 s with a single runs request in `browser network --filter '/runs'`; after `browser reload`, `testid=automation-setup-view-test-runs` shows it Successful. Click `testid=automation-setup-draft-runs-back`. Switching back with `testid=automation-setup-kind-prompt` restores the Prompt; leave the draft on Custom for the next bullet.
expected: the button beside the Prompt label switches between Prompt and **Custom** (Custom Python). Custom shows a generated Python script that calls `AUTOMATION_CALLBACK_URL`, and **Entrypoint and setup** reveals Entrypoint `python3 main.py`, Setup script path `setup.sh` and a no-op setup script; switching back shows the Prompt again.

**Test** on a saved, valid draft opens **Test runs** (with **Back**), shows `Test run started.` and a Pending row; it runs a hidden disabled copy of the draft, not a dashboard automation. Expected: the row reaches Successful or Failed by itself.
